Challenge_Anamorphic_Shield.title: Shield Constellation
Challenge_Anamorphic_Shield.text3: In the night skies over the continent of Pywel, the constellations shimmer with the promise of great destiny, yet each bears the solitary burden of carrying that fate for a lifetime.
Challenge_Anamorphic_Shield.text4: The steadfast light of the shield constellation will make your decisions firm and become unwavering protection in any trial.

Challenge_Anamorphic_Adventurer.title: Adventurer Constellation
Challenge_Anamorphic_Adventurer.text3: In the night skies over the continent of Pywel, the constellations shimmer with the promise of great destiny, yet each bears the solitary burden of carrying that fate for a lifetime.
Challenge_Anamorphic_Adventurer.text4: The adventurer constellation engraved in the sky still shines, hiding an incomprehensible power. Those who follow the light will overcome hardships and newly write an unrecorded fate.

Challenge_Anamorphic_Wagon.title: Wagon Constellation
Challenge_Anamorphic_Wagon.text3: In the night skies over the continent of Pywel, the constellations shimmer with the promise of great destiny, yet each bears the solitary burden of carrying that fate for a lifetime.
Challenge_Anamorphic_Wagon.text4: The starlight of the wagon constellation rolls on like wheels, never stopping. Those who follow the light will gain the power to forge their own path and open new roads, beyond understanding and calculation.

Challenge_Anamorphic_Hammer.title: Hammer Constellation
Challenge_Anamorphic_Hammer.text3: In the night skies over the continent of Pywel, the constellations shimmer with the promise of great destiny, yet each bears the solitary burden of carrying that fate for a lifetime.
Challenge_Anamorphic_Hammer.text4: The hammer constellation is not mere strength, but the power to temper the world. Those who receive its starlight turn even pain into the spark of growth.

Challenge_Anamorphic_Treant_Owl.title: Woodland Spirit Owl Constellation
Challenge_Anamorphic_Treant_Owl.text3: In the night skies over the continent of Pywel, the constellations shimmer with the promise of great destiny, yet each bears the solitary burden of carrying that fate for a lifetime.
Challenge_Anamorphic_Treant_Owl.text4: The starlight of the woodland spirit owl constellation summons souls hungry for knowledge. Those who follow its light remain sometimes as geniuses, sometimes as fools, yet their curiosity toward the truth never breaks in the end.

Challenge_Anamorphic_Sealing_Stone.title: Sealed Stone Constellation
Challenge_Anamorphic_Sealing_Stone.text3: In the night skies over the continent of Pywel, the constellations shimmer with the promise of great destiny, yet each bears the solitary burden of carrying that fate for a lifetime.
Challenge_Anamorphic_Sealing_Stone.text4: The sealed stone constellation demands both the weight of the hidden secret and the prudence to bear it, and those receive its light carry the fate of facing the strange truth concealed in the underside of the world.

Challenge_Anamorphic_Boat.title: Ship Constellation
Challenge_Anamorphic_Boat.text3: In the night skies over the continent of Pywel, the constellations shimmer with the promise of great destiny, yet each bears the solitary burden of carrying that fate for a lifetime.
Challenge_Anamorphic_Boat.text4: The ship constellation in the sea of the skies is a symbol of an unbound soul. Those who receive its starlight do not look at the signpost on the ground, but entrust their sails only to the winds of fate, and the end of that journey is all the greater because it is not predetermined.

Challenge_Anamorphic_Elephant.title: Elephant Constellation
Challenge_Anamorphic_Elephant.text3: In the night skies over the continent of Pywel, the constellations shimmer with the promise of great destiny, yet each bears the solitary burden of carrying that fate for a lifetime.
Challenge_Anamorphic_Elephant.text4: The elephant constellation, which covers the night sky most grandly, presses the heavens with silence and symbolizes one great belief. Those who receive its energy devote themselves to something great or become those who receive the devotion of others. The greatest belief calls forth the heaviest responsibility. The elephant constellation shines both the path of honor and the path of solitude at the same time.

Challenge_Anamorphic_Camel.title: Camel Constellation
Challenge_Anamorphic_Camel.text3: In the night skies over the continent of Pywel, the constellations shimmer with the promise of great destiny, yet each bears the solitary burden of carrying that fate for a lifetime.
Challenge_Anamorphic_Camel.text4: Like a camel crossing the barren desert, the starlight of the camel constellation symbolizes tenacious health. Those who receive its light never stop even in a wasteland where there's no hope, and at the end of a time of endurance, they will surely make something. In a harsh fate, they can carve a path and go forward.

Challenge_Anamorphic_Goblin.title: Goblin Constellation
Challenge_Anamorphic_Goblin.text3: In the night skies over the continent of Pywel, the constellations shimmer with the promise of great destiny, yet each bears the solitary burden of carrying that fate for a lifetime.
Challenge_Anamorphic_Goblin.text4: Under the shade of the glorious wagon constellation, there is the goblin constellation that silently pulls its load. Those who receive its starlight open paths with the wisdom and eloquence to read the flow of the universe, yet remain forever as ones who long for wealth, pulling the burdens of the world.

Challenge_Anamorphic_Black_Dragon.title: Black Dragon Constellation
Challenge_Anamorphic_Black_Dragon.text3: In the night skies over the continent of Pywel, the constellations shimmer with the promise of great destiny, yet each bears the solitary burden of carrying that fate for a lifetime.
Challenge_Anamorphic_Black_Dragon.text4: The quietest dragon flies the highest. The starlight of the black dragon constellation symbolizes invisible grandeur. Beneath the mask of gentleness, they stand above others and rule everything without revealing their strength, so those who try to look inside the Abyss will only sink, never able to define them forever.

Challenge_Anamorphic_Black_Giant.title: Giant Constellation
Challenge_Anamorphic_Black_Giant.text3: In the night skies over the continent of Pywel, the constellations shimmer with the promise of great destiny, yet each bears the solitary burden of carrying that fate for a lifetime.
Challenge_Anamorphic_Black_Giant.text4: The starlight of the giant constellation holds deep contemplation and grand aspirations. The dream is as vast as the sky, and the meaning remains as long as the stars.

Challenge_Anamorphic_Black_Key.title: Key Constellation
Challenge_Anamorphic_Black_Key.text3: In the night skies over the continent of Pywel, the constellations shimmer with the promise of great destiny, yet each bears the solitary burden of carrying that fate for a lifetime.
Challenge_Anamorphic_Black_Key.text4: The key constellation knows that every fate has a single key to open it. Those who receive its starlight see through all paths in unhurried silence, and with a moment of concentration, open the door without hesitation. A key once turned cannot be undone. The word "regret" does not exist on their path.

Mission_WindCliffFort_Block_Boss.title: Balthazar, the Wyvernflame
Mission_WindCliffFort_Block_Boss.text3: The leader of the Wyvernflames awaits in the deepest part of Fort Windridge.

Mission_WindCliffFort_Block_SubNode.title: Dormant Roars
Mission_WindCliffFort_Block_SubNode.text3: The Wyvernflames have occupied the wyvern nests.
Mission_WindCliffFort_Block_SubNode.text4: The Wyvernflames occupying the wyvern nests have been defeated.

Mission_GreyWolf_Camp_PailuneOperation_S.title: Reconstructing Pailune
Mission_GreyWolf_Camp_PailuneOperation_S.text3: Although Pailune has reduced to ashes from the battle against Ludvig, there's still hope that it can be reconstructed.
Mission_GreyWolf_Camp_PailuneOperation_S.text4: Pailune was reconstructed to its former glory, or maybe even more. It is now ready to welcome new folks.

Graymane_BaseCamp_Pailune_Start.title: The Return Home
Graymane_BaseCamp_Pailune_Start.text3: It's time to move to Pailune. Inform Serkis about your departure.
Graymane_BaseCamp_Pailune_Start.text4: Memories were left behind in Hernand before returning home.

Mission_HohenmarkRuins_Block_Start.title: Cursed Mountain
Mission_HohenmarkRuins_Block_Start.text3: Reports say casualties are mounting at the White Mountains Guard Post. Investigate what is happening in the mountains.
Mission_HohenmarkRuins_Block_Start.text4: When word spread that the wraith had been defeated, the soldiers rejoiced, saying the curse was finally over. For a brief moment, relief came to the guard post as well.

Mission_HohenmarkRuins_Block_Boss_Battle.title: Wraith in the Frost
Mission_HohenmarkRuins_Block_Boss_Battle.text3: A way must be found to quell the frozen blizzard that has engulfed the Argent Peaks.
Mission_HohenmarkRuins_Block_Boss_Battle.text4: The wraith that sought to build its own kingdom through wicked power was defeated. The ominous presence that hung within the frost began to fade as well.

Mission_HohenmarkRuins_Boss_Reward.title: Beloth, the Darksworn's Loot
Mission_HohenmarkRuins_Boss_Reward.text4: Beloth, the Darksworn's loot was acquired.

Mission_CalphadeNorthDepot_CounterAttack.title: Supply Wagon Interception
Mission_CalphadeNorthDepot_CounterAttack.text3: The guards at the northern depot seem troubled.
Mission_CalphadeNorthDepot_CounterAttack.text4: The intercepted Black Bear supply wagon was delivered to the Calphadean defender.

Mission_DesolateStoneAltar_Ogre_Boss_Sta.title: The Ogre of the Altar
Mission_DesolateStoneAltar_Ogre_Boss_Sta.text3: Dry lightning struck the monolithic altar as the ogre revealed itself. Defeat it before it crushes the desert.
Mission_DesolateStoneAltar_Ogre_Boss_Sta.text4: The ogre was defeated. The threat that once shook the altar has finally subsided.

Mission_Node_Crim_BurhumVillage_Block_St.title: The Dusksongs
Mission_Node_Crim_BurhumVillage_Block_St.text3: The Dusksongs has seized control of Burhum. These bandits, comprised of deserters, are relentlessly pillaging the area. Drive them out and liberate the village.
Mission_Node_Crim_BurhumVillage_Block_St.text4: With the Dusksongs defeated, Burhum was reclaimed. The deserters stopped looting, and peace returned to the village.

Mission_Node_Crim_BurhumVillage_Block_Su.title: Conditions for Enlightenment
Mission_Node_Crim_BurhumVillage_Block_Su.text3: The Dusksongs have occupied the areas where the water flowing from the Well of Enlightenment gather.
Mission_Node_Crim_BurhumVillage_Block_Su.text4: The wells around the village were reclaimed from the Dusksongs.

Mission_Node_Crim_BurhumVillage_Normal_S.title: A Town Drowned in Sorrow
Mission_Node_Crim_BurhumVillage_Normal_S.text3: Although peace has returned to Burhum, some worries still remain. Look for someone who looks troubled.
Mission_Node_Crim_BurhumVillage_Normal_S.text4: The generator has been activated with the solar power panel, and the Well of Enlightenment has been purified.

Mission_Node_Crim_BurhumVillage_Normal_E.title: Savior of Burhum
Mission_Node_Crim_BurhumVillage_Normal_E.text3: The problems troubling the people of Burhum were solved. Go to the chief who is relieved.
Mission_Node_Crim_BurhumVillage_Normal_E.text4: Once plagued by bandits and steeped in sorrow, Burhum now greets each dawn with clear water and peace of mind.

Mission_DesertOasis_Bismuthqueen_Block_S.title: Radiant Crystal
Mission_DesertOasis_Bismuthqueen_Block_S.text3: It seems people are suffering because of the Queen Bismuth Oreback Crab. Eliminate it.
Mission_DesertOasis_Bismuthqueen_Block_S.text4: The Queen Bismuth Oreback Crab was defeated. As its massive body of solid rock collapsed, the ground seemed to tremble.

Mission_FortManub_Block_Merchant.title: Masked Bandits
Mission_FortManub_Block_Merchant.text3:
Merchants have gathered at Duskway Camp.
Find out why they remain at the camp.
Mission_FortManub_Block_Merchant.text4: It is said that masked figures are stockpiling weapons in the merchant town.

Mission_FortManub_Block_Start.title: The Master of Masks
Mission_FortManub_Block_Start.text4: The Masked Liberator was defeated. With her fall, the momentum of the Faceless began to crumble.

Mission_FortManub_Block_Nahab.title: The Disaster Befalling Nahab
Mission_FortManub_Block_Nahab.text3: The masked ones have occupied the villages surrounding Fort Manub.
Mission_FortManub_Block_Nahab.text4: The villages surrounding Fort Manub were liberated by driving away the masked ones.

Mission_FortManub_Block_Duzhar.title: The Disaster Befalling Duzhar
Mission_FortManub_Block_Duzhar.text3: The masked ones have occupied the villages surrounding Fort Manub.
Mission_FortManub_Block_Duzhar.text4: The villages surrounding Fort Manub were liberated by driving away the masked ones.

Mission_FortManub_Block_End.title: What Remains Beneath the Masks
Mission_FortManub_Block_End.text3: The Faceless are not a threat anymore. Deliver the news to the villagers.
Mission_FortManub_Block_End.text4: You defeated the Masked Liberator and the Faceless. Beneath the masks, nothing remained but silence and fading traces.

Mission_HelmaraVillage_SandCrawler_Block.title: Flame of Helmara
Mission_HelmaraVillage_SandCrawler_Block.text3: Find a bomb to destruct the Helms' workshop.
Mission_HelmaraVillage_SandCrawler_Block.text4: The Helms' workshop in Helmara was destroyed.

Mission_BatiharVillage_Block_Start.title: The Village Beneath the Siege Engine
Mission_BatiharVillage_Block_Start.text3: The Helms have seized Batihar by force, using their weapon, Rusten.
Mission_BatiharVillage_Block_Start.text4: The Helms in Batihar were driven away.

Quest_Node_Crim_BatiharVillage_Normal_St.title: Extinguished Flame
Quest_Node_Crim_BatiharVillage_Normal_St.text3: People who fled from the Helms have gathered at Batihar. They've asked for Helmara's workshop to be destroyed.
Quest_Node_Crim_BatiharVillage_Normal_St.text4: The Helms' workshop in Helmara was destroyed. The flames used to forge Desert Marauder Rusten have been extinguished along with it.

Mission_Crim_HowlsandsCamp_Trade_Attack.title: Scream from the Desert
Mission_Crim_HowlsandsCamp_Trade_Attack.text3: Someone is calling for help. Go see what's happening.
Mission_Crim_HowlsandsCamp_Trade_Attack.text4: The man lying on the ground was a trade manager. He had been ambushed by the Sandfang Marauders, and even as his life faded, he worried about the safety of his fellow guild members.

Mission_HowlsandsCamp_Boss.title: Bandits Riding Wolves
Mission_HowlsandsCamp_Boss.text3: Defeat the bandits attacking the desert merchants.
Mission_HowlsandsCamp_Boss.text4: The leader of the bandits who terrorized the land atop their massive wolves was defeated. With their chieftain fallen, the reign of terror that once paralyzed the region has surely come to an end.

Mission_HowlsandsCamp_Boss_End.title: The Reclaimed Path
Mission_HowlsandsCamp_Boss_End.text3: The bandits threatening the people were eliminated. Deliver the news.
Mission_HowlsandsCamp_Boss_End.text4: The merchant guild was on the brink of collapse following a series of bandit raids, but timely intervention saved it. With the path to the trading post now liberated, the route is safe once again.

Mission_IsvatuFortress_Block_Boss.title: The Dusksongs
Mission_IsvatuFortress_Block_Boss.text3: It is said that soldiers who fled from the Musket Military Base have banded together to form a bandit faction. Trained as professional soldiers, they use stolen weapons to relentlessly rob and plunder nearby towns.
Mission_IsvatuFortress_Block_Boss.text4: The fort was liberated after defeating the Sandwatcher, the leader of the Dusksongs.

Mission_MuiquunVillage_Block_OwlsoftheMi.title: The Shackles on the Sand
Mission_MuiquunVillage_Block_OwlsoftheMi.text3: Word has it that Muiquun has recently become a den of outlaws.
Mission_MuiquunVillage_Block_OwlsoftheMi.text4: Head to Muiquun, which is occupied by the Mistcloaked Owls.

Mission_MuiquunVillage_Block_OwlsoftheMi.title: The Mistcloaked Owls
Mission_MuiquunVillage_Block_OwlsoftheMi.text3: The Mistcloaked Owls have occupied Muiquun.
Mission_MuiquunVillage_Block_OwlsoftheMi.text4: The Mistcloaked Owls who were occupying the town have been driven out.

Mission_MuiquunVillage_Block_OwlsoftheMi.title: A Heavy Fog
Mission_MuiquunVillage_Block_OwlsoftheMi.text3: The Mistcloaked Owls have occupied bases near Muiquun.
Mission_MuiquunVillage_Block_OwlsoftheMi.text4: The Mistcloaked Owls occupying the bases near Muiquun were defeated.

Mission_MuiquunVillage_Block_OwlsoftheMi.title: Lifted Fog
Mission_MuiquunVillage_Block_OwlsoftheMi.text3: The Mistcloaked Owls have been eliminated. Report back to the Tommaso guard.
Mission_MuiquunVillage_Block_OwlsoftheMi.text4: A reward was obtained for driving the Mistcloaked Owls out of Muiquun.

Mission_RedMountainFort_Block_GoldenArmo.title: The Crimson Desert's Knight of Fortune
Mission_RedMountainFort_Block_GoldenArmo.text3: Merrick, clad in golden armor, has seized the Crimson Mountains Fortress. It is said that he uses force and wealth to extort tolls, executing those who defy him as "traitors."
Mission_RedMountainFort_Block_GoldenArmo.text4: Merrick, the Knight of Fortune was defeated. The plunder and terror that gripped the Crimson Mountains Fortress subsided as well.

Mission_RedMountainFort_Block_GoldenArmo.title: Raiders of the Crimson Sands
Mission_RedMountainFort_Block_GoldenArmo.text3: The Twilight Messengers have occupied the area around Crimson Mountains Fortress.
Mission_RedMountainFort_Block_GoldenArmo.text4: The Twilight Messengers that held the area around Crimson Mountains Fortress were driven out.

Mission_StompsandFortRuins_Block_Boss.title: Master of the Wetlands
Mission_StompsandFortRuins_Block_Boss.text3: Ravok, the leader of the Savage Fangs, is at the wetlands.
Mission_StompsandFortRuins_Block_Boss.text4: Ravok of the Savage Fangs was defeated at the height of his rage. The threat weighing down the marshlands has subsided as well.

Mission_Tashkalp_Wanted_Normal_Krizhar_S.title: Bounty Notice - Caesar
Mission_Tashkalp_Wanted_Normal_Krizhar_S.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for trafficking slaves near Sandshift Village.
Mission_Tashkalp_Wanted_Normal_Krizhar_S.text4: The outlaw Caesar has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Tashkalp_Wanted_Normal_Barik.title: Bounty Notice - Barrick
Mission_Tashkalp_Wanted_Normal_Barik.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for tanning and trading leather made of human skin near Sunbaked Peak.
Mission_Tashkalp_Wanted_Normal_Barik.text4: The outlaw Barrick has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Tashkalp_Wanted_Normal_Sigrun.title: Bounty Notice - Sigrun
Mission_Tashkalp_Wanted_Normal_Sigrun.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for kidnapping those who are lost near Sovereign Wastes.
Mission_Tashkalp_Wanted_Normal_Sigrun.text4: The outlaw Sigrun has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Tashkalp_Wanted_Normal_Tariq.title: Bounty Notice - Tarik
Mission_Tashkalp_Wanted_Normal_Tariq.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for stealing valuables by fooling the believers near Urdavah.
Mission_Tashkalp_Wanted_Normal_Tariq.text4: The outlaw Tarik has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Tashkalp_Wanted_Normal_Zahir.title: Bounty Notice - Zahir
Mission_Tashkalp_Wanted_Normal_Zahir.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for breaking into empty houses near Arcosa.
Mission_Tashkalp_Wanted_Normal_Zahir.text4: The outlaw Zahir has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Tashkalp_Wanted_Normal_Brogar.title: Bounty Notice - Brogar
Mission_Tashkalp_Wanted_Normal_Brogar.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for stealing goods from the market in Varnia.
Mission_Tashkalp_Wanted_Normal_Brogar.text4: The outlaw Brogar has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Tashkalp_Wanted_Normal_Varka.title: Bounty Notice - Varka
Mission_Tashkalp_Wanted_Normal_Varka.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for illegal sale of entry passes to the arena near Muiquun.
Mission_Tashkalp_Wanted_Normal_Varka.text4: The outlaw Varka has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Tashkalp_Wanted_Normal_Hakim.title: Bounty Notice - Hakim
Mission_Tashkalp_Wanted_Normal_Hakim.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for leaking poisonous substances in the Red River.
Mission_Tashkalp_Wanted_Normal_Hakim.text4: The outlaw Hakim has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Tashkalp_Wanted_Normal_Frok.title: Bounty Notice - Frank
Mission_Tashkalp_Wanted_Normal_Frok.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for cowardly pickpocketing in Tommaso.
Mission_Tashkalp_Wanted_Normal_Frok.text4: The outlaw Frank has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Tashkalp_Wanted_Normal_Brol.title: Bounty Notice - Broll
Mission_Tashkalp_Wanted_Normal_Brol.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for pickpocketing in Tommaso.
Mission_Tashkalp_Wanted_Normal_Brol.text4: The outlaw Broll has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_BoneArena_Block_Tournament.title: The Bonepit
Mission_BoneArena_Block_Tournament.text3: It looks like a tournament is taking place in the arena.
Mission_BoneArena_Block_Tournament.text4: The tournament has been conquered, and the right to challenge the champion has been earned.

Mission_BoneArena_Block_Boss.title: Duel with the Emperor
Mission_BoneArena_Block_Boss.text3: The Bonepit in Tommaso is packed with spectators.
Mission_BoneArena_Block_Boss.text4: Muskan, who was known to be at the pinnacle of strength, was defeated. The roaring arena fell to silence in an instant. Only his shadow remained on the sands.

Mission_HyenaDen_Block_Start.title: Village in Fear
Mission_HyenaDen_Block_Start.text3: Villagers are living in fear due to a pack of hyenas prowling around the outskirts of the village.
Mission_HyenaDen_Block_Start.text4: Head to the hyena's den written on the bounty notice.

Mission_HyenaDen_Block_Boss.title: Skevald, the Carrion King
Mission_HyenaDen_Block_Boss.text3: Track down the leader who commands the hyenas.
Mission_HyenaDen_Block_Boss.text4: The pack of hyenas and Skevald, the Carrion King, who were threatening the village, were taken down.

Mission_HyenaDen_Block_Complete.title: Reward for Subjugation
Mission_HyenaDen_Block_Complete.text3: Skevald, the Carrion King threatening the town has been defeated. Return and report back.
Mission_HyenaDen_Block_Complete.text4: A reward was obtained for reporting the defeat of Skevald, the Carrion King.

Mission_Varnia_UrdavahResearch.title: Mineral Research Support
Mission_Varnia_UrdavahResearch.text3: The director of Urdavah's research institute needs more ores for the experiment.
Mission_Varnia_UrdavahResearch.text4: With the ores delivered, the director began experimenting immediately. The research is expected to be completed soon.

Mission_Urdavah_Academic_Normal_Start.title: Bioenergy Amplifier
Mission_Urdavah_Academic_Normal_Start.text3: There is an ongoing research for technology that harnesses energy emitted by living beings.
Mission_Urdavah_Academic_Normal_Start.text4: You obtained knowledge about the bioenergy amplifier.

Mission_Urdavah_Academic_Normal_WindEner.title: Wind Energy Fusion Turbine
Mission_Urdavah_Academic_Normal_WindEner.text3: There is an ongoing research about a fusion device that uses wind energy.
Mission_Urdavah_Academic_Normal_WindEner.text4: You obtained knowledge about the wind energy fusion turbine.

Mission_Urdavah_Academic_Normal_GoldVein.title: Process of Gold Formation
Mission_Urdavah_Academic_Normal_GoldVein.text3: There is an ongoing research about gold veins that can be mined for analysis.
Mission_Urdavah_Academic_Normal_GoldVein.text4: You obtained knowledge about the process of gold formation.

Mission_Urdavah_Academic_Normal_HighEner.title: High Capacity Energy Stabilizer
Mission_Urdavah_Academic_Normal_HighEner.text3: There is an ongoing research to efficiently collect and convert various forms of energy into powerful mechanical power.
Mission_Urdavah_Academic_Normal_HighEner.text4: You obtained knowledge about the high capacity energy stabilizer.

Mission_Urdavah_ResearchStop_Reserch_V.title: Halted Red Seaweed Research
Mission_Urdavah_ResearchStop_Reserch_V.text3: The research has been halted. Assistance may be needed.
Mission_Urdavah_ResearchStop_Reserch_V.text4: The research on red seaweed was resumed.

Mission_Urdavah_ResearchStop_Reserch_IV.title: Halted Gold Vein Research
Mission_Urdavah_ResearchStop_Reserch_IV.text3: The research has been halted. Assistance may be needed.
Mission_Urdavah_ResearchStop_Reserch_IV.text4: The research on gold veins was resumed.

Mission_Varnia_Finale_WaterPot.title: The Well's Gratitude
Mission_Varnia_Finale_WaterPot.text3: A goblin of the Saltroad Trading Post is looking for someone.
Mission_Varnia_Finale_WaterPot.text4: The goblin was the trainee from the time Burhum was rescued from the bandits. Grateful for reclaiming the well, he offered a reward.

Mission_Varnia_Daily_DesertTrap.title: Trap in the Desert
Mission_Varnia_Daily_DesertTrap.text3: An abandoned village comes into view.
Mission_Varnia_Daily_DesertTrap.text4: A group of bandits was hiding inside a house for an ambush.

Mission_Varnia_Daily_CaptiveTrader.title: Abducted Merchant
Mission_Varnia_Daily_CaptiveTrader.text3: A merchant has been abducted by the Helms at the Suhramahd Bazaar.
Mission_Varnia_Daily_CaptiveTrader.text4: It seems that the Helms are running rampant in this area.

Mission_Varnia_Daily_CowardlyThief.title: Dirty Marauders
Mission_Varnia_Daily_CowardlyThief.text3: There is a deep pit ahead. Descend and investigate.
Mission_Varnia_Daily_CowardlyThief.text4: There was an ambush by the Sandfang Marauders right after escaping the pit.

Mission_Varnia_Daily_ScaredMercenary.title: Frightened Freesword
Mission_Varnia_Daily_ScaredMercenary.text3: A freesword is held captive by the Mistcloaked Owls on the roadside.
Mission_Varnia_Daily_ScaredMercenary.text4: The Mistcloaked Owls have been running rampant lately around the area.

Mission_Varnia_Daily_DesertWoman.title: Lady in the Desert
Mission_Varnia_Daily_DesertWoman.text3: A woman is desperately awaiting a helping hand in the parched desert.
Mission_Varnia_Daily_DesertWoman.text4: Bandits were lying in wait for an ambush down the canyon.

Mission_Varnia_Daily_SafeCity.title: Safety Restored
Mission_Varnia_Daily_SafeCity.text3: A merchant is tied up by the roadside.
Mission_Varnia_Daily_SafeCity.text4: You rescued the merchant and provided him safe passage to the trading post. The merchant, having realized the risk of traveling alone, offered his sincere thanks as he safely returned.

Mission_Varnia_Daily_Goodwill.title: Futile Goodwill
Mission_Varnia_Daily_Goodwill.text3: There is a person looking desperately for a lost dog.
Mission_Varnia_Daily_Goodwill.text4: The goodwill was returned with betrayal, but the acts of kindness must not stop.

Mission_Varnia_Daily_HungryIguana.title: Hungry Iguanas
Mission_Varnia_Daily_HungryIguana.text3: A man has been abducted by the Goldenscale Bandits.
Mission_Varnia_Daily_HungryIguana.text4: The man was rescued from getting fed to a hungry iguanas.

Mission_HelmaraVillage_TransferStationCo.title: The Path to the Crimson Mountains
Mission_HelmaraVillage_TransferStationCo.text3: Rebuild the transit station in the Crimson Mountains.
Mission_HelmaraVillage_TransferStationCo.text4: The transit station in the Crimson Mountains was rebuilt.

Mission_Tashkalp_StatueConstruction_Star.title: Statue of the Emperor
Mission_Tashkalp_StatueConstruction_Star.text3: Build a wolf statue in Tommaso.
Mission_Tashkalp_StatueConstruction_Star.text4: The wolf statue has been constructed. A new landmark now stands in Tommaso.

Mission_Varnia_Arinna.title: Alina's Request
Mission_Varnia_Arinna.text3: Alina of Tommaso has asked for some grain to help the weak horses regain their strength.
Mission_Varnia_Arinna.text4: Alina was delighted to receive the high-quality grains, saying the horses will appreciate it too.

Mission_Varnia_Elowen.title: Rowan's Request
Mission_Varnia_Elowen.text3: In Tommaso, Rowan has been suffering from a grasshopper infestation and has asked to get rid of them.
Mission_Varnia_Elowen.text4: The grasshoppers have been dealt with. Rowan smiled, promising to take good care of the remaining fruits.

Mission_Varnia_Zara.title: Zara's Request
Mission_Varnia_Zara.text3: Zara of Varnia says there is a hole on the cloth used to cover items.
Mission_Varnia_Zara.text4: You gave clean cloth, weather should not be a concern for a good while.

Mission_Varnia_Khalid.title: Khalid's Request
Mission_Varnia_Khalid.text3: Khalid of Varnia asked to deliver fruits to the trading post as a token of gratitude for the basket.
Mission_Varnia_Khalid.text4: The soldier happily received the fruits, pondering what gift he should prepare for next time.

Mission_Varnia_Thomas.title: Thomas's Request
Mission_Varnia_Thomas.text3: Thomas at the Arcosa Trade Depot said he cannot concentrate because of the flamingos and asked to take care of them.
Mission_Varnia_Thomas.text4: The flamingos by the river were gotten rid of. Thomas's face now looks a little more at ease.

Mission_Varnia_Beatrice.title: Bea's Request
Mission_Varnia_Beatrice.text3: Bea of Tommaso has asked for information about the villagers' preferences to create a new hat.
Mission_Varnia_Beatrice.text4: The survey result of the villager's preferences were given. Bea was grateful, now with an idea of what kind of hat to make.

Mission_Varnia_Thibault.title: Tibo's Request
Mission_Varnia_Thibault.text3: Tibo of Tommaso said there's an ore that moves on its own and asked to bring it for him.
Mission_Varnia_Thibault.text4: The moving ores from the oreback crabs were delivered. The finished product on Tibo's workbench must be a sight to see.

Mission_Varnia_Samir.title: Samir's Request
Mission_Varnia_Samir.text3: Samir of Varnia has asked for a shining ore that can be used for the handle of a noble's sword.
Mission_Varnia_Samir.text4: The shining ore has been delivered to Samir. While it may never see battle, it will become a sword worthy of admiration.

Mission_Varnia_Sniks.title: Nix's Request
Mission_Varnia_Sniks.text3: Nix of the desert melon farm wants to sell the desert melons grown in this region and he asked to promote them to other camps.
Mission_Varnia_Sniks.text4: The desert melon was delivered to a nearby camp. Nix was confident the folks would love it.

Mission_Varnia_Noor.title: Nora's Request
Mission_Varnia_Noor.text3: Nora of Varnia says the cloth she has been expecting hasn't arrived, and asked to bring it for her.
Mission_Varnia_Noor.text4: The cloth was delivered. A stunning outfit, as dazzling as the shimmering fabric itself, will be completed soon.

Mission_Varnia_Esperd.title: Esford's Request
Mission_Varnia_Esperd.text3: Esford of the Saltroad Camp has said he can't make it to the village because of the hyenas, and wants the sample delivered to him.
Mission_Varnia_Esperd.text4: The sample was delivered, and Esford let out a sigh of relief.

Mission_Varnia_Bruknar.title: Brookner's Request
Mission_Varnia_Bruknar.text3: Brookner of Tommaso has asked for some horns to craft a sturdy bow.
Mission_Varnia_Bruknar.text4: You delivered horns delivered to Brookner. A sturdy bow that can withstand sandstorms will be crafted.

Mission_Varnia_Gwendolyn.title: Gwendolyn's Request
Mission_Varnia_Gwendolyn.text3: Gwendolyn of Tommaso has asked for an ingredient to create a new drink.
Mission_Varnia_Gwendolyn.text4: Gwendolyn was handed over the ingredient she asked for. She seemed delighted at the thought of brewing up a new drink.

Mission_Varnia_Khadin.title: Caden's Request
Mission_Varnia_Khadin.text3: Caden of Tommaso said that customers aren't coming because there's no signboard, and asked for some timber to make one.
Mission_Varnia_Khadin.text4: You delivered timber to Caden. He was excited to place an order for a signboard with it.

Mission_Varnia_Khadija.title: Hadiza's Request
Mission_Varnia_Khadija.text3: Hadiza, the insect collector has asked to catch an insect found on the village tree.
Mission_Varnia_Khadija.text4: Hadiza was delighted to see the spider. He could not take his eyes off its body, wondering where the web comes out of.

Mission_Varnia_Fatima.title: Fatima's Request
Mission_Varnia_Fatima.text3: Fatima, the village tavernkeep has asked for fresh desert melons.
Mission_Varnia_Fatima.text4: Fatima was handed over some desert melons. Thanks to the fresh, ripe melons, she can now serve a refreshing meal to her guests.

Mission_Varnia_Omar.title: Omar's Request
Mission_Varnia_Omar.text3: Omar, an equipment vendor, wants an order for crafting spears from the guards at the bridge.
Mission_Varnia_Omar.text4: He was told the order from the guards. Omar promised he would craft the perfect spear for them.

Mission_VarniaSaltroadCamp_All_Oasis.title: Rest at the Oasis
Mission_VarniaSaltroadCamp_All_Oasis.text3: Someone is sitting near the oasis in despair. Find out what happened.
Mission_VarniaSaltroadCamp_All_Oasis.text4: The merchant has been safely escorted with his wagon to the trading post.

Mission_RockVillage_DeepShadow_Normal_St.title: A Village of Growing Suspicion
Mission_RockVillage_DeepShadow_Normal_St.text3: Though it appears peaceful on the surface, suspicion and wariness are spreading through the village due to the thief.
Mission_RockVillage_DeepShadow_Normal_St.text4: The thief was caught, and the villagers' suspicions were put to rest. Peace of mind should now return.

Mission_SaltroadCamp_WagonEscort_Start.title: Principles of the Saltroad Merchants
Mission_SaltroadCamp_WagonEscort_Start.text3: The merchant is requesting a safe escort to the trading post.
Mission_SaltroadCamp_WagonEscort_Start.text4: The merchant was escorted safely to the Saltroad Trading Post.

Mission_Saltroad_Camp_Normal_Start.title: Merchant Behind the Camp
Mission_Saltroad_Camp_Normal_Start.text3: Someone is observing the Goldenscale Bandits being defeated.
Mission_Saltroad_Camp_Normal_Start.text4: A merchant of the Redwind Merchant Guild, who was hiding, expressed her gratitude.

Mission_Varnia_Finedining.title: A Hearty Meal
Mission_Varnia_Finedining.text3: There is a person looking starved at the Saltroad Trading Post.
Mission_Varnia_Finedining.text4: The man was delighted, having received all kinds of meat.

Mission_Varnia_DrinkandRoar.title: Between Drinks and Cheers
Mission_Varnia_DrinkandRoar.text3: A man watching at the arena is looking for some cold liquor.
Mission_Varnia_DrinkandRoar.text4: He received his tankard of beer. His gaze will never leave the arena.

Mission_Varnia_BoundbyLies.title: Footsteps of the Accused
Mission_Varnia_BoundbyLies.text3: A man from Muiquun insists he's been falsely accused and asked to send his regards to his family.
Mission_Varnia_BoundbyLies.text4: His regards were passed along to his family. He seems to be longing for the day he can see them again.

Mission_Varnia_IronGrave.title: Tomb of Iron
Mission_Varnia_IronGrave.text3: A resident of Helmara is looking for tools to clear away scrap metal.
Mission_Varnia_IronGrave.text4: You delivered the mallet and shovel. What will the village look like once all the scrap metal is cleared away?

Mission_Varnia_SecretSip.title: A Secret Request
Mission_Varnia_SecretSip.text3: A trainee of Urdavah has secretly asked for some wine.
Mission_Varnia_SecretSip.text4: The wine was handed over to him. It feels like there's someone watching.

Mission_Varnia_RestoringCamp.title: A Hand in Rebuilding
Mission_Varnia_RestoringCamp.text3: A man at the Saltroad Camp has asked for some timber to repair his fence and wagon.
Mission_Varnia_RestoringCamp.text4: The man received his timber. It'll take some time for him to restore them to its former state.

Mission_Varnia_ScalesofVitality.title: Scales of Vitality
Mission_Varnia_ScalesofVitality.text3: A weary-looking man at a freeswords' camp has asked for a fish to help him recover.
Mission_Varnia_ScalesofVitality.text4: The fish was handed over to the man. His eyes already seemed to light up at the sight of the fresh catch.

Mission_Varnia_PoisonFlower.title: Beauty Bearing Poison
Mission_Varnia_PoisonFlower.text3: A suspicious person at the outskirts of Muiquun is looking for some plant.
Mission_Varnia_PoisonFlower.text4: The false hellebore were delivered to the man. After inspecting it, he wore a satisfied expression.

Mission_Varnia_FriendNews.title: Friend's Whereabouts
Mission_Varnia_FriendNews.text3: A merchant at Arcosa is curious of his friend's whereabouts and wants news of him.
Mission_Varnia_FriendNews.text4: The merchant received the news of his friend's safety. He was relieved to hear nothing bad had happened.

Mission_Varnia_EndLessWaiting.title: Endless Waiting
Mission_Varnia_EndLessWaiting.text3: A nun who came to pray wants to know from the soldier how much longer she would have to wait.
Mission_Varnia_EndLessWaiting.text4: The nun was told she would have to wait a few more days. She accepted the news calmly and chose to wait.

Mission_Varnia_Cormar.title: Wings of Many Hues
Mission_Varnia_Cormar.text3: Cormac, a dyer in Tommaso, has asked a beautiful insect to inspire him and restore his lost senses.
Mission_Varnia_Cormar.text4: You gave him a jewel beetle with a beautifully shimmering shell. Cormac's eyes seemed to sparkle.

Mission_Tashkalp_PrayToRock_Start.title: Prayer that Reached the Rock
Mission_Tashkalp_PrayToRock_Start.text3: Found out about the memory of a woman's desperate prayer.

Mission_Tashkalp_RunawayGirl_Start.title: Frightened Footsteps
Mission_Tashkalp_RunawayGirl_Start.text3: There is a girl who seems restless.
Mission_Tashkalp_RunawayGirl_Start.text4: The girl who escaped from bandits was safely taken to the village.

Mission_HyenaDen_All_Daughter_Start.title: Lost Wooden Doll
Mission_HyenaDen_All_Daughter_Start.text3: A man seems troubled in Tommaso.
Mission_HyenaDen_All_Daughter_Start.text4: You found the doll someone lost.

Mission_HyenaDen_All_Daughter_End.title: The Wooden Doll Returned
Mission_HyenaDen_All_Daughter_End.text3: There's a wooden doll in the Hyena Den. It looks like it belongs to someone from a nearby village.
Mission_HyenaDen_All_Daughter_End.text4: You returned the wooden doll to the man who was searching it for his young daughter.

Mission_Saltroad_Camp_Block_Start.title: Dangerous Saltroad
Mission_Saltroad_Camp_Block_Start.text3: The Goldenscale Bandits have occupied the Saltroad Camp.
Mission_Saltroad_Camp_Block_Start.text4: The Goldenscale Bandits occupying the Saltroad Camp were defeated.

Mission_MuiquunVillage_Normal_BountyHunt.title: Name on the Bounty Notice
Mission_MuiquunVillage_Normal_BountyHunt.text3: Rumors suggest outlaws have been spotted near Muiquun.
Mission_MuiquunVillage_Normal_BountyHunt.text4: An outlaw near Muiquun was arrested and turned in.

Mission_MuiquunVillage_CarriageWorkshop_.title: Lawless Market
Mission_MuiquunVillage_CarriageWorkshop_.text3: Muiquun appears to be a place where outlaws often end up.

Mission_MuiquunVillage_CarriageWorkshop_.title: Wagon Collector
Mission_MuiquunVillage_CarriageWorkshop_.text3: The manager of the wagon repair shop is waiting.
Mission_MuiquunVillage_CarriageWorkshop_.text4: The wagon fence is always available.

Mission_SaltroadTradePost_TruthontheSand.title: The Missing Contract and Chest Full of Gold Coins
Mission_SaltroadTradePost_TruthontheSand.text3: There seems to be a commotion at the trading company. Find out what's happening.
Mission_SaltroadTradePost_TruthontheSand.text4: The trading company's valuable contract documents and a chest of gold coins have gone missing.

SaltroadTradePost_TruthontheSand_Normal_.title: Investigate
SaltroadTradePost_TruthontheSand_Normal_.text3: Talk to the people at the trading group.
SaltroadTradePost_TruthontheSand_Normal_.text4: Information on the strongbox has been acquired.

Mission_SaltroadTradePost_TruthontheSand.title: Contradiction
Mission_SaltroadTradePost_TruthontheSand.text3: All the information has been gathered. Talk to the guard captain.
Mission_SaltroadTradePost_TruthontheSand.text4: The culprit was tracked down after talking to the guard captain.

Mission_Tashkalp_FruitofGreed_Normal_Sta.title: The Missing Desert Melons
Mission_Tashkalp_FruitofGreed_Normal_Sta.text3: Find out what happened at the desert melon farm.
Mission_Tashkalp_FruitofGreed_Normal_Sta.text4: The desert melons have been disappearing one by one.

Mission_Tashkalp_FruitofGreed_Normal_Sea.title: Investigate
Mission_Tashkalp_FruitofGreed_Normal_Sea.text3: Talk to those connected to the desert melons to narrow down the suspects.
Mission_Tashkalp_FruitofGreed_Normal_Sea.text4: Information on the suspects has been acquired.

Mission_Tashkalp_FruitofGreed_Normal_Com.title: Unraveling Clues
Mission_Tashkalp_FruitofGreed_Normal_Com.text3: With all the information collected, talk to the guard captain.
Mission_Tashkalp_FruitofGreed_Normal_Com.text4: The culprit was tracked down after talking to the Tommaso guard captain.

Mission_Node_Crim_ShadowdeepForest_Block.title: Lingering Threat in the Forest
Mission_Node_Crim_ShadowdeepForest_Block.text3: The Wolf Trackers have occupied the Gloomy Forest.
Mission_Node_Crim_ShadowdeepForest_Block.text4: The Wolf Trackers occupying the Gloomy Forest were defeated.

Mission_Node_Crim_ShadowdeepForest_Block.title: Eyes atop the Watchtower
Mission_Node_Crim_ShadowdeepForest_Block.text3: The Wolf Trackers have occupied the strongholds around the Gloomy Forest.
Mission_Node_Crim_ShadowdeepForest_Block.text4: The Wolf Trackers occupying the strongholds around the Gloomy Forest were defeated.

Mission_Node_Crim_GiantsYardForwardCamp_.title: Veil of the Yard
Mission_Node_Crim_GiantsYardForwardCamp_.text3: The Wolf Trackers have occupied the Giant's Yard Outpost Camp.
Mission_Node_Crim_GiantsYardForwardCamp_.text4: The Wolf Trackers occupying the Giant's Yard Outpost Camp were defeated.

Mission_Node_Crim_GiantsYardForwardCamp_.title: Encirclement on the Cliff
Mission_Node_Crim_GiantsYardForwardCamp_.text3: The Wolf Trackers have occupied the Red River Cliff Watchtower.
Mission_Node_Crim_GiantsYardForwardCamp_.text4: The Wolf Trackers occupying the Red River Cliff Watchtower were defeated.

Mission_BursadaCastleRuins_Block_Start.title: Veil of the Abandoned Castle Ruins
Mission_BursadaCastleRuins_Block_Start.text3: The Wolf Trackers have occupied the Bursada Castle Ruins.
Mission_BursadaCastleRuins_Block_Start.text4: The Wolf Trackers occupying Bursada Castle Ruins were defeated.

Mission_BursadaCastleRuins_Block_SubNode.title: Siege of the Abandoned Castle Ruins
Mission_BursadaCastleRuins_Block_SubNode.text3: The Wolf Trackers have occupied the strongholds around Bursada.
Mission_BursadaCastleRuins_Block_SubNode.text4: The Wolf Trackers occupying the strongholds around Bursada were defeated.

Mission_Node_Crim_GiantsYardReasearch_Wa.title: Rainforest Gorge
Mission_Node_Crim_GiantsYardReasearch_Wa.text3: The Wolf Trackers have occupied the research group watchtower.
Mission_Node_Crim_GiantsYardReasearch_Wa.text4: The Wolf Trackers occupying the research group watchtower were defeated.

Mission_Node_Crim_GiantsYardReasearch_Wa.title: The Gorge Under Siege
Mission_Node_Crim_GiantsYardReasearch_Wa.text3: The Wolf Trackers have occupied the research site.
Mission_Node_Crim_GiantsYardReasearch_Wa.text4: The Wolf Trackers occupying the research site were defeated.

Mission_FlowingSandVillage_Block_Start.title: The Den on the Sand
Mission_FlowingSandVillage_Block_Start.text3: A group of bandits has occupied Sandshift Village.
Mission_FlowingSandVillage_Block_Start.text4: The bandits occupying Sandshift Village were defeated.

Mission_RockVillage_Block_Start.title: The Fangs That Devoured the Village
Mission_RockVillage_Block_Start.text3: The Savage Fangs have occupied Arcosa.
Mission_RockVillage_Block_Start.text4: The Savage Fangs occupying Arcosa were defeated.

Mission_AsaharamCamp_Block_IguanaSandsca.title: The Rampaging Goldenscales
Mission_AsaharamCamp_Block_IguanaSandsca.text3: The Goldenscale Bandits have occupied the camp.
Mission_AsaharamCamp_Block_IguanaSandsca.text4: The Goldenscale Bandits occupying the camp were defeated.

Mission_Del_Wanted_Criminal_Elala.title: Bounty Notice - Elara
Mission_Del_Wanted_Criminal_Elala.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for stealing money from drunkards near Benus Bandit Camp.
Mission_Del_Wanted_Criminal_Elala.text4: The outlaw Elara has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Del_Wanted_Criminal_Surugor.title: Bounty Notice - Sigor
Mission_Del_Wanted_Criminal_Surugor.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for urinating on the streets near the Gleamworks of Delesyia.
Mission_Del_Wanted_Criminal_Surugor.text4: The outlaw Sigor has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Del_Wanted_Criminal_Durin.title: Bounty Notice - Duran
Mission_Del_Wanted_Criminal_Durin.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for crafting suspicious medicine near the Delesyia Dyehouse.
Mission_Del_Wanted_Criminal_Durin.text4: The outlaw Duran has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Del_Wanted_Criminal_Borzak.title: Bounty Notice - Borzak
Mission_Del_Wanted_Criminal_Borzak.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for stealing crops near Fullharvest Farm.
Mission_Del_Wanted_Criminal_Borzak.text4: The outlaw Borzak has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Del_Wanted_Criminal_Giovanni.title: Bounty Notice - Giovanni
Mission_Del_Wanted_Criminal_Giovanni.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for using machines in Delesyia without permission near the Eastern Hills.
Mission_Del_Wanted_Criminal_Giovanni.text4: The outlaw Giovanni has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Del_Wanted_Criminal_Morga.title: Bounty Notice - Morga
Mission_Del_Wanted_Criminal_Morga.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for cultivating illegal herbs near the Sanctum of Oblation.
Mission_Del_Wanted_Criminal_Morga.text4: The outlaw Morga has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Del_Wanted_Criminal_Lilhind.title: Bounty Notice - Lilith
Mission_Del_Wanted_Criminal_Lilhind.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for attempting a forest fire near the Sanctum of Devotion.
Mission_Del_Wanted_Criminal_Lilhind.text4: The outlaw Lilith has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Del_Wanted_Criminal_Zlira.title: Bounty Notice - Zelia
Mission_Del_Wanted_Criminal_Zlira.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for damaging the garden near Marni Park.
Mission_Del_Wanted_Criminal_Zlira.text4: The outlaw Zelia has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Del_Wanted_Criminal_Talgrim.title: Bounty Notice - Talgrim
Mission_Del_Wanted_Criminal_Talgrim.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for attempting a forest fire near the Sanctum of Devotion.
Mission_Del_Wanted_Criminal_Talgrim.text4: The outlaw Talgrim has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Del_Wanted_Criminal_Brooks.title: Bounty Notice - Brooks
Mission_Del_Wanted_Criminal_Brooks.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for pickpocketing in Delesyia Castle.
Mission_Del_Wanted_Criminal_Brooks.text4: The outlaw Brooks has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Del_Wanted_Criminal_Ovis.title: Bounty Notice - Obyss
Mission_Del_Wanted_Criminal_Ovis.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for pickpocketing only the wealthy at Delesyia Castle.
Mission_Del_Wanted_Criminal_Ovis.text4: The outlaw Obyss has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Finale_Timberton.title: A Friend's Advice
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Finale_Timberton.text3: There is a letter on the second floor of a provisioner's shop in Delesyia.
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Finale_Timberton.text4: A letter Harris sent to Maidon has been discovered on the second floor of a provisioner's shop in Delesyia.

Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Finale_Fullharves.title: Plentiful Greeting
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Finale_Fullharves.text3: A farmer on the street has something to say.
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Finale_Fullharves.text4: He said that this year's harvest was bountiful thanks to the repaired water tower, and gave a small reward as thanks.

Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Daily_IntoTheCave.title: A Child in a Cave
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Daily_IntoTheCave.text3: A woman says that her child had wandered into the cave, but hasn't come out for a long time.
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Daily_IntoTheCave.text4: There was no sign of the child she spoke of in the cave.

Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Daily_CopperTheif.title: Bandits Drawn by Coins
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Daily_CopperTheif.text3: On the way back with the parts, bandits who spotted some valuables have blocked the way.
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Daily_CopperTheif.text4: The wagon carrying the pipes was gone, but at least no lives were lost.

Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Daily_AntlerHunte.title: The Alluring Herbs
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Daily_AntlerHunte.text3: An apothecary who was gathering herbs and deer antlers had vanished. All that remained by the roadside were bundles of herbs and a broken walking stick.
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Daily_AntlerHunte.text4: This road became a hunting ground for bandits targeting apothecaries.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_Empty_House.title: Burglary
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_Empty_House.text3: The house shows signs of being lived in, yet no sign of life can be felt.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_Empty_House.text4: Hidden bandits ambushed those who approached the house.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_RuinsInvest.title: Ruins Investigation
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_RuinsInvest.text3: An archeologist stands by the roadside, calling out for help.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_RuinsInvest.text4: You expected to see some mysterious ruins, but the only thing waiting for you at the site were bandits.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_Broken_Brid.title: Collapsed Bridge
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_Broken_Brid.text3: A woman is asking for help on the roadside.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_Broken_Brid.text4: Bandits were hiding atop the broken bridge.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_CliffHouse.title: Clifftop House
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_CliffHouse.text3: A rundown house stands atop the cliff.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_CliffHouse.text4: Bandits were occupying the rundown house atop the cliff.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_KidnappedMe.title: A Swindler's End
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_KidnappedMe.text3: There is a captive merchant and several bandits beside a wooden building.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_KidnappedMe.text4: The bandits were defeated, and the freed merchant could not be happier to leave the place.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_WoodCutterW.title: The Woodcutter's Concern
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_WoodCutterW.text3: A captured woodcutter and bandits can be seen among the stacked piles of wood.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_WoodCutterW.text4: The rescued woodcutter was quickly taken back to the village, yet the village remained peaceful.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_RobbingRobb.title: Stealing from Thieves
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_RobbingRobb.text3: The bandits' horses are grazing peacefully.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_RobbingRobb.text4: The bandits gave chase as soon as their horse was stolen.

Mission_PortDelesyia_LighthouseConstruct.title: A Tower that Illuminates the Sea
Mission_PortDelesyia_LighthouseConstruct.text3: Construct a lighthouse at Port Delesyia.
Mission_PortDelesyia_LighthouseConstruct.text4: A lighthouse was built at Port Delesyia.

Mission_RustfieldScrapyard_TransferStati.title: Place to Stay in the Logging Camp
Mission_RustfieldScrapyard_TransferStati.text3: Rebuild the logging camp flag stop
Mission_RustfieldScrapyard_TransferStati.text4: The logging camp flag stop was rebuilt.

Mission_SweetbloomPlantation_HouseConstr.title: Rebuilt Home
Mission_SweetbloomPlantation_HouseConstr.text4: The house in Delesyia was rebuilt.

Mission_CacaoFarm_TransferStationConstru.title: Path through the Lake
Mission_CacaoFarm_TransferStationConstru.text4: Drywind Valley ironcrawler station was rebuilt.

Mission_SolonVillageRuins_BridgeConstruc.title: Hand that Connects Rivers
Mission_SolonVillageRuins_BridgeConstruc.text4: A bridge was built in Thoron.

Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Maiden.title: Maidon's Request
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Maiden.text3: Maidon, the provisioner at Delesyia Castle, has asked to find out when the next trading ship will arrive.
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Maiden.text4: Word is, a trading ship will reach the port in five days. Maidon was relieved to hear the news, as he gained enough time to ready his business.

Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Skaldar.title: Skaldar's Request
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Skaldar.text3: Skaldar, a trader in Delesyia, has asked to deliver a shipment, which arrived behind schedule, to the castle.
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Skaldar.text4: The goods were safely delivered to the castle, saving the reputation of the merchant guild.

Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Randel.title: Randelle's Request
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Randel.text3: Randelle, a saddler in Delesyia, wants to send word to a clockwork steed expert.
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Randel.text4: Randelle was told that the expert happily agreed to help. He seemed thrilled at the thought of making new horse tacks.

Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Doni.title: Donny's Request
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Doni.text3: Donny, a grocer at Delesyia Castle, has asked to find out what kind of fruits the villagers like to make his new fruit basket.
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Doni.text4: Donny has been informed of the villager's favorite fruits. He was deeply satisfied, already planning his new fruit basket.

Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Martina.title: Martina's Request
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Martina.text3: Martina at the Delesyia Castle tailor shop wants to know if there's any word on new fabric.
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Martina.text4: The merchant was informed that Martina is looking for a new fabric. She will surely be delighted when she receives it.

Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Nancy.title: Nancy's Request
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Nancy.text3: Nancy, the butcher at Delesyia Castle, has asked to bring some meat from the ranch.
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Nancy.text4: Fresh meat from the ranch was delivered to Nancy. She immediately set to work on it with her skilled hands.

Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Forex.title: Forrex's Request
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Forex.text3: Forrex, a Delesyian cannonwright, has asked to visit the armory and find out ways to boost firepower.
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Forex.text4: The information from the scholar was passed on to Forrex. He looked pleased, already picturing greater firepower.

Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Herbert.title: Herbert's Request
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Herbert.text3: Herbert, a merchant in Delesyia, wants a bluish ore found in the area.
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Herbert.text4: The ore was handed over as asked. His display case seemed to shine even brighter.

Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Marin.title: Marin's Request
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Marin.text3: Marin at Delesyia Castle has asked for herbs to get rid of the leather's smell.
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Marin.text4: The herb was handed over. Its fragrant scent should help mask the smell of the leather.

Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Inn.title: Anne's Request
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Inn.text3: Anne, who runs the tavern at Delesyia Castle, has asked for fish for her new menu.
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Inn.text4: You gave a fish to Anne's assistant. The tavern will be even more lively soon.

Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Lior.title: Leore's Request
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Lior.text3: Leore, the equipment merchant at Delesyia Castle, wants some liquor to help mend things with his friend.
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Lior.text4: The liquor was given to Leore. He should now be able to make up with his old friend, Renier.

Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Grundak.title: Grond's Request
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Grundak.text3: Grond, the Delesyian trade goods merchant, has asked for herbs to soothe his throat.
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Grundak.text4: The herbs were delivered to Grond. They should help him get better.

Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Merrigrain.title: Merrigan's Request
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Merrigrain.text3: Merrigan, the grocer of Delesyia, has asked to deliver fruit to the dyehouse.
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Merrigrain.text4: The fruit were delivered. The dyer was pleased to receive vibrant fruit, saying it's perfect to try and make a new dye with.

Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Rainier.title: Renier's Request
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Rainier.text3: Renier, the blacksmith of Delesyia Castle, has asked for some meat to help patch things up with his friend.
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Rainier.text4: The meat was handed over to Renier. Now he'll be able to make up with his friend Leore.

Mission_Beardtree_Swamp_Station_Delivery.title: Shaking Valuables
Mission_Beardtree_Swamp_Station_Delivery.text3: A man appears to need help at the dock.
Mission_Beardtree_Swamp_Station_Delivery.text4: The valuables arrived at the ironcrawler station on time to be delivered to nobles.

Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Yohan.title: A Bit of Warmth
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Yohan.text3: Johan, a priest at the Church of Delesyia, is asking for donations to help those in need.
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Yohan.text4: A donation was made to the church. It feels like Solumen's blessing will reach those in need as well.

Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Castiel.title: Abnormal Signals from the Machines
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Castiel.text3: Castiel, the expert dyer of Delesyia, has requested an engineer to be called for a malfunctioning machine.
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_Castiel.text4: Castiel was told that the engineer will arrive soon. He let out a sigh of relief, saying he should be able to prevent any further damage.

Mission_DelesyiaCastle_FruitOfPatience.title: The Fruit of Patience
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_FruitOfPatience.text3: He says he needs quality fertilizer for a better harvest, and is asking to get some for him.
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_FruitOfPatience.text4: The fertilizer was given, and he gave a seed of his fruit in return.

Mission_DelesyiaCastle_SnackTime.title: Snacks for the Children
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_SnackTime.text3: A woman from Tinkerton is preparing snacks for her children. She realized she's run out of corn, and has asked to fetch some for her.
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_SnackTime.text4: The corns were handed to the woman. It became a sweet treat filled with her love for the children.

Mission_DelesyiaCastle_FortuneOnWave.title: Fate Carried by the Waves
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_FortuneOnWave.text3: A fisherman at the harbor wants to trade his catch with a fish that his wife likes.
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_FortuneOnWave.text4: You caught and gave the fish he needed. He surely imagined his wife's warm smile, judging by his bright smile.

Mission_DelesyiaCastle_WeaponWoolHarmony.title: Weapons and Fleece, An Unexpected Combination
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_WeaponWoolHarmony.text3: A scholar engrossed in weapons development has requested some fleece, having considered it as a potential solution for shock absorption.
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_WeaponWoolHarmony.text4: The fleece was delivered to the scholar, hoping that a small idea could spark a great change.

Mission_DelesyiaCastle_NamelessSmithy.title: A Nameless Foundry
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_NamelessSmithy.text3: The owner of the nameless foundry is upset that the his ingots aren't getting the recognition they deserve.
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_NamelessSmithy.text4: The signboard order for the foundry has been delivered. Before long, a new signboard will be hanging at the foundry.

Mission_DelesyiaCastle_NewRobot.title: Now Hiring
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_NewRobot.text3: A farmer with bad knees asked to find out about the new skills of Mecha Workers.
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_NewRobot.text4: The new skills of Mecha Workers were studied from Elderglen and shared with the farmer. Perhaps one will soon be standing in his field as well.

Mission_DelesyiaCastle_FruitoftheFestiva.title: Fruit for the Festival
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_FruitoftheFestiva.text3: The village cook, busy preparing for the festival, has run out of fruit and asked to fetch some from a nearby farm.
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_FruitoftheFestiva.text4: Fresh fruit were delivered to the cook. Looks like there's no need to worry about snacks for tomorrow's festival.

Mission_DelesyiaCastle_WoodSupply.title: Timber Supply
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_WoodSupply.text3: There has been a request to deliver timber to the workshop.
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_WoodSupply.text4: You delivered the timber to the workshop, the repair work is likely to proceed smoothly.

Mission_DelesyiaCastle_MissingHammer.title: Where's the Mallet?
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_MissingHammer.text3: A man entering the furniture stacking contest urgently offered to pay double the price for a mallet.
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_MissingHammer.text4: The mallet was sold to him in return for a hefty coin purse. It weighed as heavy as his determination to win.

Mission_DelesyiaCastle_HomewardNews.title: Send my Greetings
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_HomewardNews.text3: A miner is asking to deliver some news to his family.
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_HomewardNews.text4: The news has safely been delivered to his family. It seemed to have brought them some comfort.

Mission_DelesyiaCastle_LakeParty.title: A Drink by the Lakeside
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_LakeParty.text3: The people enjoying a feast by the lakeside has run out of alcohol and requested more from the village.
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_LakeParty.text4: The liquor from the village was delivered to the people by the lake. The clinking of cups and bursts of laughter carried over the water.

Mission_HawkstoneRuins_All_Start.title: The Hesitant Coward
Mission_HawkstoneRuins_All_Start.text3: A citizen is hiding in silence.
Mission_HawkstoneRuins_All_Start.text4: The wagon was driven to the Hawkstone Ruins for Jordyn, who cannot drive.

Mission_FullharvestFarm_Normal_Start.title: Farm without Water
Mission_FullharvestFarm_Normal_Start.text3: The sprinklers have stopped working due to the water supply tower leaning. Fix the tower to restore its function.
Mission_FullharvestFarm_Normal_Start.text4: The water supply tower was fixed and the sprinklers now work.

Mission_RedfoxTradePost_Questioning_Norm.title: A Quiet Ripple
Mission_RedfoxTradePost_Questioning_Norm.text3: It looks like something has happened at the Redfox Trading Post. Talk to the trading post manager.
Mission_RedfoxTradePost_Questioning_Norm.text4: A valuable porcelain set went missing during the inspection process after its arrival. Find the culprit who stole the porcelain.

Mission_RedfoxTradePost_Questioning_Norm.title: Questioning the People Related to the Theft
Mission_RedfoxTradePost_Questioning_Norm.text3: Find those who remember the day the porcelain set went missing.
Mission_RedfoxTradePost_Questioning_Norm.text4: Stories of everyone who remembers what happened on the day of the incident were heard.

Mission_RedfoxTradePost_Questioning_Norm.title: Information Obtained Through Investigation
Mission_RedfoxTradePost_Questioning_Norm.text3: Stories of people who remember the day the incident occurred has been heard. Return to the trading post manager to talk about it.
Mission_RedfoxTradePost_Questioning_Norm.text4: It was revealed that the theft was orchestrated by Tarbo, the packer, who held a personal grudge against the noble family and deliberately sabotaged the delivery.

Mission_DewhavenCastle_Disappeared_Norma.title: The Stolen Item
Mission_DewhavenCastle_Disappeared_Norma.text3: The villagers are gathered. Find out what's going on.
Mission_DewhavenCastle_Disappeared_Norma.text4: It seems an item went missing in the village.

Mission_DewhavenCastle_Disappeared_Norma.title: Investigation
Mission_DewhavenCastle_Disappeared_Norma.text3: An item was stolen. Talk to the suspicious people.
Mission_DewhavenCastle_Disappeared_Norma.text4: The villager's stories regarding the theft were heard.

Mission_DewhavenCastle_Disappeared_Norma.title: Crime Doesn't Pay
Mission_DewhavenCastle_Disappeared_Norma.text3: The villager's stories have been heard.
Mission_DewhavenCastle_Disappeared_Norma.text4: The culprit was tracked down after talking to the village chief.

Mission_Node_Del_StonewardCastleRuins_Su.title: Hunter of the Castle Ruins
Mission_Node_Del_StonewardCastleRuins_Su.text3: The Wolf Trackers have occupied Stoneward Ruins.
Mission_Node_Del_StonewardCastleRuins_Su.text4: The Wolf Trackers occupying Stoneward Ruins were defeated.

Mission_Node_Del_BenusThiefCamp_Surround.title: Thieves' Castle
Mission_Node_Del_BenusThiefCamp_Surround.text3: Bandits are gathered in their camp in Mount Benus.
Mission_Node_Del_BenusThiefCamp_Surround.text4: The bandits in the camp have been defeated.

Mission_MarniMansion_HyperSpace_Start.title: Old Research Journal
Mission_MarniMansion_HyperSpace_Start.text3: Investigate Marni's manor. Find out where his records lead to.
Mission_MarniMansion_HyperSpace_Start.text4: An old research journal was found in Marni's mansion. The location described in the journal led to a mysterious place filled with wonder.

Mission_MarniMansion_HyperSpace_SkyPilla.title: Skypillar Archipelago
Mission_MarniMansion_HyperSpace_SkyPilla.text3: The Skypillar Archipelago is a structure containing endless space. Escape the maze by following the passage opened through the gap.
Mission_MarniMansion_HyperSpace_SkyPilla.text4: You escaped Skypillar Archipelago by passing through the flowing light. The sky whispered a secret for a moment, and the path led forward once again.

Mission_MarniMansion_HyperSpace_StreamSk.title: Steamclouds Station
Mission_MarniMansion_HyperSpace_StreamSk.text3: The interior of the station breathes with steam fog. Find the exit by passing through the steel framework.
Mission_MarniMansion_HyperSpace_StreamSk.text4: You escaped Steamclouds Station by passing through the quietly pulsing heart of the machines. A new path that leads toward another sky was found.

Mission_MarniMansion_HyperSpace_SteelSai.title: Steelsail Archipelago
Mission_MarniMansion_HyperSpace_SteelSai.text3: Steel masts rising above the sea connect the path. Escape this place by following the sharp metallic light.
Mission_MarniMansion_HyperSpace_SteelSai.text4: You escaped Steelsail Archipelago. The rough waves and deep void formed a path, allowing the journey to move toward its end.

Mission_MarniMansion_HyperSpace_RecordFl.title: Fleet of Archives
Mission_MarniMansion_HyperSpace_RecordFl.text3: You arrived at the center of a fleet, where the breath of metal and steam forms a single heart. Escape by finding a gap between the interlocking cogwheels.
Mission_MarniMansion_HyperSpace_RecordFl.text4: You escaped the Fleet of Archives. The mechanical pulse faded, but the echoes of truth and records lingered for a long time.

Mission_MarniMansion_HyperSpace_1005.title: Eternal Corridor
Mission_MarniMansion_HyperSpace_1005.text3: At the end of the research journal is the Eternal Corridor. An unknown horror waits within.
Mission_MarniMansion_HyperSpace_1005.text4: The cold beast guarding the corridor was defeated. If this was a trial prepared by Marni, the intent feels even more mysterious. An ordinary person might have lost their life here.

Mission_DelesyiaCastle_DelesyiaResearch.title: Copper Supply
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_DelesyiaResearch.text3: The research director of Delesyia has asked for copper for his research.
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_DelesyiaResearch.text4: The copper was delivered. It should keep the research running for a while.

Mission_DelesyiaInstitute_Normal_BigBone.title: Mechanical Anatomy Research
Mission_DelesyiaInstitute_Normal_BigBone.text3: A Delesyian Institute Researcher is looking at a giant bone.
Mission_DelesyiaInstitute_Normal_BigBone.text4: You learned about the mechanical anatomy research.

Mission_DelesyiaInstitute_Normal_IronEag.title: Environment Adaptability Weapon System Research
Mission_DelesyiaInstitute_Normal_IronEag.text3: There is a steel statue in the shape of a bird.
Mission_DelesyiaInstitute_Normal_IronEag.text4: You learned about the environment adaptability weapon system research.

Mission_DelesyiaInstitute_Normal_Mercury.title: Mercury Research
Mission_DelesyiaInstitute_Normal_Mercury.text3: There are countless light bulbs hanging in a village of Delesyia.
Mission_DelesyiaInstitute_Normal_Mercury.text4: You learned about the mercury research.

Mission_DelesyiaInstitute_Normal_Train.title: High-Mobility Power Device Research
Mission_DelesyiaInstitute_Normal_Train.text3: Delesyia is connected by a railroad that runs across its land.
Mission_DelesyiaInstitute_Normal_Train.text4: You learned about the high-mobility power device research.

Mission_DelesyiaInstitute_ResearchStop_R.title: Halted Prickly Pear Research
Mission_DelesyiaInstitute_ResearchStop_R.text3: The research has been halted. Assistance may be needed.
Mission_DelesyiaInstitute_ResearchStop_R.text4: The research on Prickly Pear was resumed.

Mission_DelesyiaInstitute_ResearchStop_R.title: Halted Mercury Research
Mission_DelesyiaInstitute_ResearchStop_R.text3: The research has been halted. Assistance may be needed.
Mission_DelesyiaInstitute_ResearchStop_R.text4: The research on mercury was resumed.

Mission_DelesyiaInstitute_Clue_Start.title: Red Ink
Mission_DelesyiaInstitute_Clue_Start.text3: A noisy crowd is gathered in the alley beside the Delesyian Institute. Check what's happening, and investigate the scene.
Mission_DelesyiaInstitute_Clue_Start.text4: The victim's cause of death appeared to be a deep stab wound from a sharp metal tool. You collected a dagger and a document left at the scene, and heard the testimony of a witness to gather the necessary leads to find the culprit.

Mission_DelesyiaInstitute_Clue_Interroga.title: Forbidden Knowledge
Mission_DelesyiaInstitute_Clue_Interroga.text3: Leads from the scene point to internal conflict within the Institute. Interrogate the suspects to narrow down the truth.
Mission_DelesyiaInstitute_Clue_Interroga.text4: A document opposing the victim's research and numerous signatures were found. Testimony stated that the murder weapon was not of Delesyian style and that someone headed upstairs immediately after the incident. The critical clue was the fact that a scholar named Corbin frequently visited the area around the well.

Mission_DelesyiaInstitute_Clue_Complete.title: End of Knowledge
Mission_DelesyiaInstitute_Clue_Complete.text3: Leads have revealed the identity and whereabouts of the culprit. Follow Corbin's traces to find the culprit.
Mission_DelesyiaInstitute_Clue_Complete.text4: The culprit was tracked and captured using the clues. The blood-stained conflict of the Institute ultimately revealed a dark side to the pursuit of knowledge.

Mission_DelesyiaCastle_DewhavenCastleRes.title: The Heart of Mining
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_DewhavenCastleRes.text3: The research director's asking to find the hardest mineral to make the best mining tools.
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_DewhavenCastleRes.text4: The mineral was handed over to the director. Looks like they're one step closer to crafting those mining tools.

Mission_Dewhaven_Research_ElectroKinetic.title: Energy Conversion Technology Research
Mission_Dewhaven_Research_ElectroKinetic.text3: It is said that obsolete machines all go to Rustfield Scrapyard.
Mission_Dewhaven_Research_ElectroKinetic.text4: You learned about the electricity and movement conversion mechanism research.

Mission_Dewhaven_Research_ElectroToolDes.title: Electric Tool Design Research
Mission_Dewhaven_Research_ElectroToolDes.text3: The machines at Dewhaven Logging Camp do not appear very advanced yet.
Mission_Dewhaven_Research_ElectroToolDes.text4: You learned about the electric tool design research.

Mission_Dewhaven_Research_RazorClam.title: Razor Clam Research
Mission_Dewhaven_Research_RazorClam.text3: Stoneward Harbor is bustling with people looking to buy trade goods and seafood.
Mission_Dewhaven_Research_RazorClam.text4: You learned about the razor clam research.

Mission_Dewhaven_Research_HighConductWea.title: Alloy Weapon Conductivity Research
Mission_Dewhaven_Research_HighConductWea.text3: Artisans have gathered at the Steelspike Armory to craft new weapons.
Mission_Dewhaven_Research_HighConductWea.text4: You learned about the alloy weapon conductivity research.

Mission_Dewhaven_ResearchStop_Reserch_V.title: Halted Chaya Research
Mission_Dewhaven_ResearchStop_Reserch_V.text3: The research has been halted. Assistance may be needed.
Mission_Dewhaven_ResearchStop_Reserch_V.text4: The research on chaya was resumed.

Mission_Dewhaven_ResearchStop_Reserch_IV.title: Halted Razor Clam Research
Mission_Dewhaven_ResearchStop_Reserch_IV.text3: The research has been halted. Assistance may be needed.
Mission_Dewhaven_ResearchStop_Reserch_IV.text4: The research on razor clam was resumed.

Mission_Marni_Mine_Fortress_Airplane_Bos.title: Ironwing REN-X
Mission_Marni_Mine_Fortress_Airplane_Bos.text3: Ironwing REN-X, the airship made by Marni that cuts through the skies, is being a threat.
Mission_Marni_Mine_Fortress_Airplane_Bos.text4: You successfully mounted Ironwing REN-X during flight, despite a close call. It was ultimately detonated, letting you escape safely.

Mission_Marni_Mine_Fortress_Block_Start.title: Storm Crusher
Mission_Marni_Mine_Fortress_Block_Start.text3: Destroy Storm Crusher and seize Marni's aeronautical research base.
Mission_Marni_Mine_Fortress_Block_Start.text4: Storm Crusher was neutralized and the aeronautical research base was seized.

Mission_Marni_Mine_Fortress_Block_SubNod.title: Latch in the Sky
Mission_Marni_Mine_Fortress_Block_SubNod.text3: Machines have also occupied the area around the aeronautical research base.
Mission_Marni_Mine_Fortress_Block_SubNod.text4: The machines around the aeronautical research base were driven out.

Mission_Marni_Experiment_Fortress_Block_.title: Forbidden Gatekeeper
Mission_Marni_Experiment_Fortress_Block_.text3: Marni's laboratorium is filled with mechanical guards. Defeat them.
Mission_Marni_Experiment_Fortress_Block_.text4: The robots in Marni's laboratorium were defeated and the laboratorium was seized. Further inside was full of ominous research equipment.

Mission_Marni_Experiment_Fortress_Block_.title: Strict Perimeter
Mission_Marni_Experiment_Fortress_Block_.text3: Machines are maintaining a high alert on the path to Marni's laboratorium.
Mission_Marni_Experiment_Fortress_Block_.text4: The security was breached, and the area around the laboratorium was seized.

Mission_StarVillage_Normal_Start.title: Fading Tinkerton
Mission_StarVillage_Normal_Start.text3: The lights at Tinkerton is not how it used to be. There seems to be a problem at the energy source. Find out what is wrong.
Mission_StarVillage_Normal_Start.text4: The drilling rig that powers the village was repaired.

Mission_StarVillage_Normal_Complete.title: Light Restored to Tinkerton
Mission_StarVillage_Normal_Complete.text3: Report to Cordelia that the drilling rig has been repaired.
Mission_StarVillage_Normal_Complete.text4: Cordelia expressed her gratitude for the repair of the drilling rig.

Mission_MarniOilRig_Block_Start.title: Marni's Drilling Rig
Mission_MarniOilRig_Block_Start.text3: A group of machina knights have blockaded the path to the drilling rig. Defeat them and enter the rig.
Mission_MarniOilRig_Block_Start.text4: The machina knights near the drilling rig were defeated. The inside of the rig is free to be examined now.

Mission_MarniOilRig_FixOilRig_Normal_Sta.title: Reactivate the Drilling Rig
Mission_MarniOilRig_FixOilRig_Normal_Sta.text3: The drilling rig has stopped operating due to lack of maintenance. To get it to run again, the valve room must first be repaired.
Mission_MarniOilRig_FixOilRig_Normal_Sta.text4: The drilling rig was reactivated. The power began to flow once again.

Mission_MarniMechFactory_Block_Boss.title: Ironclad Warrior
Mission_MarniMechFactory_Block_Boss.text3: Mechanicus, the Ironclad Warrior, has appeared at Marni's armory. Defeat Mechanicus and the mechanical robots.
Mission_MarniMechFactory_Block_Boss.text4: Mechanicus the Ironclad Warrior was defeated. The armory's defense was breached, and the surrounding area was secured.

Mission_SnakeTemple_Boss_Block_Aeserion.title: Shackled God
Mission_SnakeTemple_Boss_Block_Aeserion.text3: A massive shape stretches across the island, sunlight dancing across its shimmering scales. It writhes and coils, as if trying to shake free of something.
Mission_SnakeTemple_Boss_Block_Aeserion.text4: The island and the sea met in a calm, gentle embrace.

Mission_SnakeTemple_Boss_Block_Priscus.title: Priscus the Ancient
Mission_SnakeTemple_Boss_Block_Priscus.text3: There was a request to deal with the Ancients attempting to break their seal.
Mission_SnakeTemple_Boss_Block_Priscus.text4: Priscus the Ancient has been defeated.

Mission_SnakeTemple_Boss_Block_Praevus.title: Praevus the Ancient
Mission_SnakeTemple_Boss_Block_Praevus.text3: There was a request to deal with the Ancients attempting to break their seal.
Mission_SnakeTemple_Boss_Block_Praevus.text4: Praevus the Ancient has been defeated.

Mission_SnakeTemple_Boss_Block_Ancient_P.title: Primus the Ancient
Mission_SnakeTemple_Boss_Block_Ancient_P.text3: There was a request to deal with the Ancients attempting to break their seal.
Mission_SnakeTemple_Boss_Block_Ancient_P.text4: Primus the Ancient has been defeated.

Mission_LandSpider_Swamp_Boss_Start.title: The Wolf's Ballad
Mission_LandSpider_Swamp_Boss_Start.text3: A familiar voice can be heard nearby. Go see who it is.
Mission_LandSpider_Swamp_Boss_Start.text4: Reunited after the Calphade War, Diederik was still as full of hope and joy as ever. His carefree manner made it seem as though things had returned to the good old days.

Mission_LandSpider_Swamp_LandSpiderQueen.title: The Queen's Lake
Mission_LandSpider_Swamp_LandSpiderQueen.text3: Head to the location Diederik mentioned.
Mission_LandSpider_Swamp_LandSpiderQueen.text4: An artifact was discovered where the Queen Stoneback Crab had been. One of the glittering gems proved to be the artifact itself.

Mission_LandSpider_Swamp_Boss_Delic.title: The One and Only, Diederik
Mission_LandSpider_Swamp_Boss_Delic.text3: Diederik, who was thrown from the Queen Stoneback Crab's back, has been found. Check him for injuries.
Mission_LandSpider_Swamp_Boss_Delic.text4: Diederik looks perfectly fine, without so much as a scratch. Truly, he hasn't changed a bit.

Mission_Marni_Barrier_Fortress_Blockade_.title: Thunder Crusher
Mission_Marni_Barrier_Fortress_Blockade_.text3: Destroy Thunder Crusher and seize Valvegard Garrison.
Mission_Marni_Barrier_Fortress_Blockade_.text4: Thunder Crusher was destroyed and Valvegard Garrison was seized.

Mission_BloodsteelCamp_Block_Request_Kar.title: The Divine Echoes
Mission_BloodsteelCamp_Block_Request_Kar.text3: The tolling of deathly bells echoes from the heart of the Bloodsteel Fortress. As long as the bells do not stop ringing, the threat will not end.
Mission_BloodsteelCamp_Block_Request_Kar.text4: The bells that had blanketed the fortress stopped. The omen of death was cut off, and at last, true stillness settled in.

Mission_BloodsteelCamp_Block_SubNode.title: Veil of Raining Arrows
Mission_BloodsteelCamp_Block_SubNode.text3: The Blinding Arrows are stationed at every path leading to Bloodsteel Fortress. Break through the barraging arrows and enter the fortress.
Mission_BloodsteelCamp_Block_SubNode.text4: The Blinding Arrows guarding the fortress have been defeated. Advance into the heart of Bloodsteel Fortress.

Mission_BrookfieldManor_Elemore_MoonReap.title: Time to Face Justice
Mission_BrookfieldManor_Elemore_MoonReap.text3: Count Elemore is looking for a Greymane. He seems to have finally made up his mind.
