Mission_BrookfieldManor_Elemore_MoonReap.text4: Count Elemore said he would no longer evade responsibility and had chosen to act with courage. He requested to kill the Lunar Reapers, Bastier's confidants who guard the three courts, in order to stop the atrocities of the Inquisitors.

Mission_EastCourt_Block_Start.title: Eastern Court
Mission_EastCourt_Block_Start.text3: Defeat the Full Moon Reaper occupying the Eastern Court. The corrupted judgment must be set right.
Mission_EastCourt_Block_Start.text4: The Eastern Court was liberated after defeating the Full Moon Reaper. The pressure that had weighed down the east has eased.

Mission_WestCourt_Block_Start.title: Western Court
Mission_WestCourt_Block_Start.text3: Defeat the Half Moon Reaper occupying the Western Court. Sever the reach of the court.
Mission_WestCourt_Block_Start.text4: The Western Court was liberated after defeating the Half Moon Reaper. The ominous energy that had once covered the west has started to fade.

Mission_SouthCourt_Block_Start.title: Southern Court
Mission_SouthCourt_Block_Start.text3: Defeat the New Moon Reaper occupying the Southern Court. The terror they've created must be put to an end.
Mission_SouthCourt_Block_Start.text4: The Southern Court was liberated after defeating the New Moon Reaper. The judgment of the south can finally breathe again.

Mission_BrookfieldManor_Elemore_MoonReap.title: The Count's Reward
Mission_BrookfieldManor_Elemore_MoonReap.text3: Return to Count Elemore and deliver the news. It's time to finish this matter once for all.
Mission_BrookfieldManor_Elemore_MoonReap.text4: Count Elemore expressed his gratitude. His resolve has now been proven through actions, not words.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Finale_ThornRoseF.title: Lingering Embers
Mission_DemenissCastle_Finale_ThornRoseF.text3: A soldier began talking to you at Thornbriar Outpost.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Finale_ThornRoseF.text4: He expressed gratitude for the assistance in the last battle, and also for rescuing the duke's family.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Finale_Arrow.title: Threat on an Arrow
Mission_DemenissCastle_Finale_Arrow.text3: An arrow with a note tied to it flew from near the camp.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Finale_Arrow.text4: A Righteous Inquisitor sent a letter containing threats, saying they would reclaim the reapers' weapons.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Finale_Cnstellati.title: Secrets of Constellations
Mission_DemenissCastle_Finale_Cnstellati.text3: There is a scholar researching constellations at the institute.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Finale_Cnstellati.text4: A reward was obtained for the constellation research. Other secrets may be revealed as the research continues.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Finale_IronStrong.title: The Grateful Farmer
Mission_DemenissCastle_Finale_IronStrong.text3: A farmer called out near Ironwood Farm.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Finale_IronStrong.text4: Some crops were obtained along with a gesture of gratitude from the farmer. His peaceful smile was heartwarming.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Finale_RighteousA.title: Endless Pursuit
Mission_DemenissCastle_Finale_RighteousA.text3: Rumor has it that some Blinding Arrows made it out alive.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Finale_RighteousA.text4: The attackers were the remnants of the Blinding Arrows. It seems they attacked out of vengeance for what happened at Bloodsteel Fortress.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Finale_Byron.title: Shadows of Ruin
Mission_DemenissCastle_Finale_Byron.text3: Look around House Byron's Windmere Manor.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Finale_Byron.text4: You found a warning scrawled in blood inside the manor of the fallen House Byron. No traces of their former glory remained.

Mission_AzerianManor_Finale_Peace.title: Peace at the House
Mission_AzerianManor_Finale_Peace.text3: A servant of House Azerian is standing near the town.
Mission_AzerianManor_Finale_Peace.text4: Azerian's servant expressed his gratitude for helping the house.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Finale_Flame_Knig.title: Blade in the Ashes
Mission_DemenissCastle_Finale_Flame_Knig.text3: Rumor has it that remaining Flame Knights have been sighted near Demeniss.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Finale_Flame_Knig.text4: The attackers were the Flame Knights, who had come to reclaim Tristan's weapon.

Mission_Damian_AirJump_Normal.title: Where the Wind Blows
Mission_Damian_AirJump_Normal.text3: A box containing a letter lies hidden somewhere within Azerian Manor.
Mission_Damian_AirJump_Normal.text4: The box held a letter expressing a swordmaster's wishes for an open-minded world full of freedom.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_Potter.title: Captured Potter
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_Potter.text3: The potter disappeared before he could finish crafting the pot.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_Potter.text4: The potter can now continue his work.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_Bandit.title: Outlaw's Ambush
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_Bandit.text3: There's an empty house with sunlight seeping in, a strange energy can be sensed from it.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_Bandit.text4: The stillness of the private house was part of the trap.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_KidnapCitiz.title: Kidnapped Wild Ginseng Forager
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_KidnapCitiz.text3: Blinded by the thrill of spotting wild ginseng, the forager charged ahead, oblivious to the lurking danger.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_KidnapCitiz.text4: The forager seems to have realized that life is more precious than ginseng.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_DecoyCanyon.title: Attack at a Narrow Path
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_DecoyCanyon.text3: The woman on the roadside asked you to escort her, fearing the nearby bandits.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_DecoyCanyon.text4: Bandits attacked while following the woman through a narrow path. The woman you were helping calmly ran away as soon as the battle started.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_DecoyCanyon.title: The End to Curiosity
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_DecoyCanyon.text3: A woman is asking for help on the roadside.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_DecoyCanyon.text4: Only bandits lurked deep within the cliff on the way to searching for the curious dog.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_Decoy.title: A Trap for the Kind
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_Decoy.text3: A woman is asking for help on the roadside.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_Decoy.text4: The woman asking for help was on the same side as the bandits, and she disappeared amidst the chaos. The soul's scars deeper than any physical exhaustion.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_Decoy_II.title: Casted Shadow Over Good Will
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_Decoy_II.text3: A woman is asking for help on the roadside.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_Decoy_II.text4: Approached the wagon to help the woman, only to find the bandits' blades.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_DangerousHe.title: Herbalist in Danger
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_DangerousHe.text3: A man is held hostage by the bandits on the roadside.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_DangerousHe.text4: The bandits lay vanquished, and the herbalist was safe once more. The gentle scent of herbs lingered in the air, bringing an unexpected sense of calm.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_SprainedAnk.title: Sprained Ankle
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_SprainedAnk.text3: A man who slipped on moss is struggling to keep his balance.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_SprainedAnk.text4: The fisherman stuck between pieces of wood sprained his ankle and couldn't walk properly.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_Fallen_Hays.title: Collapsed Straw Bale
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_Fallen_Hays.text3: A man, trapped under a straw bale, is flailing and calling for help.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_Fallen_Hays.text4: The man trapped under the straw bale was rescued. He gave a small reward and expressed his thanks.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_Ruins_Thief.title: Robber at the Ruins
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_Ruins_Thief.text3: There is a suspicious iron gate at the secretive ruins.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_Ruins_Thief.text4: At the ruins, there were bandits hiding, prepared to attack the people.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_Safety_Firs.title: Safety First
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_Safety_Firs.text3: A man, stuck under a wooden foothold, is screaming for help.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_Safety_Firs.text4: The injured man was taken to town. He shouted, "Safety first!"

Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_Naive_Merch.title: Naive Merchant
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_Naive_Merch.text3: A person who looks like a merchant is held captive by the bandits.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_Naive_Merch.text4: The merchant fooled and held captive by the bandits was rescued, who then offered a reward.

Mission_AzerianManor_StatueConstruction_.title: Horse Outside the Manor
Mission_AzerianManor_StatueConstruction_.text3: Build a horse statue at Azerian Manor.
Mission_AzerianManor_StatueConstruction_.text4: A horse statue was built at Azerian Manor.

Mission_LacusFarm_WindmillConstruction_S.title: Where the Wind Blows
Mission_LacusFarm_WindmillConstruction_S.text3: Build a windmill at Lacus Farm.
Mission_LacusFarm_WindmillConstruction_S.text4: A windmill was built at Lacus Farm.

Mission_HayroofFarm_WindmillConstruction.title: Broken Sails
Mission_HayroofFarm_WindmillConstruction.text3: Build a windmill at Hayroof Farm.
Mission_HayroofFarm_WindmillConstruction.text4: A windmill was built at Hayroof Farm.

Mission_RoyalTomb_KingTombConstruction_S.title: Glory in Ruins
Mission_RoyalTomb_KingTombConstruction_S.text3: Build a memorial hall for the Royal Tomb.
Mission_RoyalTomb_KingTombConstruction_S.text4: A memorial hall was built for the Royal Tomb.

Mission_SilvermoonHQ_LighthouseConstruct.title: Light at the Port
Mission_SilvermoonHQ_LighthouseConstruct.text3: Build a lighthouse for the Silvermoon Tradehouse.
Mission_SilvermoonHQ_LighthouseConstruct.text4: A lighthouse was built at Demeniss Port. The ships can now safely return to the port, through the dark night seas.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Zarkon.title: Zargon's Request
Mission_DemenissCastle_Zarkon.text3: The merchant Zargon says there are difficulties in mass producing wool.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Zarkon.text4: The sheep's condition was conveyed to Zargon after visiting the ranch.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Khorn.title: Khron's Request
Mission_DemenissCastle_Khorn.text3: Khron says he needs some liquor for a ceremony.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Khorn.text4: The liquor was handed over to Khron to honor the deceased.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Geoffroi.title: Jofroy's Request
Mission_DemenissCastle_Geoffroi.text3: The Demenissian blacksmith Jofroy is looking for a way to light a bigger fire.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Geoffroi.text4: Jofroy was given a tool to stoke the fire, so he immediately started working.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Palga.title: Palgar's Request
Mission_DemenissCastle_Palga.text3: The grocer Palgar has requested to deliver some goods to his regular customers.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Palga.text4: Fruits and vegetables were delivered to Palgar's regular customers on his behalf.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Linda.title: Linda's Request
Mission_DemenissCastle_Linda.text3: The tavernkeep Linda requests to find interesting stories for her guests at the tavern.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Linda.text4: A tale of adventure was shared to the guests at the inn.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Orlonel.title: Olanelle's Request
Mission_DemenissCastle_Orlonel.text3: Olanelle wants to find out what kind of clothes are currently popular among the nobles.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Orlonel.text4: Olanelle was told about the latest fashion trend among the nobles.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Kike.title: Kiki's Request
Mission_DemenissCastle_Kike.text3: Kiki, a provisioner, has asked for a good look at the fruits in the market.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Kike.text4: Kiki was informed on the condition and prices of the fruits at the market.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Mariana.title: Mariana's Request
Mission_DemenissCastle_Mariana.text3: Mariana has requested for some fruits to put on her child's birthday cake.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Mariana.text4: Fresh fruits were delivered to Mariana.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Kata.title: Kathor's Request
Mission_DemenissCastle_Kata.text3: The equipment vendor Kathor has asked for some pumpkins to promote his weapons.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Kata.text4: The pumpkins were handed over to Kathor. He began preparing for the weapon demonstration.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Fiona.title: Fiona's Request
Mission_DemenissCastle_Fiona.text3: Fiona the saddler has asked to find out the demand for horse tack at the circus.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Fiona.text4: Fiona learned that the circus animals also need equipment.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Eldmor.title: Eldon's Request
Mission_DemenissCastle_Eldmor.text3: Eldon is troubled because his mallet is worn out.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Eldmor.text4: A mallet was delivered to Eldon.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Eliza.title: Elise's Request
Mission_DemenissCastle_Eliza.text3: Elise, the tailor, is curious to hear an honest opinion about the new outfit she's made.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Eliza.text4: Elise was able to receive an honest feedback from her regular customer.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Flint.title: Flint's Request
Mission_DemenissCastle_Flint.text3: Flint, the mineral merchant at the headstone workshop, wants to acquire a beautiful mineral so he can engrave a meaningful inscription on it.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Flint.text4: The potter's beautiful verse was passed on to Flint.

Mission_DemenissCastle_GrainHart.title: Grannard's Request
Mission_DemenissCastle_GrainHart.text3: Grannard has asked to have his grapes delivered to the winery on his behalf.
Mission_DemenissCastle_GrainHart.text4: Grannard's grapes were delivered to the winery.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Mariel.title: Marielle's Request
Mission_DemenissCastle_Mariel.text3: At the tailor's shop, Marielle has asked for some hide to patch up the jester outfit on display.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Mariel.text4: The hide was delivered to Marielle.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Trollmag.title: Trolmagg's Request
Mission_DemenissCastle_Trollmag.text3: Trolmagg, the trade manager, has asked for a bottle of wine from the winery.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Trollmag.text4: A bottle of wine was delivered to Trolmagg.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Gabriel.title: Path to Delivering the Message
Mission_DemenissCastle_Gabriel.text3: Uriel, a priest at the Cathedral of Demeniss, is asking for donations to support his conversion work.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Gabriel.text4: A donation was made to the cathedral. The blessings of Solumen will reach even the remote villages.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Bartholomew.title: Memory Beyond Sadness
Mission_DemenissCastle_Bartholomew.text3: Bartholomew has asked to provide comfort to the person grieving in front of the grave.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Bartholomew.text4: The person grieving in front of the grave was comforted.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Anselm.title: Bloom on the Forgotten Tomb
Mission_DemenissCastle_Anselm.text3: Anselm asks for some flowers to pay respects to an empty grave that no one visits.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Anselm.text4: The flowers were delivered to Anselm to pay respects to the deceased.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Benedict.title: Meal of Might
Mission_DemenissCastle_Benedict.text3: Benedict asks for fish to be caught for the weary faithful at the monastery.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Benedict.text4: Benedict received the freshly caught fish.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Montpellier.title: Invitation of Colors
Mission_DemenissCastle_Montpellier.text3: Monty from the dyehouse wants to teach the orphanage children about dyeing, but he's too shy to tell them himself, so he asked to deliver the message instead of him.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Montpellier.text4: Monty's invitation was delivered to the orphanage.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Edmar.title: A Colorful Request
Mission_DemenissCastle_Edmar.text3: Edmar has asked to check the color of the clothes that were ordered.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Edmar.text4: Information on the color of clothes ordered was delivered to Edmar.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Leonar.title: Color from Nature
Mission_DemenissCastle_Leonar.text3: Linus from the dyehouse has requested pretty flowers so he can make beautiful, natural colors.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Leonar.text4: The flowers were delivered to Linus.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Fishthiefcat.title: Protecting the Fish
Mission_DemenissCastle_Fishthiefcat.text3: A woman is looking at some fish being dried with a concerned look on her face.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Fishthiefcat.text4: The fish were retrieved and handed over before the cats could take them.

Mission_DemenissCastle_ForbiddenDrink.title: A Forbidden Drink
Mission_DemenissCastle_ForbiddenDrink.text3: A tired guard has secretly requested some cold beer.
Mission_DemenissCastle_ForbiddenDrink.text4: The beer was handed over to the guard. He looked very pleased.

Mission_DemenissCastle_NewsOnTheWaves.title: News Over the Waves
Mission_DemenissCastle_NewsOnTheWaves.text3: The man has asked to deliver news that he is doing well for his worried wife, whose husband works at the port.
Mission_DemenissCastle_NewsOnTheWaves.text4: News of her husband were delivered. The worry seemed to vanish from his wife's face after hearing the news.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Workers.title: Empty-Handed Workers
Mission_DemenissCastle_Workers.text3: A soldier guarding the statue said that some workers can't work because they don't have tools and asked for some tools.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Workers.text4: The tools were delivered to the soldier. It felt like some of the workers were glaring.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Quack.title: Cloth Over Medicine
Mission_DemenissCastle_Quack.text3: The man has asked for some clean cloth, saying that the patients are still in pain even after taking the medicine.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Quack.text4: Some cloths were delivered to the quacksalver. It's questionable whether this will improve the patient's illness.

Mission_DemenissCastle_SimilarHeart.title: Being Like Someone
Mission_DemenissCastle_SimilarHeart.text3: A man wearing animal hide has asked for some hide to make clothes for a child.
Mission_DemenissCastle_SimilarHeart.text4: The hide to make clothes was delivered to him, he smiled when he thought about the child.

Mission_DemenissCastle_FishTrap.title: Secret Fish Trap Plan
Mission_DemenissCastle_FishTrap.text3: A man wants some fish from the fish trap and has asked to deliver it to him.
Mission_DemenissCastle_FishTrap.text4: The man received the fish from the fish trap. He could feel someone watching, but pretended not to notice.

Mission_DemenissCastle_HungryHorse.title: The Horse's Sorrowful Eyes
Mission_DemenissCastle_HungryHorse.text3: A woman looking after the horses at the ranch has asked some carrots.
Mission_DemenissCastle_HungryHorse.text4: The carrots for the horse were handed over.

Mission_DemenissCastle_SadClown.title: Jester Who Cannot Smile
Mission_DemenissCastle_SadClown.text3: The jester, unable to perform tricks without his props, asks for something useful instead of a ball.
Mission_DemenissCastle_SadClown.text4: Fruits that could be used instead of balls were handed over. The jester was happier than expected.

Mission_DemenissCastle_WifeHeart.title: A Wife's Show of Heart
Mission_DemenissCastle_WifeHeart.text3: She requests to deliver the gloves she made for her husband, who works at the outskirts post.
Mission_DemenissCastle_WifeHeart.text4: The gloves were handed over. The husband who received the gloves looked very happy.

Mission_DemenissCastle_RabbitCarrot.title: Carrot for the Rabbit
Mission_DemenissCastle_RabbitCarrot.text3: A noble in a rabbit mask at the wildlife park wants a carrot.
Mission_DemenissCastle_RabbitCarrot.text4: A carrot was handed over to the noble in a rabbit mask.

Mission_DemenissCastle_HorseMoney.title: Horses and Coins
Mission_DemenissCastle_HorseMoney.text3: A man who loves horses at the racecourse asked to borrow some coins.
Mission_DemenissCastle_HorseMoney.text4: Money was given to the man at the racecourse.

Mission_DemenissCastle_WifeSupport.title: A Wife's Encouragement
Mission_DemenissCastle_WifeSupport.text3: A woman near the fishing dock has quietly asked for help. She asked to secretly catch a fish and give it to her husband.
Mission_DemenissCastle_WifeSupport.text4: The fish was delivered to the husband and the wife's request was carried out successfully.

Mission_DemenissCastle_DreamToSky.title: Longing Dream to the Skies
Mission_DemenissCastle_DreamToSky.text3: A scholar with a lasting dream of being closer to the skies has asked to get the materials to use for the final step of her research.
Mission_DemenissCastle_DreamToSky.text4: The required materials were handed over to the scholar.

Mission_DemenissCastle_WarmHands.title: Nameless Helping Hand
Mission_DemenissCastle_WarmHands.text3: A man at the trading post has asked for help to quietly donate goods to those in need.
Mission_DemenissCastle_WarmHands.text4: The man's donations were delivered to neighbors in need through the church.

Mission_DemenissCastle_ShareFarm.title: Shared Abundance
Mission_DemenissCastle_ShareFarm.text3: The fruit harvest at the farm was good, and the man has asked to deliver fruit to the apiary that lent the bee boxes.
Mission_DemenissCastle_ShareFarm.text4: The farm and the apiary ended up helping one another as they exchanged fruit and honey.

Mission_DemenissCastle_MemoryScent.title: Scent That Awakens Memories
Mission_DemenissCastle_MemoryScent.text3: A man wanting his wife to remember the past memories has asked to deliver flowers to her.
Mission_DemenissCastle_MemoryScent.text4: The husband's flower was delivered to the wife. For a moment, it seemed like old memories resurfaced.

Mission_DemenissCastle_FirstHorse.title: First Time Meeting the Four-Legged Companion
Mission_DemenissCastle_FirstHorse.text3: A man trying to buy a horse for the first time has asked help on selecting a fine horse.
Mission_DemenissCastle_FirstHorse.text4: He received information on how to select a fine horse. The man looked ready to buy his first horse.

Mission_DemenissCastle_ExpressMail.title: Swift Delivery, Safe Borders
Mission_DemenissCastle_ExpressMail.text3: A soldier at the Demeniss West Gate has asked to quickly deliver the new inspection guidelines to the south gate.
Mission_DemenissCastle_ExpressMail.text4: The new inspection guidelines were quickly delivered to the south gate. Border security has been reinforced.

Mission_DemenissCastle_BigChange.title: Small Differences, Big Changes
Mission_DemenissCastle_BigChange.text3: A man, curious about why the horses at the neighboring ranch were always healthier and faster, has asked to find out the secret for him.
Mission_DemenissCastle_BigChange.text4: The man was told that the neighboring ranch's horses were healthier because of the fresh pastures. He began to consider making changes to his own ranch.

Mission_DemenissCastle_CrescentLakeView.title: The Scenery of Crescent Lake
Mission_DemenissCastle_CrescentLakeView.text3: A man, bored from fishing at the same old small pond, has asked to check the scenery of the Crescent Lake for him.
Mission_DemenissCastle_CrescentLakeView.text4: The man was told about the scenery of Crescent Lake.

Mission_DemenissCastle_BeerForMiner.title: Beer on a Stifling Day
Mission_DemenissCastle_BeerForMiner.text3: A miner, working hard in heavy smoke and heat, has asked for some cold beer.
Mission_DemenissCastle_BeerForMiner.text4: The cold beer was handed over to the miner.

Mission_DemenissCastle_IngredientRequest.title: Food for the Festivities
Mission_DemenissCastle_IngredientRequest.text3: A woman, cooking at Slopeseed Farm, is worried that she's running out of an ingredient.
Mission_DemenissCastle_IngredientRequest.text4: The ingredient was handed over to the woman at Slopeseed Farm.

Mission_DemenissCastle_BeehiveCrisis.title: Crisis of the Beehive
Mission_DemenissCastle_BeehiveCrisis.text3: A sweating beekeeper near the beehive has urgently asked for some sugar for the bees.
Mission_DemenissCastle_BeehiveCrisis.text4: The sugar was handed over. The bees will be energized again.

Mission_DemenissCastle_RacingStage.title: Sprinting Grounds
Mission_DemenissCastle_RacingStage.text3: A researcher deeply committed to experiments wants to know if it was possible to rent the racecourse to test a new mechanical wagon.
Mission_DemenissCastle_RacingStage.text4: The manager granted permission to use the racecourse.

Mission_DemenissCastle_FieldVoice.title: News on the Dig Site
Mission_DemenissCastle_FieldVoice.text3: A manager, curious about the work at the dig site, has asked to go and check on the situation.
Mission_DemenissCastle_FieldVoice.text4: The situation at the dig site was reported back to the manager. He seemed relieved.

Mission_DemenissCastle_CitizenStory_Marn.title: The Mechatank at Horseshoe Lake
Mission_DemenissCastle_CitizenStory_Marn.text3: People are gathered around Horseshoe Lake.
Mission_DemenissCastle_CitizenStory_Marn.text4: The Mechatank drifting down the Horseshoe Lake was destroyed.

Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_TreasureBur.title: Buried Treasure
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_TreasureBur.text3: Ursula's journal spoke of a hidden treasure.
Mission_DemenissCastle_Daily_TreasureBur.text4: By piecing together the clues unearthed from the field, Ursula's secret location was found.

Mission_CarriageFence_Seizure_I.title: Other Side of the Farm
Mission_CarriageFence_Seizure_I.text3: Someone at the farm seems to be looking for Greymane. Talk to them.
Mission_CarriageFence_Seizure_I.text4: The farm owner asked to retrieve the wagon hijacked by bandits.

Mission_CarriageFence_Seizure_II.title: Marks on the Farm
Mission_CarriageFence_Seizure_II.text3: Bandits are guarding the wagon. The bandits must be eliminated and the wagon stolen.
Mission_CarriageFence_Seizure_II.text4: The stolen wagon can now be sold.

Mission_JijeongTemple_HiddenCave_Normal_.title: Young Monk's Request
Mission_JijeongTemple_HiddenCave_Normal_.text3: The young monk is desperately looking for something. Hear what he has to say.
Mission_JijeongTemple_HiddenCave_Normal_.text4: The young monk from Jijeong Temple was searching for the mystical pine mushroom. The pine mushrooms were hidden among poisonous mushrooms deep in the cave.

Mission_Dem_Wanted_Criminal_Gruul.title: Bounty Notice - Grull
Mission_Dem_Wanted_Criminal_Gruul.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for breaking into houses along the main streets of Demeniss.
Mission_Dem_Wanted_Criminal_Gruul.text4: The outlaw Grull has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Dem_Wanted_Criminal_Fabrizio.title: Bounty Notice - Fabrizio
Mission_Dem_Wanted_Criminal_Fabrizio.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for illegal trade in animals at the royal hunting ground.
Mission_Dem_Wanted_Criminal_Fabrizio.text4: The outlaw Fabrizio has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Dem_Wanted_Criminal_Gruultar.title: Bounty Notice - Garth
Mission_Dem_Wanted_Criminal_Gruultar.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for kidnapping and murdering.
Mission_Dem_Wanted_Criminal_Gruultar.text4: The outlaw Garth has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Dem_Wanted_Criminal_Selene.title: Bounty Notice - Selene
Mission_Dem_Wanted_Criminal_Selene.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for extorting money and goods from the Church of West Demeniss.
Mission_Dem_Wanted_Criminal_Selene.text4: The outlaw Selene has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Dem_Wanted_Criminal_Sizzle.title: Bounty Notice - Cecil
Mission_Dem_Wanted_Criminal_Sizzle.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for fraud at the Demeniss Circus.
Mission_Dem_Wanted_Criminal_Sizzle.text4: The outlaw Cecil has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Dem_Wanted_Criminal_Blurt.title: Bounty Notice - Blair
Mission_Dem_Wanted_Criminal_Blurt.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for spreading songs mocking the royal family and inciting citizens to disturb the order.
Mission_Dem_Wanted_Criminal_Blurt.text4: The outlaw Blair has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Dem_Wanted_Criminal_Boggle.title: Bounty Notice - Bo
Mission_Dem_Wanted_Criminal_Boggle.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for committing theft and selling stolen goods at the port of the Silvermoon Trade Group.
Mission_Dem_Wanted_Criminal_Boggle.text4: The outlaw Bo has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Dem_Wanted_Criminal_Urga.title: Bounty Notice - Ursula
Mission_Dem_Wanted_Criminal_Urga.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for cultivating dangerous crops at Slopeseed Farm.
Mission_Dem_Wanted_Criminal_Urga.text4: The outlaw Ursula has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Dem_Wanted_Criminal_Helya.title: Bounty Notice - Helia
Mission_Dem_Wanted_Criminal_Helya.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for being involved in human trafficking at Thornbriar Mountain.
Mission_Dem_Wanted_Criminal_Helya.text4: The outlaw Helia has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Dem_Wanted_Criminal_Rinaldo.title: Bounty Notice - Rinaldo
Mission_Dem_Wanted_Criminal_Rinaldo.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for posing as a beggar at Demeniss Castle.
Mission_Dem_Wanted_Criminal_Rinaldo.text4: The outlaw Rinaldo has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Dem_Wanted_Criminal_Gunnar.title: Bounty Notice - Gunder
Mission_Dem_Wanted_Criminal_Gunnar.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for pickpocketing in Demeniss.
Mission_Dem_Wanted_Criminal_Gunnar.text4: The outlaw Gunder has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Dem_Wanted_Criminal_Henrik.title: Bounty Notice - Henrik
Mission_Dem_Wanted_Criminal_Henrik.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for pickpocketing in Demeniss.
Mission_Dem_Wanted_Criminal_Henrik.text4: The outlaw Henrik has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Dem_Wanted_Criminal_Eskil.title: Bounty Notice - Aksel
Mission_Dem_Wanted_Criminal_Eskil.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for pickpocketing in Demeniss.
Mission_Dem_Wanted_Criminal_Eskil.text4: The outlaw Aksel has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Node_Dem_GrayRockShipyard_Block_.title: The Hunter's Path
Mission_Node_Dem_GrayRockShipyard_Block_.text3: The Wolf Trackers have occupied Grey Rock Dock.
Mission_Node_Dem_GrayRockShipyard_Block_.text4: The Wolf Trackers occupying Grey Rock Dock were defeated.

Mission_Node_Dem_GrayRockQuarry_Block_St.title: Settled Dust
Mission_Node_Dem_GrayRockQuarry_Block_St.text3: The Wolf Trackers have occupied Grey Rock Quarry.
Mission_Node_Dem_GrayRockQuarry_Block_St.text4: The Wolf Trackers occupying Grey Rock Quarry were defeated.

Mission_ScorchrockCastle_Block_Start.title: Banished Flames
Mission_ScorchrockCastle_Block_Start.text3: The Flame Knights have occupied Scorchrock Castle.
Mission_ScorchrockCastle_Block_Start.text4: The Flame Knights who were occupying Scorchrock Castle were defeated.

Mission_NorthOutpost_Block_Start.title: Hunter's Veil
Mission_NorthOutpost_Block_Start.text3: The Wolf Trackers have occupied the northern outpost.
Mission_NorthOutpost_Block_Start.text4: The Wolf Trackers occupying the northern outpost were defeated.

Mission_EyeOfIce_Block_Start.title: The Frostwarden
Mission_EyeOfIce_Block_Start.text3: There is a drunk man causing a scene. Go take a look.
Mission_EyeOfIce_Block_Start.text4: After hearing the drunkard's tale, the journey to the Spire of Frost began. The Skull Knight was faced in a battle, and the specters of frost were summoned around the tower's perimeter. Upon reaching the summit, every stone lantern was lit, successfully purifying the Spire of Frost.

Mission_EyeOfIceAltar_Block_Start.title: Followers from Frost
Mission_EyeOfIceAltar_Block_Start.text3: Skull Knight followers have occupied Icewatch Altar.
Mission_EyeOfIceAltar_Block_Start.text4: Skull Knight followers occupying Icewatch Altar were defeated.

Mission_FrostFort_Block_Start.title: Where Followers Hail From
Mission_FrostFort_Block_Start.text3: Skull Knight followers have occupied Frosthold.
Mission_FrostFort_Block_Start.text4: Skull Knight followers occupying Frosthold were defeated.

Mission_FrostFort_Block_SubNode.title: Besieged Fort
Mission_FrostFort_Block_SubNode.text3: A band of Skull Knight followers have occupied the strongholds around Frosthold.
Mission_FrostFort_Block_SubNode.text4: The Skull Knight followers occupying the strongholds around Frosthold were defeated.

Mission_Flame_Knights_Block_Ask.title: Letter of Silence
Mission_Flame_Knights_Block_Ask.text3: Bastier's confidant, Tristan, holds a castle in the west of Demeniss. Defeat Tristan to shatter their unity.
Mission_Flame_Knights_Block_Ask.text4: Tristan was eliminated. The flames looming over the castle subsided, and Bastier's forces began to fracture.

Mission_Flame_Knights_Block_Reward.title: Greed in Ashes
Mission_Flame_Knights_Block_Reward.text3: Tristan was defeated. Search the castle to retrieve loot.
Mission_Flame_Knights_Block_Reward.text4: You secured Tristan's loot. The wealth he amassed will no longer serve as fuel for Bastier's flame.

Mission_Node_Neut_GoldenGoblinWineMaker_.title: Stolen Oven
Mission_Node_Neut_GoldenGoblinWineMaker_.text3: Gearmelt Confectionery has been occupied by the Helms. They've seized control of the workshop and are monopolizing the trading post. Drive them out and liberate the workshop.
Mission_Node_Neut_GoldenGoblinWineMaker_.text4: The Helms were driven out of Gearmelt Confectionery. The workshop can finally breathe again.

Mission_Node_Neut_GoldenGoblinWineMaker_.title: The Solitary Confectionery
Mission_Node_Neut_GoldenGoblinWineMaker_.text3: The Helms have seized control of the Gearmelt Trading Post.
Mission_Node_Neut_GoldenGoblinWineMaker_.text4: The Helms occupying the Gearmelt Trading Post were driven out.

Mission_GoldenGoblinBrewery_Normal_Recov.title: Restarting the Chocolate Factory
Mission_GoldenGoblinBrewery_Normal_Recov.text3: The factory machines have broken down, halting chocolate production. Get the plant back up and running.
Mission_GoldenGoblinBrewery_Normal_Recov.text4: The chocolate factory is back to properly operating now. The once-stalled sweet production process has resumed.

Mission_GoldenGoblinBrewery_Normal_Decor.title: Crafted Chocolate
Mission_GoldenGoblinBrewery_Normal_Decor.text3: Chocolates topped with syrup and toppings have been packaged, now showing off their delicious beauty.
Mission_GoldenGoblinBrewery_Normal_Decor.text4: The Chocolate born from the revived factory was an exquisite masterpiece crafted by Gearmelt's Skills.

Mission_GoldenGoblinBrewery_Normal_Rewar.title: Sweet Pack
Mission_GoldenGoblinBrewery_Normal_Rewar.text3: Looks like Gearmelt Confectionery Association has a special gift ready. Go check out the gift.
Mission_GoldenGoblinBrewery_Normal_Rewar.text4: The gift was the chocolate-making pack, the pinnacle of their technology. The sweet aroma will now never leave your back.

Mission_Node_Dem_NightExpeditionCamp_Blo.title: The Exposed Cliff
Mission_Node_Dem_NightExpeditionCamp_Blo.text3: The Righteous Inquisitors are conscripted at the Nightfell Expedition Camp.
Mission_Node_Dem_NightExpeditionCamp_Blo.text4: The Righteous Inquisitors conscripted at the Nightfell Expedition Camp were defeated.

Mission_SilvermoonHQ_Block_MeetingMercha.title: Shaded Silvermoon
Mission_SilvermoonHQ_Block_MeetingMercha.text3: A merchant is lost in deep worry. Ask what is troubling him.
Mission_SilvermoonHQ_Block_MeetingMercha.text4: The Silvermoon Trade Group is reportedly suffering heavy losses due to the high-handedness of the Inquisitors. The great magnate was also deeply troubled by this matter.

Mission_SilvermoonHQ_Block_MeetingNobles.title: A Desperate Hand
Mission_SilvermoonHQ_Block_MeetingNobles.text3: Meet the great magnate of the Silvermoon Trade Group and hear about the situation. The Inquisitors' tyranny is strangling the collective.
Mission_SilvermoonHQ_Block_MeetingNobles.text4: Brollam asked to drive out the Inquisitors, stating that their tyranny is worsening by the day. The Silvermoon Trade Group is reportedly at a point where they can no longer resist.

Mission_SilvermoonHQ_Block_DemenissMP.title: Gust Striking the Port
Mission_SilvermoonHQ_Block_DemenissMP.text3: Righteous Inquisitors have seized control of the Silvermoon Trade Group. Defeat the Raging Tempest attempting to subjugate the collective.
Mission_SilvermoonHQ_Block_DemenissMP.text4: The Raging Tempest, who sought to crush the Silvermoon Trade Group with overwhelming power, has been defeated. As the Inquisitors' grip loosened, the trade collective finally started to find some peace.

Mission_SilvermoonHQ_Block_MeetingNobles.title: A Promise Beyond the Shadows
Mission_SilvermoonHQ_Block_MeetingNobles.text3: Return to the great magnate and deliver the news that the Raging Tempest has been defeated. It is now time for the Silvermoon Trade Group's next decision.
Mission_SilvermoonHQ_Block_MeetingNobles.text4: The great magnate offered his thanks and pledged cooperation with the Greymanes. The Silvermoon Trade Group has gained the strength to resume trade once again.

Mission_SilvermoonHQ_Block_SubNode.title: Approaching Pressure at the Port
Mission_SilvermoonHQ_Block_SubNode.text3: Righteous Inquisitors are seizing control of the Silvermoon Trade Group's domain.
Mission_SilvermoonHQ_Block_SubNode.text4: The Righteous Inquisitor that controlled the area around the Silvermoon Trade Group was driven away. The pressure on the port has also eased significantly.

Mission_HuntersCabin_Block_Start.title: Torn Trade
Mission_HuntersCabin_Block_Start.text3: A merchant of the Silvermoon Trade Group lies injured in the Hunter's Cabin. Check their condition and hear what they have to say.
Mission_HuntersCabin_Block_Start.text4: The Silvermoon Trade Group merchant's wounds were treated. He gritted his teeth, claiming the Inquisitors' tyranny was even more vicious than a pack of bandits, and asked you to meet the great magnate, hoping the Greymanes could provide some help.

Mission_CaliburnClan_II_DemenissZoo_Boss.title: Corrupted Greymane
Mission_CaliburnClan_II_DemenissZoo_Boss.text3: The greatest archer of the Greymanes has defected. Now known as the Crimson Warden, she hunts humans like prey.
Mission_CaliburnClan_II_DemenissZoo_Boss.text4: The Crimson Warden has been slain. The corruption that defiled the honor of the Greymanes ends here.

Mission_KingMountainDigSite_Block_Boss.title: Beneath the Dig Site
Mission_KingMountainDigSite_Block_Boss.text3: An unidentified power stirs beneath the Kingshield Dig Site. Investigate the source of the awakening.
Mission_KingMountainDigSite_Block_Boss.text4: Kutum was defeated at the Kingshield Dig Site. The ominous thumping that echoed underground fell silent.

Mission_TheLaughingMarionette_Normal_Sec.title: Mysterious Messenger
Mission_TheLaughingMarionette_Normal_Sec.text3: Marshell's messenger brings news. Meet with him to receive information.
Mission_TheLaughingMarionette_Normal_Sec.text4: The messenger reported that the Lord Keg will be waiting for you at the circus tonight. You decided to go to confirm the truth yourself.

Mission_TheLaughingMarionette_Normal_Bos.title: Nightmare on Stage
Mission_TheLaughingMarionette_Normal_Bos.text3: Head to the circus at night to meet with Lord Keg to discover Countess Marshell's intentions.
Mission_TheLaughingMarionette_Normal_Bos.text4: Lord Keg was revealed to be a massive machine known as Keglord Garnier Mk. XXIII. You survived Countess Marshell's trap and defeated the construct.

Mission_TarivVillage_GuardianTree_Normal.title: Light of the Guardian Tree
Mission_TarivVillage_GuardianTree_Normal.text3: A sorcerer in Tariv looks troubled. Listen to what's on their mind.
Mission_TarivVillage_GuardianTree_Normal.text4: The light of the Guardian Tree protecting Tariv has disappeared. Traitors are trying to extinguish the light. They must be quickly stopped.

Mission_TarivVillage_GuardianTree_Normal.title: Fragment of Life
Mission_TarivVillage_GuardianTree_Normal.text3: Find the power to restore the light of the Guardian Tree from the Brothertree.
Mission_TarivVillage_GuardianTree_Normal.text4: The Fruit of Life was found from the Brothertree. The power within the fruit should be able to restore the light of the Guardian Tree.

Mission_TarivVillage_GuardianTree_Normal.title: Reawakened Light
Mission_TarivVillage_GuardianTree_Normal.text3: Revive the Guardian Tree with the power within the Fruit of Life to restore light to Tariv once more.
Mission_TarivVillage_GuardianTree_Normal.text4: Finally, the energy of light began to envelop the Guardian Tree once more. The sorcerers of Tariv breathed a sigh of relief, overwhelmed with emotion.

Mission_GateOfTruth_StoneGolem_Block_Anc.title: Secrets of the Ancient Ruins
Mission_GateOfTruth_StoneGolem_Block_Anc.text3: Observe the constellations at the Stones of Time and Sheltering Rocks, and reflect on what they mean. The results might be connected to the ruins of the Gate of Truth.
Mission_GateOfTruth_StoneGolem_Block_Anc.text4: As the flow of the constellations aligned, the seal binding the Gate of Truth began to break. Return to the ruins of the Gate of Truth to assess the situation.

Mission_GateOfTruth_StoneGolem_Block_Lig.title: Pillar of Light atop the Mountain
Mission_GateOfTruth_StoneGolem_Block_Lig.text3: As the seal broke, a massive pillar of light erupted from the summit of the Kingshield Mountains. Head toward the Gate of Truth and hold off the ruins' gatekeeper.
Mission_GateOfTruth_StoneGolem_Block_Lig.text4: Antiquum, the Stonewalker, the keeper of the Gate of Truth, has been defeated. Its massive, puppet-like movements have ceased, and silence has once again settled over the ruins.

Mission_GateOfTruth_StoneGolem_Block_Sub.title: Moving Rocks
Mission_GateOfTruth_StoneGolem_Block_Sub.text3: Walkers have occupied the rocks near the Gate of Truth.
Mission_GateOfTruth_StoneGolem_Block_Sub.text4: The walkers around the Gate of Truth have been defeated.

Mission_WindmereManor_HorseRace_Normal_S.title: Horse Fair Races
Mission_WindmereManor_HorseRace_Normal_S.text3: Many fine horses are on display at the horse fair.
Mission_WindmereManor_HorseRace_Normal_S.text4: A proud rider introduced his latest addition to his stable, before leading a spirited race around the course.

Mission_WindmereManor_Byron_FullPlateArm.title: A Secret Request
Mission_WindmereManor_Byron_FullPlateArm.text3: A cryptic note was found at the farm, signaling a secret task from Countess Azerian.
Mission_WindmereManor_Byron_FullPlateArm.text4: You reached Burnhand Quarry as instructed and liberated the site from Mazzul, the Dark Justiciar.

Mission_WindmereManor_Byron_FullPlateArm.title: One Step Ahead
Mission_WindmereManor_Byron_FullPlateArm.text3: Burnhand Quarry has been seized by Mazzul, the Dark Justiciar. Eliminate him before his reinforcements arrive.
Mission_WindmereManor_Byron_FullPlateArm.text4: Mazzul, the Dark Justiciar was defeated and the Burnhand Quarry was liberated.

Mission_WindmereManor_Byron_FullPlateArm.title: Crescent Lake
Mission_WindmereManor_Byron_FullPlateArm.text3: Countess Azerian's letter points toward Crescent Lake, where a hidden reward is waiting for you.
Mission_WindmereManor_Byron_FullPlateArm.text4: The reward left by Countess Azerian was recovered from Crescent Lake, completing her request.

Mission_BluemontManor_Rupert_Normal_Cont.title: First Trial of Trust
Mission_BluemontManor_Rupert_Normal_Cont.text3: A despondent figure stands near Bluemont Manor. Listen to their story and offer assistance.
Mission_BluemontManor_Rupert_Normal_Cont.text4: The Bleed Bandits cast a shadow over the Roberts Estate. You passed a small test and gained a clue to reach the count.

Mission_BluemontManor_Rupert_Normal_Quar.title: Troubled Count
Mission_BluemontManor_Rupert_Normal_Quar.text3: The cask house has been reclaimed. Meet Count Roberts to discuss the situation.
Mission_BluemontManor_Rupert_Normal_Quar.text4: The Bleed Bandits continue to occupy other parts of the Roberts estate. The count requested your help in reclaiming Karin Quarry.

Mission_BluemontManor_Rupert_Normal_Kari.title: Stolen Quarry
Mission_BluemontManor_Rupert_Normal_Kari.text3: The Bleed Bandits are occupying Karin Quarry. Drive them out and reclaim the site.
Mission_BluemontManor_Rupert_Normal_Kari.text4: The Bleed Bandits were driven out and the quarry was reclaimed. Investigation of the inner quarry is now possible.

Mission_BluemontManor_Rupert_Normal_Reli.title: Sealed in Stone
Mission_BluemontManor_Rupert_Normal_Reli.text3: Investigate the commotion at the crane.
Mission_BluemontManor_Rupert_Normal_Reli.text4: You operated the massive crane at Erich's request and removed the relic that was sealed in stone at the quarry's center.

Mission_BluemontManor_Rupert_Normal_Trus.title: The Count's Honor
Mission_BluemontManor_Rupert_Normal_Trus.text3: The troubles at Karin Quarry are settled. Return to Count Roberts with the news.
Mission_BluemontManor_Rupert_Normal_Trus.text4: The Count expressed his deep gratitude and presented a gift. His estate, once in mayhem, finally found room to breathe.

Mission_BluemontWineHouse_PervinFort_Blo.title: Strange Red Smoke
Mission_BluemontWineHouse_PervinFort_Blo.text3: Another concern arises for House Roberts. Investigate the silence from Fort Perwin.
Mission_BluemontWineHouse_PervinFort_Blo.text4: The Bleed Bandits occupying Fort Perwin were manufacturing a suspicious medicine. Count Roberts decided to further investigate the source of the red smoke himself.

Mission_Node_Her_PervinFort_Block_Boss.title: The Crimson Nightmare
Mission_Node_Her_PervinFort_Block_Boss.text3: An unknown red smoke is rising from Fort Perwin. Find out what's happening inside.
Mission_Node_Her_PervinFort_Block_Boss.text4: The monster made of swirling smoke, the Crimson Nightmare, was slain. The ominous aura of the red smoke that spread through the fort began to dissipate.

Mission_Node_Her_PervinFort_Block_SubNod.title: Veil of Red Smoke
Mission_Node_Her_PervinFort_Block_SubNod.text3: An unknown red smoke is rising from Fort Perwin.
Mission_Node_Her_PervinFort_Block_SubNod.text4: The Bleed Bandits, who had taken control around Fort Perwin, were driven away. The ominous aura of the red smoke that had spread through the area has begun to dissipate.

Mission_BluemontWineHouse_PervinFort_Com.title: Dissipated Smoke
Mission_BluemontWineHouse_PervinFort_Com.text3: Fort Perwin has been reclaimed. Return to the count with the news.
Mission_BluemontWineHouse_PervinFort_Com.text4: The count's relief at retaking the fort was tempered by his growing concern for the suspicious medicine discovered there.

Mission_MuckrootRanch_Artifact_Ing.title: Shorthanded
Mission_MuckrootRanch_Artifact_Ing.text3: A noble plans to renovate Bremer's house in an attempt to impress Duke Celeste. He is seeking manpower for the project.
Mission_MuckrootRanch_Artifact_Ing.text4: You assisted with rebuilding Bremer's house, leaving his home looking as good as new.

Mission_Her_RuinedChapel_Block_Start.title: Mysterious Arrow
Mission_Her_RuinedChapel_Block_Start.text3: A mysterious note was tied to an arrow that flew in from out of nowhere.
Mission_Her_RuinedChapel_Block_Start.text4: The note contained a message instructing you to visit the ruined chapel in southern Hernand.

Mission_Her_RuinedChapel_Block_Complete.title: Bloodied Sanctum
Mission_Her_RuinedChapel_Block_Complete.text3: Fundamentalist Goblins following Sizlek have gathered in the Ruined Chapel.
Mission_Her_RuinedChapel_Block_Complete.text4: Sizlek, the leader of the Fundamentalist Goblins who was occupying the ruined chapel, was defeated.

Mission_Node_Her_FortAnvil_Surround.title: Loop of Siege
Mission_Node_Her_FortAnvil_Surround.text3: A commander who has gone through many hardships is keeping watch at Fort Anvil, the outpost of the Bleed Bandits.
Mission_Node_Her_FortAnvil_Surround.text4: The momentum of the Bleed Bandits broke once their commander fell. The siege loosened, and Fort Anvil began to find its footing again.

Mission_HellwoodSlaveCamp_Block_Start.title: Remaining Chains
Mission_HellwoodSlaveCamp_Block_Start.text3: A slave who escaped from the camp is bound and encircled. Save him and find out what is happening.
Mission_HellwoodSlaveCamp_Block_Start.text4: The Bleed Bandits occupying Rocca's Hill Slave Camp were defeated. The camp was liberated, and so were the slaves inside.

Mission_FortHellwood_HamondBindel_Start.title: The Rabid Hound of Hellwood
Mission_FortHellwood_HamondBindel_Start.text3: Defeat the group occupying Fort Hellwood and restore peace.
Mission_FortHellwood_HamondBindel_Start.text4: The Hellhounds and their leader Hemon Beindel, who were occupying Fort Hellwood, were defeated. The terror they inflicted faded, and the fort found its peace once again.

Mission_FortHellwood_HamondBindel_Gate.title: Hound's Gate
Mission_FortHellwood_HamondBindel_Gate.text3: The path to Fort Hellwood has been seized by the Hellhounds.
Mission_FortHellwood_HamondBindel_Gate.text4: The Hellhounds guarding the gate were driven away.

Mission_Node_Her_Ruffians_Surround.title: Piercing Spear
Mission_Node_Her_Ruffians_Surround.text3: Fort Warspike and its surrounding strongholds have been occupied by the Bleed Bandits. Defeat the Bleed Bandits and reclaim the area to liberate the fort.
Mission_Node_Her_Ruffians_Surround.text4: The Bleed Bandits occupying Fort Warspike and the surrounding strongholds were defeated. The siege on the fort was broken, and the path to liberation was opened.

Mission_Node_Her_Ruffians_Surround_SubNo.title: The Crimson-Stained Speartip
Mission_Node_Her_Ruffians_Surround_SubNo.text3: The Bleed Bandits have occupied the strongholds near Fort Warspike.
Mission_Node_Her_Ruffians_Surround_SubNo.text4: The strongholds occupied by the Bleed Bandits near Fort Warspike were liberated.

Mission_WindHillFactory_Block_Start.title: A Dwarf's Concern
Mission_WindHillFactory_Block_Start.text3: In front of the wrecked cloudcart, the dwarves stand with faces clouded by concern. It seems best to approach and find out what's going on.
Mission_WindHillFactory_Block_Start.text4: A smile bloomed at the tip of the artisan's beard, and soon he began crafting a cloudcart that would soar into the sky.

Mission_WindHillFactory_Block_Fly.title: Wagon in the Skies
Mission_WindHillFactory_Block_Fly.text3: The craftsman has offered a ride on his cloudcart as a gesture of thanks. Visit the craftsman, as the cloudcart appears to be complete.
Mission_WindHillFactory_Block_Fly.text4: The cloudcart ascended into the skies, revealing a vast world.

Mission_GlenbrightManor_Grace_Block_Star.title: The Whereabouts of the New Lord
Mission_GlenbrightManor_Grace_Block_Star.text3: The owner of Grace Estate has changed since the Reed Devil incident. Go meet the new lord.
Mission_GlenbrightManor_Grace_Block_Star.text4: Count Grace's servant has requested for the new count to be found, as the count is somewhere inside the manor but cannot be found.

Mission_GlenbrightManor_Grace_Block_NewO.title: The Lord Who Hid in the Manor
Mission_GlenbrightManor_Grace_Block_NewO.text3: Cedric Grace, new lord of the Grace Estate, remains holed up inside the manor. Search for Cedric Grace inside the manor.
Mission_GlenbrightManor_Grace_Block_NewO.text4: Although the estate was regaining stability after the incident, the new lord cowered in the basement, gripped by fear. Rather than tending to the people and restoring order, he hid away to protect himself, a sight that stirred deep frustration among the onlookers.

Mission_FlowerDustBeeFarm_Normal_Start.title: Scattered Honey Jars
Mission_FlowerDustBeeFarm_Normal_Start.text3: It seems there's been some trouble at the apiary in Grace Estate, which had just begun to recover.
Mission_FlowerDustBeeFarm_Normal_Start.text4: The culprit disturbing and raiding the apiary was a massive bear. After defeating the beast that was terrorizing the villagers, peace was restored.

Mission_GoldleafGuildhouse_Purge_Normal_.title: Troubled Shakatu
Mission_GoldleafGuildhouse_Purge_Normal_.text3: Shakatu has been troubled lately over matters concerning the guild.
Mission_GoldleafGuildhouse_Purge_Normal_.text4: It seems that there are followers of the former branchmaster still within the guild.

Mission_GoldleafGuildhouse_Purge_Normal_.title: Nogle, the Trade Manager
Mission_GoldleafGuildhouse_Purge_Normal_.text3: Find evidence that confirms the activities of Nogle, the trade manager.
Mission_GoldleafGuildhouse_Purge_Normal_.text4: You found evidence confirming Nogle's activities.

Mission_GoldleafGuildhouse_Purge_Normal_.title: Skrav, the Trade Manager
Mission_GoldleafGuildhouse_Purge_Normal_.text3: Find evidence that confirms the activities of Skrav, the trade manager.
Mission_GoldleafGuildhouse_Purge_Normal_.text4: You found evidence confirming Skrav's activities.

Mission_GoldleafGuildhouse_Purge_Normal_.title: Kathan, the Goldleaf Private Soldier
Mission_GoldleafGuildhouse_Purge_Normal_.text3: Find evidence that confirms the activities of Kathan, the Goldleaf private soldier.
Mission_GoldleafGuildhouse_Purge_Normal_.text4: You found evidence confirming Kathan's activities.

Mission_GoldleafGuildhouse_Purge_Normal_.title: Blique, the Horse Manager
Mission_GoldleafGuildhouse_Purge_Normal_.text3: Find evidence that confirms the activities of Blique, the horse manager.
Mission_GoldleafGuildhouse_Purge_Normal_.text4: You found evidence confirming Blique's activities.

Mission_GoldleafGuildhouse_Purge_Normal_.title: Grimzle, the Ledger Manager
Mission_GoldleafGuildhouse_Purge_Normal_.text3: Find evidence that confirms the activities of Grimzle, the ledger manager.
Mission_GoldleafGuildhouse_Purge_Normal_.text4: You found evidence confirming Grimzle's activities.

Mission_GoldleafGuildhouse_Purge_Normal_.title: Close Threat
Mission_GoldleafGuildhouse_Purge_Normal_.text3: You've heard all the stories from the Goldleaf Merchant Guild. Now, it's time to deduce who the traitor is.
Mission_GoldleafGuildhouse_Purge_Normal_.text4: The suspects were investigated and evidence confirming their activities was secured. With it, the merchant guild's traitor was found.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_RescueRefu.title: Rescuing the Pailunese Refugees
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_RescueRefu.text3: Pailune has been reduced to ashes, and countless Pailunese have been taken captive and scattered across Pywel. Find as many of the scattered refugees as possible and take them to a safe location.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_PetGuide.title: The Nag and the Stubborn One
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_PetGuide.text3:
Andrew and Naira are arguing again.
See what the argument is about.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_PetGuide.text4: Naira wanted to take in the dog she saw in town that had lost its owner, but Andrew was dead set against it, insisting they couldn't handle the responsibility. Eventually, she stormed off toward Hernand, claiming she had to run an errand for Carl. Follow her.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_PetGuide_M.title: A Chunk of Meat
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_PetGuide_M.text3: Buy meat and join Naira at the town gate.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_PetGuide_M.text4: Meat was purchased and Naira was met at the town gate. She looked on bitterly, noting how the dog wagged its tail the moment she tossed it a piece of meat.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_PetGuide_D.title: Fang Without a Master
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_PetGuide_D.text3: The dog that lost its owner is still there. If you are planning on taking it in, now is the time.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_PetGuide_D.text4: The dog that lost its owner was brought in. It can sense enemies and bark, making it the perfect new "fang."

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_WagonTheft.title: Letter at the Shrine
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_WagonTheft.text3:
The camp is quieter than usual.
Yann, who is always loud, is nowhere to be seen.
Read the letter at the shrine.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_WagonTheft.text4: The letter was left behind by Yann. You should go to the place he mentioned in the letter before he causes trouble.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_WagonTheft.title: Running Loot
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_WagonTheft.text3: Yann might be causing trouble again. Go to the location written in the letter.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_WagonTheft.text4: Yann's plan seemed to be going smoothly for once. However, the bandits had already noticed and moved any valuables from the wagon.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_WagonTheft.title: Empty Wagon
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_WagonTheft.text3: Yann mentioned a merchant willing to buy even questionable wagons. Sell the wagon to the fence to raise some funds.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_WagonTheft.text4: Nothing inside was worth any coin. In the end, the only option was to sell the wagon.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Dyeing_Sta.title: Gloomy Gray
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Dyeing_Sta.text3:
Andrew and Naira are arguing again.
See what the argument is about.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Dyeing_Sta.text4: Naira complained that the camp is far too drab and suggested brightening things up with some colorful clothes. She handed over the materials for a dye recipe she discovered and asked to have them mixed in the cauldron.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Dyeing_Pla.title: Vibrant Dye
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Dyeing_Pla.text3: A dye can be crafted using the materials provided by Naira. Mix the ingredients in the cauldron to produce a vibrant color.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Dyeing_Pla.text4: The dye has been created by mixing the materials. Everything is now ready to color the clothes.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Dyeing_Com.title: A Fresh Color
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Dyeing_Com.text3: Return to Naira and report that the dye is ready. Then, talk about creating other colors.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Dyeing_Com.text4: Naira was impressed, saying that the quality was much better than expected. She mentioned that other colors can be crafted as long as there are flowers and insects available, and asked to see the final results of the dye later.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Seotda_Sta.title: Shattered Charmed Life
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Seotda_Sta.text3: Yann sits in total despair, looking completely shocked. Listen to what happened.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Seotda_Sta.text4: Yann ground his teeth angrily, claiming to have been cheated at the gambling den. Determined to catch the crook, he asked for help. Go there and survey the situation.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Seotda_Pla.title: A Move on the Table
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Seotda_Pla.text3: Enter the gambling den as Yann suggested and observe the game. Keep a sharp eye out for any suspicious movements.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Seotda_Pla.text4: The swindler Yann mentioned was nowhere to be found today. Instead, the game concluded without trouble, leaving a bit of coin.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Seotda_Com.title: Liquor and Memories
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Seotda_Com.text3: Return to Yann to deliver the news. He will open up about what is truly on his mind.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Seotda_Com.text4: Though disappointed at missing the swindler, Yann decided to use the winnings as an excuse to drink. What he really longed for wasn't money, but the company and shared memories.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_EquipmentC.title: Trembling Hands
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_EquipmentC.text3: The children at the camp are begging for a bow. Go and find out why Andrew and Duane are arguing.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_EquipmentC.text4: Andrew hesitated to put weapons into the children's hands due to a past accident. However, deciding that teaching proper safety was better than a total ban, he requested that you craft a bow designed for the young ones.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_EquipmentC.title: White Wood Bow
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_EquipmentC.text3: The children need a white wood bow. Follow Andrew's instructions at the smithy to craft the bow.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_EquipmentC.text4: The white wood bow is complete. The size and weight have been adjusted to ensure the children do not get hurt.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_EquipmentC.title: The New Archers
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_EquipmentC.text3: Hand over the white wood bow to Andrew. This will mark the children's first steps.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_EquipmentC.text4: The white wood bow was delivered to Andrew. He expressed satisfaction with the perfect size and weight, stating that he and Naira will teach the children properly.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Wanted.title: Face on the Bounty Notice
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Wanted.text3: Yann has been pacing in front of the bounty notice for quite some time. Approach and listen to what is going on.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Wanted.text4: Yann gnashed his teeth, saying that the man on the bounty notice was the one he saw at the "House of Healing." He said that capturing the criminal would bring a hefty reward and insisted on tracking him down.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Wanted_Mon.title: Plenty of Bounty
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Wanted_Mon.text3: Locate and catch the outlaw Yann mentioned. Capture and turn in the outlaw to the constabulary to receive the bounty.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Wanted_Mon.text4: The outlaw was captured and turned in to the constabulary. Upon receiving the promised bounty, Yann's words proved true, bringing a sense of satisfaction.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Felling.title: The Cost of the Tab
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Felling.text3: Yann and Naira are stumbling around, completely plastered in alcohol. Listen to what kind of trouble they caused.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Felling.text4: The two ran up a massive bar tab, so Marius made them gather firewood. Yann handed over an axe and suggested doing some logging together.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Felling_Ax.title: Logging Without an Axe
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Felling_Ax.text3: Head to the forest with an axe to gather timber. The firewood must be collected before returning to the camp.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Felling_Ax.text4: You gathered timber and brought it back to the camp. Yann slipped away halfway through and vanished, leading Marius to sigh and assume he'd gone off to drink again.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_HorseRace.title: Quarrel on Horseback
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_HorseRace.text3: Duane and Naira are bickering over horses. Go and find out what is happening.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_HorseRace.text4: Duane mocked you for being a poor rider. It soon turned into a battle of pride, and you agreed to settle it with a horse race.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_HorseRace_.title: Showdown in the Saddles
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_HorseRace_.text3: Compete against Duane in a horse racing match. Do not get distracted by his taunt and keep riding until the end.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_HorseRace_.text4: The race against Duane concluded, he made excuses about a loose saddle and demanded a rematch.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Trade_Star.title: Scent of Gold
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Trade_Star.text3: Yann is making a fuss over a chance to make a fortune. Hear him out and find out what he's plotting.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Trade_Star.text4: Yann mentioned that a merchant frequenting the Goldleaf Merchant Guild suddenly became rich, which seemed suspicious. He said he would use this "mark" himself after you bring a wagon.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Trade_Guid.title: Wagon Stuck in the Mud
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Trade_Guid.text3: The merchant pointed out by Yann got the wagon stuck in the mud. Approach and help pull it out.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Trade_Guid.text4: After the wagon was freed, the merchant said that he was in a hurry for a delivery. Yann managed to dig up information that he's taking “pepper” to Demeniss.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Trade_Play.title: A Sack of Pepper
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Trade_Play.text3: Buy black pepper from the Goldleaf Merchant Guild. As Yann suggested, selling it in Demeniss might lead to a fortune.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Trade_Play.text4: Purchased the pepper and transported to the Demeniss branch. The trade was completed, and the profit was secured.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Trade_Comp.title: Gold Made from Black Pepper
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Trade_Comp.text3: A profit was made by selling black pepper in Demeniss. Talk to Yann.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Trade_Comp.text4: Yann, thrilled by the juicy profits, boasted about his own business savvy. Dreaming of becoming rich after just a few more deals, he was already plotting the next venture.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Cook.title: Naira the Gourmand
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Cook.text3: Naira and Andrew are fussing over meat stew. Find out what's going on.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Cook.text4: Naira complained about wanting to eat traditional Pailunese meat stew. It was decided to buy the ingredients and make it, so you went to town with her.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Cook_Ing.title: Ingredients for One Bowl
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Cook_Ing.text3: Ingredients are needed to make meat soup. Gather them from the grocer's shop and butchery.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Cook_Ing.text4: All ingredients for the meat soup are ready, head back to the camp and start cooking.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Cook_End.title: A Bowl of Rich Broth
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Cook_End.text3: All the ingredients are ready. Cook the meat soup and hand it to Naira.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Cook_End.text4: Naira's birthday was celebrated with meat soup.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Fishing_Pl.title: Gentle Sound of Flowing River
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Fishing_Pl.text3: Oongka was waiting by the riverside. He mentioned that Ronnie requested some fish and suggested a fishing bet.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Fishing_Pl.text4: After finishing the match, Oongka said the calm sound of the water helps settle the mind, and that everyone needs somewhere they can return to.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_RoyalSuppl.title: Urgent News
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_RoyalSuppl.text3: Yann is making a fuss again. Find out what's happening.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_RoyalSuppl.text4: Yann said Hernand Castle is buying trade goods for a high price and insisted on leaving at once. Get a wagon and head straight to the Goldleaf Merchant Guild.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_RoyalSuppl.title: Sweet Deal
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_RoyalSuppl.text3: Head to the Goldleaf Merchant Guild by wagon. Buy as much honey as possible, then deliver and sell it to Hernand Castle.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_RoyalSuppl.text4: Honey was purchased from the Goldleaf Merchant Guild and delivered to Hernand Castle. As Yann said, it was a business where speed equaled money.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Armwrestli.title: Arm Wrestling Tips
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Armwrestli.text3: Oongka is observing the new recruits. Go speak with him.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Armwrestli.text4: Oongka planned to have the recruits arm-wrestle one another to test their mettle. He suggested taking them on yourself at the tavern, and even offered advice on how to properly balance one's strength.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Armwrestli.title: How to Distribute Strength
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Armwrestli.text3: Compete against the soldiers at the tavern in arm wrestling.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Armwrestli.text4: The skills of the soldiers were verified personally through arm wrestling. Oongka considered facing the remaining recruits himself but stepped back to just watch, worrying that people might run away.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_ScoutFromMariusLv2_.title: News of Comrades
Mission_GreymaneCamp_ScoutFromMariusLv2_.text3: Marius has important word about your comrades.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_ScoutFromMariusLv2_.text4: Marius shared rumors of potential Greymanes being spotted.

Graymane_Scout_Group_XIV.title: A Rumor at Hills of No Return
Graymane_Scout_Group_XIV.text3: Rumor has it that a group of Greymanes have gathered at Hills of No Return.
Graymane_Scout_Group_XIV.text4: You reunited with Otto, Silvan, Aldric, and Fritz at Hills of No Return.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_ScoutFromMariusLv2_.title: New Information
Mission_GreymaneCamp_ScoutFromMariusLv2_.text3: According to Marius, there's been a progress in the search for the other Greymanes.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_ScoutFromMariusLv2_.text4: Marius shared rumors of potential Greymanes being spotted.

Graymane_Scout_Group_II.title: A Rumor at Glenbright Farm
Graymane_Scout_Group_II.text3: Rumor has it that a cook near Glenbright Farm used to be a Greymane.
Graymane_Scout_Group_II.text4: You reunited with Ronnie, Tranan, and Brice at the farm.

Graymane_GetCampRes_Lv2.title: Secure Resources
Graymane_GetCampRes_Lv2.text3: More resources are needed to gather more comrades and expand forces.
Graymane_GetCampRes_Lv2.text4: Timber and stone were secured through logging and quarry missions.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Luke.title: Luke's Request
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Luke.text3: Luke asked to place a flower basket in the old house on the hill to get rid of the smell so he could use it as lodging.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Luke.text4: After the old house was decorated, Luke appeared satisfied, stating it was now ready to serve as lodging.

Graymane_ExpandCamp_Lv2.title: Expanding the Camp
Graymane_ExpandCamp_Lv2.text3: The camp must be expanded to gather more comrades and expand forces.
Graymane_ExpandCamp_Lv2.text4: The camp was expanded successfully. More comrades can be gathered at the camp, and forces can be strengthened.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_ScoutFromMariusLv3_.title: News of Comrades
Mission_GreymaneCamp_ScoutFromMariusLv3_.text3: Marius has important word about your comrades.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_ScoutFromMariusLv3_.text4: Marius shared rumors of potential Greymanes being spotted.

Graymane_Scout_Group_VIII.title: A Rumor at Hook Rapids
Graymane_Scout_Group_VIII.text3: Rumor has it that a group of Greymanes are gathered at Hook Rapids.
Graymane_Scout_Group_VIII.text4: You reunited with Balder and Ryan at Hook Rapids.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_ScoutFromMariusLv3_.title: New Information
Mission_GreymaneCamp_ScoutFromMariusLv3_.text3: Marius has news of your comrades.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_ScoutFromMariusLv3_.text4: Marius shared rumors of potential Greymanes being spotted.

Graymane_Scout_Group_V.title: A Rumor at the Goldleaf Trading Post
Graymane_Scout_Group_V.text3: Rumors has it that a group of Greymanes at the Goldleaf Trading Post are trying to sell something.
Graymane_Scout_Group_V.text4: You reunited with Conrad, Wynstan, Kamu, Alec, Ed, and Ben at the Goldleaf Trading Post.

Graymane_GetCampRes_Lv3.title: Secure Resources
Graymane_GetCampRes_Lv3.text3: More resources are needed to gather more comrades and expand forces.
Graymane_GetCampRes_Lv3.text4: Weapons were secured through a weapon crafting mission.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_BuildFarm_Expand.title: Land of Dreams
Mission_GreymaneCamp_BuildFarm_Expand.text3: Kamu is looking at the barren land. Something seems to be on his mind.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_BuildFarm_Expand.text4: A farm was established in the camp, with hopes for the day its fields turn golden.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Kamu.title: Kamu's Request
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Kamu.text3: Kamu asked to plant a seed and harvest its fruit to better understand the challenges some comrades face during cultivation.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Kamu.text4: You delivered the fruit that you personally cultivated to Kamu. After hearing the account of the process, Kamu appeared to devise an improved method for instructing the comrades.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_BuildRanch_Expand.title: Field of Abundance
Mission_GreymaneCamp_BuildRanch_Expand.text3: Ben is looking over the lush field as if he's made up his mind.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_BuildRanch_Expand.text4: A ranch was built at the camp, with hopes of getting many livestock in there.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Ben.title: Ben's Request
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Ben.text3: Ben says he has a request to fill the newly built ranch with tamed animals.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Ben.text4: Wild animals were caught, penned, and taken to the butchery at Ben's request. Though it was an unpleasant task, it had to be done, and as a result, there was dinner for everyone at the camp table.

Graymane_ExpandCamp_Lv3.title: Expanding the Camp
Graymane_ExpandCamp_Lv3.text3: The camp must be expanded to gather more comrades and expand forces.
Graymane_ExpandCamp_Lv3.text4: The camp was expanded successfully. More comrades can be gathered at the camp, and forces can be strengthened.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_ScoutFromMariusLv4_.title: News of Comrades
Mission_GreymaneCamp_ScoutFromMariusLv4_.text3: Marius has important news of your comrades.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_ScoutFromMariusLv4_.text4: Marius shared rumors of potential Greymanes being spotted.

Graymane_Scout_Group_XIII.title: The Greymanes' Cabin
Graymane_Scout_Group_XIII.text3: Marius believes some of the comrades may be at the cabin where they last gathered at, and wants you to pay it a visit.
Graymane_Scout_Group_XIII.text4: You reunited with Morrow, Xavier, Gilbert, Max, and Brennan at the cabin at Hills of No Return.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_ScoutFromMariusLv4_.title: New Information
Mission_GreymaneCamp_ScoutFromMariusLv4_.text3: Marius has news of your comrades.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_ScoutFromMariusLv4_.text4: Marius shared rumors of potential Greymanes being spotted.

Graymane_Scout_Group_XI.title: A Rumor at the Inksworth Bindery
Graymane_Scout_Group_XI.text3: Rumor has it that Greymanes have been seen at the waterfall by the Inksworth Bindery.
Graymane_Scout_Group_XI.text4: You reunited with Connor, Oliver, and Eric at the waterfall overlooking Howling Hill.

Graymane_GetCampRes_Lv4.title: Secure Resources
Graymane_GetCampRes_Lv4.text3: More resources are needed to gather more comrades and expand forces.
Graymane_GetCampRes_Lv4.text4: Camp funds were secured through a guard mission.

Graymane_ExpandCamp_Lv4.title: Expanding the Camp
Graymane_ExpandCamp_Lv4.text3: The camp must be expanded to gather more comrades and expand forces.
Graymane_ExpandCamp_Lv4.text4: The camp was expanded successfully. More comrades can be gathered at the camp, and forces can be strengthened.

Graymane_Scout_Group_III.title: A Rumor in Ivynook
Graymane_Scout_Group_III.text3: They say there are Greymanes who took care of the troublesome vines.
Graymane_Scout_Group_III.text4: You reunited with Evelyn, Pierce, and Devan.

Graymane_Scout_Group_VI.title: A Rumor in St. Halssius
Graymane_Scout_Group_VI.text3: There's a rumor that Greymanes have gathered at a cabin near St. Halssius.
Graymane_Scout_Group_VI.text4: You reunited with Colton, Arnold, Fred at the cabin near St. Halssius.

Graymane_Scout_Group_VII.title: A Rumor in the Southern Quarry
Graymane_Scout_Group_VII.text3: There's a rumor that Greymanes are planning a ritual in a village near Southern Quarry.
Graymane_Scout_Group_VII.text4: You reunited with Laurent, Kenneth, Wybert, and Ashton.

Graymane_Scout_Group_IX.title: A Rumor in Pollengarth Apiary
Graymane_Scout_Group_IX.text3: There's a rumor that Greymanes have gathered at Pollengarth Apiary.
Graymane_Scout_Group_IX.text4: You reunited with Lucius and Matilda at Pollengarth Apiary.

Graymane_Scout_Group_X.title: A Rumor in Calphade
Graymane_Scout_Group_X.text3: There's a rumor that Greymanes have gathered at a hill overlooking Calphade.
Graymane_Scout_Group_X.text4: You reunited with Duncan, Falstaff, Anders, Luther, and Terry at the hill overlooking Calphade.

Graymane_Scout_Diederik.title: A Familiar Voice at the Redfox Trading Post
Graymane_Scout_Diederik.text3: Rumor has it that someone is singing ballads of the Greymanes near the Redfox Trading Post.
Graymane_Scout_Diederik.text4: You reunited with Diederik at the Redfox Trading Post.

Graymane_Scout_Group_XII.title: A Rumor in the Calphade Gate
Graymane_Scout_Group_XII.text3: Word is that Greymanes have been spotted at the Calphade gate.
Graymane_Scout_Group_XII.text4: You reunited with Lars, Joseph, Vernon, and Gerald at the Hunter's Cabin.

Graymane_Scout_Group_IV.title: A Rumor in Arboria Craftshop
Graymane_Scout_Group_IV.text3: They say there are Greymanes eliminating bandits.
Graymane_Scout_Group_IV.text4: You reunited with Niall, Joan, and Brant.

Mission_GreymaneCampMoney_Donation.title: Well-Stocked Coffers
Mission_GreymaneCampMoney_Donation.text3: For a better future with comrades, contribute extra funds to Carl, who manages the camp's supplies.
Mission_GreymaneCampMoney_Donation.text4: The camp's funds have been filled to a comfortable level. For a while, worries about coin can be set aside while looking ahead with hope.

Mission_GreymaneCampFood_Donation.title: A Bountiful Table
Mission_GreymaneCampFood_Donation.text3: To keep hunger at bay, deliver ample provisions to Carl, who manages the camp's supplies.
Mission_GreymaneCampFood_Donation.text4: The camp's food stores have been fully stocked. Now all that remains is for comrades gathered by the campfire to enjoy a hearty evening meal.

Mission_GreymaneCampWood_Donation.title: Sturdy Support
Mission_GreymaneCampWood_Donation.text3: Deliver timber to Carl, who manages the camp's supplies so the Greymanes will not waver under external danger in the future.
Mission_GreymaneCampWood_Donation.text4: Sufficient camp timber has been secured. No danger from beyond will easily shake the peace of the days ahead.

Mission_GreymaneCampStone_Donation.title: A Firm Foundation
Mission_GreymaneCampStone_Donation.text3: To make the road ahead safer, deliver stone to Carl, who manages the camp's supplies.
Mission_GreymaneCampStone_Donation.text4: The camp's stone supplies have been gathered without missing a piece. Even in the face of any threat, safety and peace can be maintained.

Mission_GreymaneCampWeapon_Donation.title: Reliable Arms
Mission_GreymaneCampWeapon_Donation.text3: For victory in battle, deliver spare equipment to Carl, who manages the camp's supplies.
Mission_GreymaneCampWeapon_Donation.text4: The camp's weapons are fully prepared. Now the keen steel in comrades' hands will stand firm, protecting one another from outside threats.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Carl.title: Carl's Request
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Carl.text3: The storagekeeper Carl suggested delivering surplus leather to the tannery as an opportunity to build trust.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Carl.text4: The leather was delivered to the tannery. It was a small gesture, but strengthened trust with the villagers.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Ronnie.title: Ronnie's Request
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Ronnie.text3: Ronnie, the cook, is preparing a feast to boost the camp's morale and has asked for help in getting more meat.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Ronnie.text4: The meat was delivered to Ronnie. Tonight, the camp will be filled with laughter and the scent of delicious food will linger for the first time in a long while.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Russo.title: Ross's Request
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Russo.text3: Ross, the dispatch coordinator, has heard rumors that bandits frequently raid the apothecary and has requested an investigation and aid.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Russo.text4: The apothecary was informed of the situation and assured of assistance. As trust begins to grow, greater requests are expected to come.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Tranan.title: Tranan's Request
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Tranan.text3: Tranan, the equipment merchant, asked to obtain a sword made by the renowned blacksmith of Hernand Castle.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Tranan.text4: The sword was delivered to Tranan, who admired its craftsmanship, remarked on the lessons it could offer, and expressed his gratitude.
