Mission_GreymaneCamp_Brice.title: Brice's Request
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Brice.text3: Brice, the wagonmaster, needs someone to visit Timberturner Wainwright and seek advice on materials and construction for making a wagon that can last a long time.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Brice.text4: A new wagon was crafted at the Timberturner Wainwright. Brice smiled with satisfaction, saying the depot can now function properly.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Martin.title: Wynstan's Request
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Martin.text3: Wynstan, the consumable craftsman, requested a proposal for a direct trade with the Goldleaf Merchant Guild to address the issue of costly, low-quality materials.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Martin.text4: A direct trade was proposed to the Goldleaf Merchant Guild, which they accepted. From this point onward, quality materials will be supplied with consistency.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Ethan.title: Conrad's Request
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Ethan.text3: Conrad, the furniture craftsman, believes that good rest before battle is important and asked to get the crafting secrets for making the best bed from a scholar at the Scholastone Institute.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Ethan.text4: The skill to craft a comfortable bed learned from a scholar of Scholastone was passed onto him. Using this knowledge, Conrad vowed to create a masterpiece that would allow all to rest in comfort.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Alec.title: Alec's Request
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Alec.text3: Alec, the blacksmith, wanting to apologize for recently refusing Ronnie the cook's request, has asked for a fresh fish so he could grill it himself.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Alec.text4: Fresh fish was delivered to Alec. He intends to grill it for Ronnie as an apology and vowed to be more flexible in the future.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Diederik.title: Diederik's Request
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Diederik.text3: Diederik asked to deliver the mended clothes to the monastery for neighbors in need.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Diederik.text4: The clothes were delivered to the monastery for Diederik, who then showed an evident expression of warm joy.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Eric.title: Eric's Request
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Eric.text3: Eric wants to visit the village where the sick are staying and tend to their hair, and asked to convey his intention to the village healer.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Eric.text4: Word of Eric's proposal was delivered to the village. Eric seemed to be full of joy after hearing the news.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Connor.title: Connor's Request
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Connor.text3: Connor wants to contribute to the camp funds by crafting and selling accessories, and asked help on gathering minerals for making a sample piece.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Connor.text4: The minerals for jewelcrafting were delivered to Connor. With a satisfied expression, he said he could craft an exceptional piece and promised to show it to you before anyone else once completed.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Oliver.title: Oliver's Request
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Oliver.text3: Oliver wanted to create a special fabric infused not only with color but also with fragrance, and asked for a strongly scented herb.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Oliver.text4: Rosemary was delivered to Oliver. He was delighted, claiming he had found the scent he had been looking for. Now, he can craft a special piece that blends both color and fragrance.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Ronald.title: Ronald's Request
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Ronald.text3: Ronald asked for timber to craft a supply record board to place in front of the storage.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Ronald.text4: The timber required for crafting the supply record board was delivered to Ronald. He expressed satisfaction, noting that once the board is installed, managing Carl's storage would be much easier.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Brant.title: Brant's Request
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Brant.text3: Brant, tormented by the past tragedies, asked for some alcohol to forget those nightmares even if it was for just a moment.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Brant.text4: The alcohol was handed to Brant, hoping it would erase at least some of the memories from that day.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Devan.title: Devan's Request
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Devan.text3: Devan wants to erect a gravestone to honor those who had passed and asked for solid stones to make it.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Devan.text4: The stones for the gravestone were delivered to Devan. He carved the names of his fallen comrades to honor them and swore that no more names would ever be added.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Evelyn.title: Evelyn's Request
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Evelyn.text3: Evelyn wants to begin archery training for the Greymanes, and asked you to bring her some arrows.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Evelyn.text4: Evelyn received the arrows she needed for the training. She vowed to make every Greymane stronger, so they would not fall so easily to their enemies.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Joan.title: Joan's Request
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Joan.text3: Joan asked for leather to wrap around the handle in order to repair her worn axe handle.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Joan.text4: The leather was delivered to Joan to wrap around her axe's handle. With her weapon restored, her resolve appeared to strengthen once more.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Piers.title: Pierce's Request
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Piers.text3: Pierce asked for an assessment of the opponents' gambling skills at the Hernand Tavern to prepare himself for future visits.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Piers.text4: The gambling situation at the Hernand Tavern was reported to Pierce, and the dullness in his eyes faded, replaced by a spark of life.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Niall.title: Niall's Request
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Niall.text3: Niall asked for a horn to make a signal trumpet to prepare for the Black Bears' ambush.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Niall.text4: The horn required to craft a trumpet was delivered to Niall. He was satisfied with it, saying that the trumpet would safeguard the lives of all.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Balder.title: Balder's Request
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Balder.text3: Balder requested some gifts for the children he taught, which are meant to convey the meaning of protecting others.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Balder.text4: The gift was delivered, and Balder smiled quietly, as though envisioning the children one day growing into steadfast companions.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Terry.title: Terry's Request
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Terry.text3: Terry, ready to face fate, asked for an apple that can foresee the future.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Terry.text4: Five apples were handed over. Terry smiled awkwardly, then gave up fortune-telling and resolved to change fate.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Luceran.title: Luther's Request
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Luceran.text3: Luther said the leather patches on the comrades' armor were badly worn and asked for high-quality leather to repair them.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Luceran.text4: High-quality leather was handed to Luther. With the armor soon to be reborn in his hands, the comrades would be able to move with greater safety and comfort.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Duncan.title: Duncan's Request
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Duncan.text3: Duncan asked for a fish caught in Pailune Lake, saying he wished to prepare a nostalgic dish for Ronnie the cook.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Duncan.text4: The northern pike was given to Duncan, and the thought of Ronnie tasting that familiar flavor again made anticipation for tonight's dinner grow even stronger.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Mauro.title: Morrow's Request
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Mauro.text3: Morrow asked for herbs to repay the people of Sunset Valley.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Mauro.text4: Good-quality herbs were delivered to Morrow, with the hope that they would reach the people of Sunset Valley and make their days a little easier.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Lars.title: Lars's Request
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Lars.text3: Lars asked for a jewel beetle to use as fishing bait.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Lars.text4: The jewel beetle was delivered to Lars, sparking curiosity about what kind of fish he might catch that day.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Gerald.title: Gerald's Request
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Gerald.text3: Gerald devised a way to fry eggs on a shield and asked for some eggs.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Gerald.text4: The eggs were delivered to Gerald, and whether the attempt succeeds or fails, it is certain to become an amusing tale.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Vernon.title: Vernon's Request
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Vernon.text3: Vernon said he needs to prepare for combat even without a weapon and asked for fleece to make a scarecrow for hand-to-hand combat training.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Vernon.text4: The fleece was delivered to Vernon, allowing him to continue training in a manner that more closely resembles real combat. His strength is expected to be a valuable asset in the next battle.

Mission_GreystoneManor_Felix_Normal_Star.title: Dante the Great Thief
Mission_GreystoneManor_Felix_Normal_Star.text3: Bounty notices are posted throughout Hernand. Track down the Great Thief Dante, spotted near the Inksworth Bindery, and hand him over to the constabulary.
Mission_GreystoneManor_Felix_Normal_Star.text4: Dante has been handed over to the constabulary. The outlaw had allied with the Bleed Bandits to infiltrate Count Felix's manor and steal an important document.

Mission_GreystoneManor_Felix_Normal_Bind.title: Inksworth Bindery
Mission_GreystoneManor_Felix_Normal_Bind.text3: Residents of Inksworth Bindery are suffering from raids by the Bleed Bandits. Drive the bandits out and protect the village.
Mission_GreystoneManor_Felix_Normal_Bind.text4: The Bleed Bandits' raid was repelled. The terrified residents of Inksworth Bindery began to regain their composure.

Mission_GreystoneManor_Felix_Normal_Requ.title: Count Felix's Request
Mission_GreystoneManor_Felix_Normal_Requ.text3: Count Felix is in urgent need of aid. Talk to him to find out what happened.
Mission_GreystoneManor_Felix_Normal_Requ.text4: The Southern Quarry, once blockaded by the Bleed Bandits, was reclaimed. Within its depths, a strange stone monster appeared. Upon its defeat, the creature crumbled to dust, expressing gratitude for reasons unknown.

Mission_GreystoneManor_Felix_Normal_Rewa.title: Count Felix's Reward
Mission_GreystoneManor_Felix_Normal_Rewa.text3: Count Felix awaits news of the Southern Quarry. Return to the Count and share the results.
Mission_GreystoneManor_Felix_Normal_Rewa.text4: Count Felix's worries were resolved, and he expressed his deep gratitude. He promised to provide support whenever aid is needed.

Mission_SouthQuarry_Block_CubeWalker_Sta.title: Stone Giant
Mission_SouthQuarry_Block_CubeWalker_Sta.text3: There's a gaze following you from somewhere in the southern quarry. Check what it is.
Mission_SouthQuarry_Block_CubeWalker_Sta.text4: The strange rock monster and Bleed Bandits in the Southern Quarry were defeated. The threat looming over the quarry finally vanished.

Mission_Node_Her_RodbelFishingDock_Surro.title: Trouble by the River
Mission_Node_Her_RodbelFishingDock_Surro.text3: The Bleed Bandits have occupied Rodbel Fishing Dock.
Mission_Node_Her_RodbelFishingDock_Surro.text4: The Bleed Bandits occupying Rodbel Fishing Dock were defeated.

Mission_HowlingCave_Boss_Wolf_Wife.title: Silence from Afar
Mission_HowlingCave_Boss_Wolf_Wife.text3: A woman is worrying about her husband, who was transferred to Hernand North Gate.
Mission_HowlingCave_Boss_Wolf_Wife.text4: The woman requested you check in on her husband, who she lost contact with after his transfer to Hernand North Gate.

Mission_HowlingCave_Boss_Battle.title: Howls from the North Gate
Mission_HowlingCave_Boss_Battle.text3: Track the legendary wolf terrorizing the North Gate.
Mission_HowlingCave_Boss_Battle.text4: You slew the legendary wolf threatening the North Gate. The villagers finally found relief.

Mission_HowlingCave_Boss_GoBackHome.title: A Moment of Relief
Mission_HowlingCave_Boss_GoBackHome.text3: The legendary wolf has fallen. Return to the North Gate.
Mission_HowlingCave_Boss_GoBackHome.text4: You found the husband alive and safe. He rejoiced to hear news from his wife.

Mission_Node_Her_RootFort_Surround.title: The Eldertree
Mission_Node_Her_RootFort_Surround.text3: Wolf Trackers are occupying the fort of the ancient Eldertree. Defeat them and liberate the stronghold.
Mission_Node_Her_RootFort_Surround.text4: The Wolf Trackers collapsed after you defeated Gwen Kraber. The enemy retreated, and the fort regained its freedom.

Mission_Node_Her_RootFort_Reward.title: Spear Left Behind
Mission_Node_Her_RootFort_Reward.text3: Search the area where Gwen Kraber fell.
Mission_Node_Her_RootFort_Reward.text4: You found Gwen Kraber's spear. It will serve as a symbol of the fort's liberation.

Mission_HernandCastle_Finale_LioncrestMa.title: Recovered Spearmanship
Mission_HernandCastle_Finale_LioncrestMa.text3: A soldier began talking to you in front of Alfonso Manor.
Mission_HernandCastle_Finale_LioncrestMa.text4: It seems House Alfonso is finding their footing again with their spear training.

Mission_HernandCastle_Finale_IcemoorCast.title: Woman Who Lost Her Husband
Mission_HernandCastle_Finale_IcemoorCast.text3: A woman has approached to speak.
Mission_HernandCastle_Finale_IcemoorCast.text4: The woman let out a sigh upon hearing of the Staglord's demise. Her expression held a blend of relief and sorrow.

Mission_HernandCastle_Finale_BluemontMan.title: A Life Returned
Mission_HernandCastle_Finale_BluemontMan.text3: A man has called out near the Bluemont Cask House.
Mission_HernandCastle_Finale_BluemontMan.text4: The man, freed from the quarry, handed over a gift along with his thanks.

Mission_HernandCastle_Finale_SebastianMe.title: Empty Desk
Mission_HernandCastle_Finale_SebastianMe.text3: A letter has been found at the Wycliffe Mappery.
Mission_HernandCastle_Finale_SebastianMe.text4: The mapmaker's letter was found at Wycliffe Mappery.

Mission_HernandCastle_Finale_KharonsoLak.title: Gratitude Not Forgotten
Mission_HernandCastle_Finale_KharonsoLak.text3: A troll man has called out near the Goldleaf trading post.
Mission_HernandCastle_Finale_KharonsoLak.text4: He gave a small gift, along with his thanks for saving the village.

Mission_HernandCastle_Finale_MiningRight.title: The Price of Mining Rights
Mission_HernandCastle_Finale_MiningRight.text3: Felix's guard is reportedly on a search somewhere in Hernand.
Mission_HernandCastle_Finale_MiningRight.text4: A portion of the profits was received as a token of gratitude for the mining rights. The mining business appeared to be progressing smoothly.

Mission_Slum_Finale_LifeSavor.title: Savior
Mission_Slum_Finale_LifeSavor.text3: A man is calling out from the forest.
Mission_Slum_Finale_LifeSavor.text4: The man from the Scrapfold expressed his thanks.

Mission_HernandCastle_Finale_Bleed.title: Bloody Revenge
Mission_HernandCastle_Finale_Bleed.text3: There are rumors that Bleed Bandits still remain throughout Hernand.
Mission_HernandCastle_Finale_Bleed.text4: Remnants of the Bleed Bandits appeared to be seeking revenge for Walter Lanford.

Mission_HernandCastle_Finale_Calphade.title: Savior of the Battlefield
Mission_HernandCastle_Finale_Calphade.text3: There has been an encounter with a soldier in Calphade.
Mission_HernandCastle_Finale_Calphade.text4: Lanford's document of gratitude was delivered. It conveyed the comradery of those who fought together.

Mission_HernandCastle_UnderWagon.title: Man Crushed by a Wagon
Mission_HernandCastle_UnderWagon.text3: There is a man crushed under a destroyed wagon.
Mission_HernandCastle_UnderWagon.text4: The man crushed by a wagon was saved. He offered the item he was moving as a reward for saving him.

Mission_HernandCastle_Rescue.title: Savior on the Road
Mission_HernandCastle_Rescue.text3: There is a man held captive and bandits next to a broken wagon.
Mission_HernandCastle_Rescue.text4: The captured man was safely taken to the village. He delivered his thanks and offered a bottle of wine from the winery.

Mission_HernandCastle_MonasteryRoad.title: On the Way to the Monastery
Mission_HernandCastle_MonasteryRoad.text3: The Bleed Bandits are tying up a man on the roadside.
Mission_HernandCastle_MonasteryRoad.text4: The man was taken to the monastery after defeating the Bleed Bandits. He went into the monastery with an anxious look on his face.

Mission_HernandCastle_DangerousWoodMan.title: Woodcutter in Peril
Mission_HernandCastle_DangerousWoodMan.text3: A man is held hostage by the bandits on the roadside.
Mission_HernandCastle_DangerousWoodMan.text4: The woodcutter was freed after defeating all the bandits. His face still held a frightened look.

Mission_HernandCastle_UnderWagon_II.title: Mysterious Voice
Mission_HernandCastle_UnderWagon_II.text3: A mysterious voice is coming from under the wagon.
Mission_HernandCastle_UnderWagon_II.text4: The voice belonged to a townsperson stuck under the wagon. He has been taken safely to a nearby town.

Mission_HernandCastle_SweetHalt.title: Where the Sweetness Stopped
Mission_HernandCastle_SweetHalt.text3: There are goblins and a tied up man next to a broken wagon.
Mission_HernandCastle_SweetHalt.text4: The farmer, ambushed during his honey delivery, was rescued and taken to the village. He delivered his thanks and asked to visit the winery.

Mission_HernandCastle_WomansTrap.title: The Place She Led
Mission_HernandCastle_WomansTrap.text3: A woman is asking for help on the roadside.
Mission_HernandCastle_WomansTrap.text4: Bandits appeared from all directions upon entering the abandoned house after the woman who was asking for help.

Mission_HernandCastle_Help_Drunken.title: Drunkard in the Liquor Barrel
Mission_HernandCastle_Help_Drunken.text3: A drunkard is in a liquor barrel.
Mission_HernandCastle_Help_Drunken.text4: The drunkard was pulled out of the liquor barrel, but he still failed to regain his senses.

Mission_HernandCastle_Bandit.title: The Bandits' Trap
Mission_HernandCastle_Bandit.text3: There is some mouthwatering meat at an empty house.
Mission_HernandCastle_Bandit.text4: Targeting the greedy, bandits lay in wait with a trap prepared.

Mission_HernandCastle_FakeTear.title: Faked Tears
Mission_HernandCastle_FakeTear.text3: A woman is asking for help on the roadside.
Mission_HernandCastle_FakeTear.text4: Arriving where the child reportedly collapsed, only Bleed Bandits waited. It was a trap.

Mission_HernandCastle_ThornBind.title: Entangled in Thorns
Mission_HernandCastle_ThornBind.text3: A man stands by the roadside, calling out for help.
Mission_HernandCastle_ThornBind.text4: The man was pulled out of the thorny vines. He expressed his gratitude for saving his life.

Mission_HernandCastle_CliffRescue.title: From the Cliff's Edge
Mission_HernandCastle_CliffRescue.text3: A man is asking for help at the cliff behind the Church of Hernand.
Mission_HernandCastle_CliffRescue.text4: The man was pulled up the cliff. He claimed to have seen something shiny down the cliff.

Mission_HernandCastle_TideboundWalk.title: Steps of the Waves
Mission_HernandCastle_TideboundWalk.text3: A man who seems to be a fisherman was rescued from the hill near Vellua. He said to show the dagger to a certain man in the village for a reward.
Mission_HernandCastle_TideboundWalk.text4: The dagger he handed over was a stolen item. A sense of betrayal followed.

Mission_HernandCastle_BaitedCabin.title: Cabin of Deception
Mission_HernandCastle_BaitedCabin.text3: There is an abandoned cabin in the Hills of No Return.
Mission_HernandCastle_BaitedCabin.text4: Upon leaving the abandoned cabin, the Bleed Bandits appeared from all directions. It was a trap.

Mission_HernandCastle_TrapForest.title: Forest of Trickery
Mission_HernandCastle_TrapForest.text3: A woman is urgently calling for help on the roadside.
Mission_HernandCastle_TrapForest.text4: Only herb gathering tools remained where the woman led, and no traces of wild animals. When the bandits appeared, it became clear that it was a trap.

Mission_HernandCastle_TaxInspector.title: The Price of Coin
Mission_HernandCastle_TaxInspector.text3: A tax notice was received from the tax collector.
Mission_HernandCastle_TaxInspector.text4: The tax was paid as instructed in the notice.

Mission_HellwoodSlaveCamp_BridgeConstruc.title: Path Crossing the River
Mission_HellwoodSlaveCamp_BridgeConstruc.text3: A man at the tannery seems to have something to request.
Mission_HellwoodSlaveCamp_BridgeConstruc.text4: A bridge now connects the leatherworks to Hernand, travel between the two places became easier.

Mission_RuinedChapel_ChapelConstruction_.title: Bells Ringing Again
Mission_RuinedChapel_ChapelConstruction_.text3: The ruined chapel needs to be reconstructed.
Mission_RuinedChapel_ChapelConstruction_.text4: Once the Ruined Chapel was reconstructed, the bells rung again in the peaceful town.

Mission_StreamsidePier_StatueConstructio.title: Goddess of Abundance
Mission_StreamsidePier_StatueConstructio.text3: Build a statue of the goddess at the Nas River Fishing Dock.
Mission_StreamsidePier_StatueConstructio.text4: Once the statue of the Goddess of Abundance was built at the Nas River Fishing Dock, the area once again brimmed with life and prosperity.

Mission_HalsiusHospital_BridgeConstructi.title: Path that Connects to House of Healing
Mission_HalsiusHospital_BridgeConstructi.text3: Construct a bridge to St. Halssius's House of Healing.
Mission_HalsiusHospital_BridgeConstructi.text4: A bridge was built at St. Halssius's House of Healing.

Mission_HernandCastle_StatueConstruction.title: Wolf Protecting Hernand
Mission_HernandCastle_StatueConstruction.text3: Build a wolf statue at the Hernand south entrance.
Mission_HernandCastle_StatueConstruction.text4: The wolf statue was built. Hernand gained a new symbol.

Mission_Velluavillage_LighthouseConstruc.title: Light for the Village
Mission_Velluavillage_LighthouseConstruc.text3: Construct a lighthouse to illuminate Vellua.
Mission_Velluavillage_LighthouseConstruc.text4: A lighthouse was constructed in Vellua, resolving the difficulties faced by the residents.

Mission_HernandCastle_CucuIcemoorCastleR.title: A Special Blueprint
Mission_HernandCastle_CucuIcemoorCastleR.text3: Soldiers are gathered around Bloomwood Ranch, having a conversation.
Mission_HernandCastle_CucuIcemoorCastleR.text4: The craftsman said they'd run out of materials.

Mission_HernandCastle_CucuIcemoorCastleR.title: Missing Materials
Mission_HernandCastle_CucuIcemoorCastleR.text3: Obtain the ingredients mentioned in the blueprint, and bring it to life.
Mission_HernandCastle_CucuIcemoorCastleR.text4: A new storage chest was crafted at the workshop using the pot and the required materials.

Mission_HernandCastle_CucuIcemoorCastleR.title: Mysterious Cooler
Mission_HernandCastle_CucuIcemoorCastleR.text3: Return to the craftsman with the cooler.
Mission_HernandCastle_CucuIcemoorCastleR.text4: The craftsman, seeing the completed cooler, showed you how to enhance it further.

Mission_HernandCastle_Roberts_Collection.title: Early Encounter
Mission_HernandCastle_Roberts_Collection.text3: A servant of House Roberts called to you with a bright smile on his face.
Mission_HernandCastle_Roberts_Collection.text4: In return for helping House Roberts, you received a specially crafted storage chest. It should prove useful for the journey ahead.

Mission_HernandCastle_Rhett.title: Rhett's Request
Mission_HernandCastle_Rhett.text3: It seems like something is going on with Rhett, the blacksmith of Hernand.
Mission_HernandCastle_Rhett.text4: Materials have been gathered for Rhett, who was struggling with his work.

Mission_HernandCastle_Raine.title: Renee's Request
Mission_HernandCastle_Raine.text3: Renee, the butcher, has requested fish porridge.
Mission_HernandCastle_Raine.text4: The fish porridge was made and delivered to Renee.

Mission_HernandCastle_Turnuli.title: Turnali's Request
Mission_HernandCastle_Turnuli.text3: Blacksmith Turnali has requested for wood, saying he needs them for his tools.
Mission_HernandCastle_Turnuli.text4: High-quality wood was delivered to Turnali.

Mission_HernandCastle_Anbella.title: Annabella's Request
Mission_HernandCastle_Anbella.text3: Annabella has requested for fish to use their scales as decorations of a saddle.
Mission_HernandCastle_Anbella.text4: The fish was delivered to Annabella.

Mission_HernandCastle_Tina.title: Tina's Request
Mission_HernandCastle_Tina.text3: Tina of the Hernand tailor's shop appears to be in trouble.
Mission_HernandCastle_Tina.text4: The hat was delivered as Tina requested.

Mission_HernandCastle_Bran.title: Bran's Request
Mission_HernandCastle_Bran.text3: Bran, the merchant from Hernand, wants to sell his spinning wheel.
Mission_HernandCastle_Bran.text4: It seems he changed his mind after seeing the spinning wheel work.

Mission_HernandCastle_Aldun.title: Alden's Request
Mission_HernandCastle_Aldun.text3: Alden is worried that his shop is not getting enough customers.
Mission_HernandCastle_Aldun.text4: The words of the provisioner's shop have been shared with the arena's cook. New customers should be visiting Alden's shop.

Mission_HernandCastle_Bruna.title: Bruna's Request
Mission_HernandCastle_Bruna.text3: Bruna from the saddlery seems restless.
Mission_HernandCastle_Bruna.text4: The feedback on Bruna's new tack has been passed onto her.

Mission_HernandCastle_Grana.title: Grania's Request
Mission_HernandCastle_Grana.text3: Grania, the tavernkeep in Kharonso, wants to find the customer who left behind a pair of sweet-scented gloves.
Mission_HernandCastle_Grana.text4: The gloves left behind at the tavern have been delivered to the beekeeper.

Mission_HernandCastle_Ugmum.title: Ugmon's Request
Mission_HernandCastle_Ugmum.text3: Ugmon, the merchant from Goldleaf Merchant Guild, is doubtful about the quality of the honey.
Mission_HernandCastle_Ugmum.text4: The condition of the honey has been checked, then explained to Ugmon.

Mission_HernandCastle_Delkin.title: Delkin's Request
Mission_HernandCastle_Delkin.text3: Delkin, a merchant from Hernand, is running out of space to store his grains.
Mission_HernandCastle_Delkin.text4: A jar has been delivered to him.

Mission_HernandCastle_Dahlia.title: Dahlia's Request
Mission_HernandCastle_Dahlia.text3: Dahlia says there's an unpaid tab she hasn't collected yet.
Mission_HernandCastle_Dahlia.text4: The tab was collected and delivered to Dahlia.

Mission_HernandCastle_Yjork.title: Nork's Request
Mission_HernandCastle_Yjork.text3: The equipment merchant Nork is wondering why the beeswax for his weapons hasn't arrived.
Mission_HernandCastle_Yjork.text4: Nork was notified that the apiary couldn't prepare the beeswax on time, as they were buried in work.

Mission_HernandCastle_Berdo.title: Berto's Request
Mission_HernandCastle_Berdo.text3: Berto from Vellua Village is in trouble because the owner of the fishing rod hasn't shown up.
Mission_HernandCastle_Berdo.text4: The fishing rod has been delivered to its owner.

Mission_HernandCastle_Shirg.title: Serge's Request
Mission_HernandCastle_Shirg.text3: The merchant Serge has requested to inform the Goldleaf Guildhouse about his trouble with the bandits.
Mission_HernandCastle_Shirg.text4: Serge's predicament has been shared with the Goldleaf Guildhouse.

Mission_HernandCastle_Frox.title: Prox's Request
Mission_HernandCastle_Frox.text3: Prox has requested to deliver the counterfeit goods and a list of related people to the investigator at the trading post.
Mission_HernandCastle_Frox.text4: The counterfeit goods and the list have been handed over to the investigator of Goldleaf Merchant Guild.

Mission_HernandCastle_SpinStone.title: Break in the grindstone
Mission_HernandCastle_SpinStone.text3: A dwarf artisan at the Timberturner Wainwright is struggling with a grindstone that won't turn.
Mission_HernandCastle_SpinStone.text4: The workshop's grindstone was broken in.

Mission_HernandCastle_StrongSteed.title: Sturdy Horse
Mission_HernandCastle_StrongSteed.text3: The Horse Fence in Hernand has said he needs a sturdy horse.

Mission_Node_Her_Saddlecap_Cowherd_Norma.title: To the Green Fields
Mission_Node_Her_Saddlecap_Cowherd_Norma.text3: It looks like the farmer at Saddlecap Ranch needs help.
Mission_Node_Her_Saddlecap_Cowherd_Norma.text4: The cows were taken to a pasture where fresh grass grew. In the green field, they began grazing peacefully.

SunsetVillage_Normal_Start.title: Village of the Sick
SunsetVillage_Normal_Start.text3: The healer in Sunset Valley needs herbs, as the patients' conditions are very serious.
SunsetVillage_Normal_Start.text4: Herbs were handed over to the healer in Sunset Valley.

Mission_RiventainMonastery_StolenMap_All.title: The Hidden Space of the Heart
Mission_RiventainMonastery_StolenMap_All.text3: Ulzok the outlaw says he is from the Reventine Monastery.
Mission_RiventainMonastery_StolenMap_All.text4: The outlaw Ulzok's secret location has been discovered.

Mission_ReventineMonastery_Normal_Start.title: A Rumor Fueled by Greed
Mission_ReventineMonastery_Normal_Start.text3: Rumor speaks of a valuable document hidden within the Reventine Monastery. It may be wise to heed those eager for sudden fortune.
Mission_ReventineMonastery_Normal_Start.text4: You obtained the valuable document concealed in the Reventine Monastery.

Mission_Her_SpringtideWatermill_Block_Sp.title: Stopped Watermill
Mission_Her_SpringtideWatermill_Block_Sp.text3: The watermill at Springtide Mill has stopped working. Open the floodgate to activate the watermill.
Mission_Her_SpringtideWatermill_Block_Sp.text4: The watermill was activated by opening Springtide Mill's floodgate.

Mission_HernandCastle_BrokenHeart.title: The Ever Waiting Man
Mission_HernandCastle_BrokenHeart.text3: They say there's a man who stands in the exact same place every day.
Mission_HernandCastle_BrokenHeart.text4: It seems he's waiting for someone who's not coming.

Mission_HernandCastle_SafetyFactory.title: Safety First
Mission_HernandCastle_SafetyFactory.text3: A worker has requested help on the goblins that appeared near his worksite.
Mission_HernandCastle_SafetyFactory.text4: The goblins around the Emberwind Workshop were taken care of.

Mission_HernandCastle_SellToBlack.title: A Secret Deal
Mission_HernandCastle_SellToBlack.text3: A man in a discreet place has carefully requested to sell something for him.
Mission_HernandCastle_SellToBlack.text4: The goods were sold to the trading post on his behalf. It was a shady deal, but he did give half the coin as promised.

Mission_HernandCastle_ShopFriend.title: Old Friends
Mission_HernandCastle_ShopFriend.text3: A man in Vellua is worried he might not finish his work with a loose mallet.
Mission_HernandCastle_ShopFriend.text4: A mallet was bought and delivered on his behalf. The two seemed like old friends who would patch things up in no time.

Mission_HernandCastle_PassionateFarming.title: Passionate Farmer
Mission_HernandCastle_PassionateFarming.text3: A farmer at Glenbright Farm is trying to decide his next crop.
Mission_HernandCastle_PassionateFarming.text4: Some carrots were given to the farmer, for which the farmer gave some beets in return. His field will become even more bountiful.

Mission_HernandCastle_CausesOfBadOdor.title: The Cause of the Stench
Mission_HernandCastle_CausesOfBadOdor.text3: A villager is asking for help cleaning up the livestock's feces, in a place filled with foul odor.
Mission_HernandCastle_CausesOfBadOdor.text4: The pig dungs were cleaned for the villagers who couldn't stand the stench, but the response was...

Mission_HernandCastle_CitizenStory_Saddl.title: A Missing Goat
Mission_HernandCastle_CitizenStory_Saddl.text3: A man has requested for help looking for a goat that went missing last night.
Mission_HernandCastle_CitizenStory_Saddl.text4: The man was told the missing goat was found and the wolf is no longer a threat. A hint of relief, mixed with sorrow for the goat he could not save, remained in his eyes.

Mission_HernandCastle_MissingFriend.title: Missing Companion
Mission_HernandCastle_MissingFriend.text3: A request has been made to investigate the forest for a friend who disappeared there one day.
Mission_HernandCastle_MissingFriend.text4: Some strangely arranged stones were found. Could there be some kind of secret?

Mission_HernandCastle_AlmsfortheBeggar.title: Kindness for the Poor
Mission_HernandCastle_AlmsfortheBeggar.text3: A beggar is asking for help feeding the starving villagers.
Mission_HernandCastle_AlmsfortheBeggar.text4: The villagers in need have been helped with. They won't have to starve, at least for today.

Mission_HernandCastle_Alfred.title: Scent That Soothes the Night
Mission_HernandCastle_Alfred.text3: Alfred is running low on herbs needed to treat the sick faithful.
Mission_HernandCastle_Alfred.text4: The herbs were delivered to Alfred for the sick faithful.

Mission_HernandCastle_Theoric.title: Color of Sunlight
Mission_HernandCastle_Theoric.text3: Theoric of the Hernand dyehouse has requested fresh flowers to produce more beautiful colors.
Mission_HernandCastle_Theoric.text4: The flowers were delivered to Theoric. He can now create an even more vivid, brilliant color thanks to the quality ingredients.

Mission_HernandCastle_Dverick.title: The Vanished Dye
Mission_HernandCastle_Dverick.text3: Devin from Pororin is having a hard time because of a shai's pranks.
Mission_HernandCastle_Dverick.text4: The dye was returned to Devin.

Mission_HernandCastle_WifeLunchBox.title: Lunchbox of Love
Mission_HernandCastle_WifeLunchBox.text3: There is a woman, worrying about her husband who forgot his packed lunch.
Mission_HernandCastle_WifeLunchBox.text4: The packed lunch has been delivered to the husband. His wife's love and care warmed his heart, and those of the villagers.

Mission_HernandCastle_EnoughArrow.title: Plenty of Arrows
Mission_HernandCastle_EnoughArrow.text3: The guards at the outpost in Stormtalon Ridge are wondering why the camp at Hills of No Return hasn't requested more arrows.
Mission_HernandCastle_EnoughArrow.text4: The soldier at Hills of No Return were told that there will be an upcoming inspection of training, along with arrows.

Mission_HernandCastle_EggForVoice.title: A Voice like an Angel
Mission_HernandCastle_EggForVoice.text3: A woman at Bloomwood Ranch is looking for some eggs to make her voice sound more beautiful.
Mission_HernandCastle_EggForVoice.text4: The eggs were handed over so the woman can make her voice sound more beautiful.

Mission_HernandCastle_BraveToLove.title: All You Need is Courage
Mission_HernandCastle_BraveToLove.text3: There is a man at Coalvale Workshop who has a secret crush.
Mission_HernandCastle_BraveToLove.text4: The mas was told that she likes courageous men.

Mission_HernandCastle_DevelopPosion.title: Testing Folk Remedies
Mission_HernandCastle_DevelopPosion.text3: A troll scholar researching antidotes is looking to test folk remedies passed down through generations.
Mission_HernandCastle_DevelopPosion.text4: The scholar's study on the secrets of folk remedies was helped with.

Mission_HernandCastle_MeatForWork.title: Meat or Nothing
Mission_HernandCastle_MeatForWork.text3: Someone at the Timberham Sawmill is complaining that there is no meat in the stew.
Mission_HernandCastle_MeatForWork.text4: Meat was provided so that the worker could work harder.

Mission_HernandCastle_UnbelievableRumor.title: A Wheel of Dreams
Mission_HernandCastle_UnbelievableRumor.text3: A soldier, building his own wagon for his dreams, has asked for some help.
Mission_HernandCastle_UnbelievableRumor.text4: After hearing the wagon artisan's advice, the soldier seemed to have found a solution. Determination lit in his face, as if he'd moved one step closer to his dream.

Mission_HernandCastle_InviteGardener.title: Looking for a Gardener
Mission_HernandCastle_InviteGardener.text3: A man from Ivynook has asked to find a gardener.
Mission_HernandCastle_InviteGardener.text4: The gardener was told the news from Ivynook.

Mission_HernandCastle_RhinocerosBeetle.title: Small Horn in the Forest
Mission_HernandCastle_RhinocerosBeetle.text3: A villager who's recently gotten into insect collecting is asking to catch an insect found in the forest.
Mission_HernandCastle_RhinocerosBeetle.text4: The insect was handed over. He couldn't stop staring at the horn.

Mission_HernandCastle_Peregrine.title: Peregrine's Request
Mission_HernandCastle_Peregrine.text3: Peregrine, the provisioner, has requested to deliver bread to the church.
Mission_HernandCastle_Peregrine.text4: The breads have been anonymously delivered to the church. Peregrine's warmth spread throughout the village.

Mission_HernandCastle_Timmyr.title: Temir's Request
Mission_HernandCastle_Timmyr.text3: Temir needs timber to fix his worn out display stand.
Mission_HernandCastle_Timmyr.text4: The timber was delivered to Temir.

Mission_HernandCastle_Harveston.title: Haverson's Request
Mission_HernandCastle_Harveston.text3: Haverson from Calphade Village wants to learn why the bakery isn't buying his wheat.
Mission_HernandCastle_Harveston.text4: The reason the bakery isn't buying his wheat has been explained. Haverson was determined to make changes for the next harvest.

Mission_HernandCastle_Drianna.title: Driana's Request
Mission_HernandCastle_Drianna.text3: Driana wants to get the soldiers' opinions on saddles.
Mission_HernandCastle_Drianna.text4: Driana has been told which type of saddles the soldiers prefer. Looks like she'll be selling even finer saddles soon.

Mission_HernandCastle_Gloin.title: Galen's Request
Mission_HernandCastle_Gloin.text3: Galen from Calphade is in trouble because of a leather delivery gone wrong.
Mission_HernandCastle_Gloin.text4: The leather of the requested quality has been delivered.

Mission_HernandCastle_Matilda.title: Mathilde's Request
Mission_HernandCastle_Matilda.text3: It appears more and more people are seeing ghosts at the tavern.
Mission_HernandCastle_Matilda.text4: You handed over a bottle of holy water to Matilde, who was troubled by ghost stories.

Mission_HernandCastle_Adelina.title: Adrina's Request
Mission_HernandCastle_Adelina.text3: Adrina is thinking of ways to show off her outfits in style.
Mission_HernandCastle_Adelina.text4: The training field will deliver a scarecrow to Adrina.

Mission_HernandCastle_FindShelter.title: Securing a Shelter
Mission_HernandCastle_FindShelter.text3: A person is worried that war might break out.
Mission_HernandCastle_FindShelter.text4: He was told about a shelter cave, so he could feel relieved.

Mission_HernandCastle_SurpriseGift.title: Surprise Gift
Mission_HernandCastle_SurpriseGift.text3: A man has asked to deliver a basket of flowers to his wife.
Mission_HernandCastle_SurpriseGift.text4: The wife seemed overjoyed after receiving the present from her husband.

Mission_HernandCastle_FillDonation.title: Empty Donation Box
Mission_HernandCastle_FillDonation.text3: There is a priest who wishes to help the faithful return to the church after the war.
Mission_HernandCastle_FillDonation.text4: A contribution was added to the donation box. The small donation will provide help to those who visit the church.

Mission_HernandCastle_Roendel.title: Material of Light
Mission_HernandCastle_Roendel.text3: Lauendell from Calphade dyehouse is running low on dyes and needs assistance.
Mission_HernandCastle_Roendel.text4: The satintail roots were handed over to Lauendell.

Mission_Friendly_Legendary.title: Legendary Hunter
Mission_Friendly_Legendary.text3: A freesword in the archery contest says he knows about the Legendary Hunter.
Mission_Friendly_Legendary.text4: Information on the Legendary Hunter was acquired.

Mission_Friendly_Legendary_Animal.title: Rumors about Legendary Animals
Mission_Friendly_Legendary_Animal.text3: Head to the location where the Legendary Hunter was last spotted.
Mission_Friendly_Legendary_Animal.text4: You obtained information about the legendary animals.

Mission_Friendly_Legendary_Black_Lion.title: Dark Catastrophy
Mission_Friendly_Legendary_Black_Lion.text3: Track down the black lion mentioned in the journal.
Mission_Friendly_Legendary_Black_Lion.text4: The black lion was defeated. Its blood-red eyes and sharp claws seemed to display its majesty.

Mission_GoldleafGuildhouse_InnocentSon_N.title: Truth in the Shadows
Mission_GoldleafGuildhouse_InnocentSon_N.text3: You found about a woman's desperate memory.
Mission_GoldleafGuildhouse_InnocentSon_N.text4: The true culprit was delivered to the guards, clearing the name of the wrongfully accused.

Mission_GoldleafGuildhouse_InnocentSon_N.title: Trust Uncovered
Mission_GoldleafGuildhouse_InnocentSon_N.text3: Deliver the news that the real culprit has been caught.
Mission_GoldleafGuildhouse_InnocentSon_N.text4: The news about the caught culprit was delivered. The false accusation was cleared, and the woman can now live peacefully with her son again.

Mission_CalphadeCastle_Misappropriation_.title: Stolen Supplies
Mission_CalphadeCastle_Misappropriation_.text3: There is a person who seems troubled in front of the castle. Check what's going on.
Mission_CalphadeCastle_Misappropriation_.text4: Supplies for rebuilding after the war have gone missing. The soldier asked to listen to the villagers and help them catch the thief.

Mission_CalphadeCastle_Misappropriation_.title: Search for leads
Mission_CalphadeCastle_Misappropriation_.text3: They say supplies for rebuilding have gone missing. Talk to those who might know.
Mission_CalphadeCastle_Misappropriation_.text4: The villagers' stories about the missing supplies were heard. Return to the soldier who requested the investigation and share the results.

Mission_CalphadeCastle_Misappropriation_.title: Deduction and Revelation of the Culprit
Mission_CalphadeCastle_Misappropriation_.text3: The villagers' stories have been heard. Return and organize the leads gathered so far.
Mission_CalphadeCastle_Misappropriation_.text4: A talk with the soldier revealed that Helmut the blacksmith was the one stealing the supplies. He was caught red-handed at the smuggling site and turned in to the construction overseer, bringing the case to a close.

Mission_ScholastoneInstitute_WeightOfKno.title: The Missing Forbidden Book
Mission_ScholastoneInstitute_WeightOfKno.text3: There appears to be a commotion at the institute. Find out what is happening.
Mission_ScholastoneInstitute_WeightOfKno.text4: It's said that a forbidden book of the institute has gone missing.

ScholastoneInstitute_WeightOfKnowledge_N.title: Investigation
ScholastoneInstitute_WeightOfKnowledge_N.text4: The movements of the people on the day of the incident were investigated.

Mission_ScholastoneInstitute_WeightOfKno.title: Contradiction
Mission_ScholastoneInstitute_WeightOfKno.text3: The villagers' stories have been heard. Return and organize the leads gathered so far.
Mission_ScholastoneInstitute_WeightOfKno.text4: The culprit was identified through conversations. They were caught at the scene and handed in, bringing the case to a close.

Mission_Hernand_Wanted_Guide.title: Bounty Notice - Jeffrey
Mission_Hernand_Wanted_Guide.text3: A guard is sighing with a stack of bounty notices in his hands. It looks like he's running out of space to post them due to the overwhelming numbers.
Mission_Hernand_Wanted_Guide.text4: The outlaw Jeffrey has been handed over to the guards. The guard acknowledged the skill and requested that any more such individuals be brought to the guards.

Mission_Her_Wanted_Criminal_Simon_de_Mon.title: Bounty Notice - Simon de Montfort
Mission_Her_Wanted_Criminal_Simon_de_Mon.text3: They say there's a honey thief near Nectarwood Apiary.
Mission_Her_Wanted_Criminal_Simon_de_Mon.text4: The outlaw Simon de Montfort has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Her_Wanted_Criminal_Haldin.title: Bounty Notice - Haldin
Mission_Her_Wanted_Criminal_Haldin.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for stealing military supplies in Hernand.
Mission_Her_Wanted_Criminal_Haldin.text4: The outlaw Haldin has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Her_Wanted_Criminal_Alessio.title: Bounty Notice - Alessio
Mission_Her_Wanted_Criminal_Alessio.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for murder near the Southern Quarry.
Mission_Her_Wanted_Criminal_Alessio.text4: The outlaw Alessio has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Her_Wanted_Criminal_Blix.title: Bounty Notice - Blix
Mission_Her_Wanted_Criminal_Blix.text3: A criminal is illegally looting ruins.
Mission_Her_Wanted_Criminal_Blix.text4: The outlaw Blix has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Her_Wanted_Criminal_Bianca.title: Bounty Notice - Bianca
Mission_Her_Wanted_Criminal_Bianca.text3: They say a hired killer was witnessed near Hillside Manor.
Mission_Her_Wanted_Criminal_Bianca.text4: The outlaw Bianca has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Her_Wanted_Criminal_Salvatore.title: Bounty Notice - Salvatore
Mission_Her_Wanted_Criminal_Salvatore.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for murder in Vellua.
Mission_Her_Wanted_Criminal_Salvatore.text4: The outlaw Salvatore has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Her_Wanted_Criminal_Warren.title: Bounty Notice - Warren
Mission_Her_Wanted_Criminal_Warren.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for making people addicted to the drug he crafted.
Mission_Her_Wanted_Criminal_Warren.text4: The outlaw Warren has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Her_Wanted_Criminal_Billy.title: Bounty Notice - Billy
Mission_Her_Wanted_Criminal_Billy.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for pickpocketing in Hernand.
Mission_Her_Wanted_Criminal_Billy.text4: The outlaw Billy has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Node_Her_WillkommPost_Surround.title: Torn Encirclement
Mission_Node_Her_WillkommPost_Surround.text3: The Wolf Trackers have occupied Vilkom Outpost.
Mission_Node_Her_WillkommPost_Surround.text4: The Wolf Trackers occupying Vilkom Outpost were defeated.

Mission_Node_Her_BellanorHuntingGrounds_.title: Savage Horde
Mission_Node_Her_BellanorHuntingGrounds_.text3: The Wolf Trackers have occupied Bellanor Hunting Grounds.
Mission_Node_Her_BellanorHuntingGrounds_.text4: The Wolf Trackers occupying Bellanor Hunting Grounds were defeated.

Mission_Node_Her_RiverwardOutpost_Surrou.title: Origin of the Gunshots
Mission_Node_Her_RiverwardOutpost_Surrou.text3: The Wolf Trackers have occupied Riverward Outpost.
Mission_Node_Her_RiverwardOutpost_Surrou.text4: The Wolf Trackers occupying Riverward Outpost were defeated.

Mission_Node_Her_RiverwardOutpost_Block_.title: Gunshots at the Riverside
Mission_Node_Her_RiverwardOutpost_Block_.text3: The Wolf Trackers have occupied the riverside posthouses.
Mission_Node_Her_RiverwardOutpost_Block_.text4: The Wolf Trackers occupying the riverside posthouses were defeated.

Mission_Node_Her_EmbernestBeacon_Surroun.title: A Promise Without Ember
Mission_Node_Her_EmbernestBeacon_Surroun.text3: The Bleed Bandits have occupied Embernest Beacon.
Mission_Node_Her_EmbernestBeacon_Surroun.text4: The Bleed Bandits occupying Embernest Beacon were defeated.

Mission_Node_Her_HellwoodBeacon_Surround.title: Night Sky in Darkness
Mission_Node_Her_HellwoodBeacon_Surround.text3: The Bleed Bandits have occupied Rocca's Hill Beacon.
Mission_Node_Her_HellwoodBeacon_Surround.text4: The Bleed Bandits occupying Rocca's Hill Beacon were defeated.

Mission_Node_Her_DeepForestBeacon_Surrou.title: Knight of the Beacon
Mission_Node_Her_DeepForestBeacon_Surrou.text3: The Blinding Arrows have occupied Deepwoods Beacon.
Mission_Node_Her_DeepForestBeacon_Surrou.text4: The Blinding Arrows occupying Deepwoods Beacon were defeated.

Mission_Node_Her_BellanorBeacon_Surround.title: Burning Fire
Mission_Node_Her_BellanorBeacon_Surround.text3: The Wolf Trackers have occupied Bellanor Beacon.
Mission_Node_Her_BellanorBeacon_Surround.text4: The Wolf Trackers occupying Bellanor Beacon were defeated.

Mission_Node_Cal_WolfFang_Mine_Surround.title: Encirclement Within Rocks
Mission_Node_Cal_WolfFang_Mine_Surround.text3: The Wolf Trackers have occupied the mine in Stormtalon Ridge.
Mission_Node_Cal_WolfFang_Mine_Surround.text4: The Wolf Trackers occupying the mine in Stormtalon Ridge Mine were defeated.

Mission_Node_Cal_WolfFang_Mine_SubNode.title: The Gaze Over Stones
Mission_Node_Cal_WolfFang_Mine_SubNode.text3: The Wolf Trackers have occupied the strongholds around Stormtalon Ridge Mine.
Mission_Node_Cal_WolfFang_Mine_SubNode.text4: The Wolf Trackers occupying the strongholds around Stormtalon Ridge Mine were defeated.

Mission_Node_Her_WisdomTower_Surround.title: Commotion in the Spire
Mission_Node_Her_WisdomTower_Surround.text3: The goblins have occupied the Spire of Insight.
Mission_Node_Her_WisdomTower_Surround.text4: The goblins occupying the Spire of Insight were defeated.

Mission_AnvilHill_Block_Start.title: Bandits of Anvil Hill
Mission_AnvilHill_Block_Start.text3: There are rumors that the Goblin Bandits have occupied Anvil Hill.
Mission_AnvilHill_Block_Start.text4: The bandits occupying Anvil Hill were defeated.

Mission_Node_Her_DrakefallCastle_Block.title: Bloodied Sword
Mission_Node_Her_DrakefallCastle_Block.text3: The Wolf Trackers have occupied Drakesfall Castle.
Mission_Node_Her_DrakefallCastle_Block.text4: Giath and the Wolf Trackers occupying Drakesfall Castle were defeated. The fort is isolated and weakened, and it's time to move forward.

Mission_Node_Her_DrakefallCastle_Watchto.title: Drakesfall Watchtower
Mission_Node_Her_DrakefallCastle_Watchto.text3: There are major strongholds supporting the castle near Drakesfall Watchtower.
Mission_Node_Her_DrakefallCastle_Watchto.text4: The castle is isolated and weakened, and it's time to move forward.

Mission_Node_Her_StoneTowerVillage_Block.title: Blade in the Stone Tower
Mission_Node_Her_StoneTowerVillage_Block.text3: The Bleed Bandits are occupying Cairn House.
Mission_Node_Her_StoneTowerVillage_Block.text4: The Bleed Bandits occupying Cairn House were defeated.

Mission_KharonsoLake_Block_Start.title: Destroyed Barrier Stone of the Lake
Mission_KharonsoLake_Block_Start.text4: A boulder fell from the sky, shattering the seal that kept the Runewalker dormant. The barrier stones must be found and restored before it awakens again.

Mission_KharonsoLake_Block_PillarComplet.title: Fading Seal
Mission_KharonsoLake_Block_PillarComplet.text3: Restore all the barrier stones. Only when the seal is complete will the heart fall dormant once more.
Mission_KharonsoLake_Block_PillarComplet.text4: All broken barrier stones were restored.

Mission_KharonsoLake_Block_BossBattle.title: Nightmare of Kharonso
Mission_KharonsoLake_Block_BossBattle.text3: A runewalker appeared in the lake ruins. Defeat Vordis, the Runewalker.
Mission_KharonsoLake_Block_BossBattle.text4: After restoring all the barrier stones in the lake ruins, the true form of the ruins emerged. Runewalker, the walker of the lake, began to destroy its surroundings while crying out in pain. It was clear it carried a story of its own.

Mission_LioncrestManor_Alfonso_Normal_Re.title: Inadequacy
Mission_LioncrestManor_Alfonso_Normal_Re.text3: Baron Alfonso seeks aid regarding a troubling matter. Meet with him.
Mission_LioncrestManor_Alfonso_Normal_Re.text4: The Baron admitted his inability to act alone after his son, Graham Alfonso, went missing while pursuing the family spear manual.

Mission_LioncrestManor_Alfonso_Normal_Re.title: Graham Alfonso
Mission_LioncrestManor_Alfonso_Normal_Re.text3: Contact was lost with Graham Alfonso, who vanished while attempting to recover the stolen spear manual. Look for him.
Mission_LioncrestManor_Alfonso_Normal_Re.text4: You rescued Graham from the clutches of the Bleed Bandits, though his wounds were deep.

Mission_LioncrestManor_Alfonso_Normal_Re.title: The Weight of Legacy
Mission_LioncrestManor_Alfonso_Normal_Re.text3: Recover all parts of the stolen spear manual that the Bleed Bandits have scattered across their various hideouts.
Mission_LioncrestManor_Alfonso_Normal_Re.text4: The recovery of the spear manual from the Bleed Bandits restored the honor of House Alfonso. The baron's humble admission of his own failures proved why his name remains so highly esteemed.

Mission_LioncrestManor_Alfonso_AbyssTrac.title: Peculiar Structure
Mission_LioncrestManor_Alfonso_AbyssTrac.text3: Reports of boulders from the sky and mysterious structures weigh heavily on the baron's mind. Investigate the claims of the strange sightings.
Mission_LioncrestManor_Alfonso_AbyssTrac.text4: While others failed to notice, the strange structure proved to be an Abyss Nexus, offering a gateway to paths previously left uncovered.

Mission_OakenshieldManor_Serkis_Clue_Sta.title: The Missing Family Seal
Mission_OakenshieldManor_Serkis_Clue_Sta.text3: A letter and a piece of a clue have been left for Marquis Serkis. Follow the lead written within to find the next location.
Mission_OakenshieldManor_Serkis_Clue_Sta.text4: The next location was found by comparing the letter and the clue. It's time to follow the trail.

Mission_OakenshieldManor_Serkis_Clue_Int.title: Traces of Intruder
Mission_OakenshieldManor_Serkis_Clue_Int.text3: An intruder has left behind a trace. Search the suspicious locations to gather leads.
Mission_OakenshieldManor_Serkis_Clue_Int.text4: A trace of the intruder was found at Lioncrest Watchtower. The lead pointed toward the next location.

Mission_OakenshieldManor_Serkis_Clue_Sha.title: Trace of Shadows
Mission_OakenshieldManor_Serkis_Clue_Sha.text3: The traces left by the intruder continues. Find where "black and white blends."
Mission_OakenshieldManor_Serkis_Clue_Sha.text4: The leads in Duskwood were gathered up. It's time to piece it all together and uncover the truth.

Mission_OakenshieldManor_Serkis_Clue_Con.title: Where All Comes Together
Mission_OakenshieldManor_Serkis_Clue_Con.text3: Head to where the leads from Duskwood point to. The clues may finally come together.
Mission_OakenshieldManor_Serkis_Clue_Con.text4: The clues were pieced together. The seal of House Serkis is at Anvil Hill.

Mission_OakenshieldManor_Serkis_Clue_Mor.title: Heart of Anvil Hill
Mission_OakenshieldManor_Serkis_Clue_Mor.text3: Marquis Serkis has asked to retrieve the seal from the fortress on Anvil Hill.
Mission_OakenshieldManor_Serkis_Clue_Mor.text4: The seal of House Serkis was recovered from the fort at Anvil Hill. The marquis thought about the lesson left with the seal and vowed to take this incident as an opportunity for self-reflection.

Mission_IcemoorCastleRuins_Block_William.title: The Broken Trail
Mission_IcemoorCastleRuins_Block_William.text3: A soldier has asked for help looking for Middler. Help the search and check the situation.
Mission_IcemoorCastleRuins_Block_William.text4: Williem was finally found, having collapsed. He said that the Staglord was killing people and had to be stopped before it's too late.

Mission_IcemoorCastleRuins_Block_DeerKin.title: King of the Fallen Kingdom
Mission_IcemoorCastleRuins_Block_DeerKin.text3: Saigord the Staglord, king of a forgotten kingdom, has gone mad in solitude in his ruined castle. Defeat him to prevent further casualties.
Mission_IcemoorCastleRuins_Block_DeerKin.text4: Saigord the Staglord was defeated. Only obsession and emptiness remained upon the throne he sought to protect. He muttered incoherently until the very moment his life faded. One could only guess what he was looking at in his final moments.

Mission_OakenshieldManor_Serkis_FortWars.title: Leader of the Bleed Bandits
Mission_OakenshieldManor_Serkis_FortWars.text3: Marquis Serkis is waiting at the manor. It seems he has some important news regarding the leader of the Bleed Bandits.
Mission_OakenshieldManor_Serkis_FortWars.text4: Walter Lanford, the leader of the Bleed Bandits, has made his appearance. Defeat him for the peace of Hernand.

Mission_OakenshieldManor_Serkis_FortWars.title: Name Written in Blood
Mission_OakenshieldManor_Serkis_FortWars.text3: Walter Lanford, the leader of the Bleed Bandits, must be defeated. With him gone, Hernand will find peace.
Mission_OakenshieldManor_Serkis_FortWars.text4: Walter Lanford, the leader of the Bleed Bandits, was defeated. The shadow that loomed over Hernand finally disappeared along with him.

Mission_OakenshieldManor_Serkis_FortWars.title: The Ennobled of Hernand
Mission_OakenshieldManor_Serkis_FortWars.text3: Return and share the news to Marquis Serkis. It's time to end this long fight.
Mission_OakenshieldManor_Serkis_FortWars.text4: Recognized for the notable achievement, Hernand granted ennoblement. The shadow of the Bleed Bandits finally began to lift from Hernand.

Mission_BloomwoodRanch_HorseRace_Normal_.title: Race in Hernand
Mission_BloomwoodRanch_HorseRace_Normal_.text3: There is a noble on horseback next to Bloomwood Ranch.
Mission_BloomwoodRanch_HorseRace_Normal_.text4: A race against the noble was held in the middle of Hernand, kicking up clouds of dust.

Mission_Silver_Armor_Her_Beacon_Start.title: For Whom the Bell Tolls
Mission_Silver_Armor_Her_Beacon_Start.text3: Light the fire at the beacon to inform Hernand of victory.
Mission_Silver_Armor_Her_Beacon_Start.text4: The beacon has been lighted to announce Calphade's victory in the war to all of Hernand.

Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_BurnedBeacon.title: Dark Tidings from Pailune
Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_BurnedBeacon.text3: With the war behind them, Marshal Middler brings troubling news. He awaits outside Marquis Serkis's manor in Hernand.
Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_BurnedBeacon.text4: The Calphade War may be won, yet Marshal Middler's tidings offer no peace. Bitter news has come of a Greymane traitor in the homeland of Pailune. The journey is far from over.

Mission_PororinVillage_Bell_All_Hernand.title: Bell Tolling in Hernand
Mission_PororinVillage_Bell_All_Hernand.text4: A shai appeared as the bell rang, offering you a gift before vanishing.

Mission_PororinVillage_Bell_All_Pailune.title: Bell Tolling in Pailune
Mission_PororinVillage_Bell_All_Pailune.text4: A shai appeared as the bell rang, offering you a gift before vanishing.

Mission_PororinVillage_Bell_All_Calphade.title: Bell Tolling in Calphade
Mission_PororinVillage_Bell_All_Calphade.text4: A shai appeared as the bell rang, offering you a gift before vanishing.

Mission_PororinVillage_Bell_All_Tashkalp.title: Bell Tolling in Tommaso
Mission_PororinVillage_Bell_All_Tashkalp.text4: A shai appeared as the bell rang, offering you a gift before vanishing.

Mission_PororinVillage_Bell_All_Demeniss.title: Bell Tolling in Demeniss
Mission_PororinVillage_Bell_All_Demeniss.text4: A shai appeared as the bell rang, offering you a gift before vanishing.

Mission_PororinVillage_Bell_All_Delesyia.title: Bell Tolling in Delesyia
Mission_PororinVillage_Bell_All_Delesyia.text4: A shai appeared as the bell rang, offering you a gift before vanishing.

Mission_PororinVillage_Bell_All_Scholast.title: Bell Tolling in Scholastone
Mission_PororinVillage_Bell_All_Scholast.text3: Ring the bell at the Scholastone Institute.
Mission_PororinVillage_Bell_All_Scholast.text4: A shai appeared as the bell rang, offering you a gift before vanishing.

Mission_PororinVillage_Bell_All_Varnia.title: Bell Tolling in Varnia
Mission_PororinVillage_Bell_All_Varnia.text4: A shai appeared as the bell rang, offering you a gift before vanishing.

Mission_PororinVillage_HiddenPororin_Nor.title: A Mystical Gathering
Mission_PororinVillage_HiddenPororin_Nor.text3: The shais of Pororin laugh and play joyfully throughout the village.
Mission_PororinVillage_HiddenPororin_Nor.text4: The curious shais shared their stories, each eager to speak their mind, before vanishing across Pywel and leaving only petals behind.

Mission_PororinVillage_HiddenPororin_Nor.title: Restrictions
Mission_PororinVillage_HiddenPororin_Nor.text3: One individual seems particularly concerned about the shais who suddenly disappeared.
Mission_PororinVillage_HiddenPororin_Nor.text4: The village chief, accustomed to the commotion, handed over a journal containing clues to the missing shais' whereabouts.

Mission_PororinVillage_HiddenPororin_Nor.title: Mystic Falls
Mission_PororinVillage_HiddenPororin_Nor.text3: Polan is looking for the scattered shais who wandered away from the safety of the village.
Mission_PororinVillage_HiddenPororin_Nor.text4: You found one of the adventurous shais. Having explored the continent's mystical wonders, they returned to the village satisfied.

Mission_PororinVillage_HiddenPororin_Nor.title: Beautiful Desert
Mission_PororinVillage_HiddenPororin_Nor.text3: Polan is looking for the scattered shais who wandered away from the safety of the village.
Mission_PororinVillage_HiddenPororin_Nor.text4: You found one of the adventurous shais. Having explored the continent's mystical wonders, they returned to the village satisfied.

Mission_PororinVillage_HiddenPororin_Nor.title: Wyvern's Cradle
Mission_PororinVillage_HiddenPororin_Nor.text3: Polan is looking for the scattered shais who wandered away from the safety of the village.
Mission_PororinVillage_HiddenPororin_Nor.text4: You found one of the adventurous shais. Having explored the continent's mystical wonders, they returned to the village satisfied.

Mission_PororinVillage_HiddenPororin_Nor.title: Desert's Edge Maze
Mission_PororinVillage_HiddenPororin_Nor.text3: Polan is looking for the scattered shais who wandered away from the safety of the village.
Mission_PororinVillage_HiddenPororin_Nor.text4: You found one of the adventurous shais. Having explored the continent's mystical wonders, they returned to the village satisfied.

Mission_PororinVillage_HiddenPororin_Nor.title: A Token of Friendship
Mission_PororinVillage_HiddenPororin_Nor.text3: The missing shais have been found. Speak with the chief of Pororin.
Mission_PororinVillage_HiddenPororin_Nor.text4: The chief of Pororin gifted you one of their signature hats as a token of gratitude for finding the mischievous shais.

Mission_PororinVillage_Trembling_Woods_N.title: The Unreachable Village
Mission_PororinVillage_Trembling_Woods_N.text3: A shai seeks your help. He has offered a way into the mysterious village in exchange for a specific favor.
Mission_PororinVillage_Trembling_Woods_N.text4: The Relic of Pororin was retrieved from the Windwood Spirit Offin, securing Arkin's promise of entry.

Mission_PororinVillage_Trembling_Woods_N.title: Authorized Access
Mission_PororinVillage_Trembling_Woods_N.text3: Return the relic to Arkin to gain entry to the village.
Mission_PororinVillage_Trembling_Woods_N.text4: Arkin was relieved by the relic's safe return and granted you entry to the village as a reward.

Mission_HernandCastle_PororinResearch.title: Herbs of Vitality
Mission_HernandCastle_PororinResearch.text3: The research director of Pororin has requested herbs to make an energizing potion.
Mission_HernandCastle_PororinResearch.text4: The herbs needed to kick off research were delivered to the research director.

Mission_PororinVillage_Normal_KeepFocus.title: How to Stay Focused
Mission_PororinVillage_Normal_KeepFocus.text3: A shai researcher is examining a waterfall.
Mission_PororinVillage_Normal_KeepFocus.text4: The shai researcher revealed that the scent from a pouch of herbs can sharpen mental focus.

Mission_PororinVillage_Normal_AboutJijeo.title: Palmar Leaves
Mission_PororinVillage_Normal_AboutJijeo.text3: A massive, ancient tree stands at the heart of Pororin.
Mission_PororinVillage_Normal_AboutJijeo.text4: Observations confirmed that Palmar leaves thrive primarily in the shadow of giant trees.

Mission_PororinVillage_Normal_GrowJijeon.title: Palmar Leaf Cultivation
Mission_PororinVillage_Normal_GrowJijeon.text3: Fields of various herbs stretch across the village of Pororin.
Mission_PororinVillage_Normal_GrowJijeon.text4: Shai researchers continue their efforts to create conditions for Palmar leaf cultivation.

Mission_PororinVillage_Normal_OriginPoro.title: The Origin of Pororin's Magic Tools
Mission_PororinVillage_Normal_OriginPoro.text3: A shai researcher is examining some ruins.
Mission_PororinVillage_Normal_OriginPoro.text4: Knowledge regarding the construction of magical tools was recovered from the ruins surrounding Pororin.

Mission_PororinVillage_ResearchStop_Rese.title: Halted Wild Ginseng Research
Mission_PororinVillage_ResearchStop_Rese.text3: The research has been halted. Assistance may be needed.
Mission_PororinVillage_ResearchStop_Rese.text4: The research on the mysterious energy from wild ginseng was resumed.

Mission_PororinVillage_ResearchStop_Rese.title: Halted Palmar Leaf Research
Mission_PororinVillage_ResearchStop_Rese.text3: The research has been halted. Assistance may be needed.
Mission_PororinVillage_ResearchStop_Rese.text4: The research on Palmar leaves was resumed.

Mission_PororinVillage_Shaipresent_0001.title: Reunited with Rulupee
Mission_PororinVillage_Shaipresent_0001.text4: You encountered Rulupee again, who handed over an aged object before disappearing.

Mission_HernandCastle_ScholarStoneResear.title: The Secret to Concentration
Mission_HernandCastle_ScholarStoneResear.text3: The Scholastone research director has requested a cup of sweet tea before beginning an important study.
Mission_HernandCastle_ScholarStoneResear.text4: A cup of sweet tea was brought to the research director. His expression softened immediately after drinking it.

ScholarStoneInstitute_Academic_Normal_St.title: Flow of the Abyss
ScholarStoneInstitute_Academic_Normal_St.text3: Scholars are conducting academic research on the Abyss around a sculpture visualizing the flow of the Abyss.
ScholarStoneInstitute_Academic_Normal_St.text4: You obtained knowledge about the flow of the Abyss.

ScholarStoneInstitute_Academic_Normal_Ro.title: Abyss Rocket Device
ScholarStoneInstitute_Academic_Normal_Ro.text3: There is an ongoing research about a rocket device that uses the power of the Abyss.
ScholarStoneInstitute_Academic_Normal_Ro.text4: You obtained knowledge about the Abyss rocket device.

ScholarStoneInstitute_Academic_Normal_Ku.title: Skyroot Cultivation Site
ScholarStoneInstitute_Academic_Normal_Ku.text3: There is an ongoing research about skyroot cultivation for stable studies on them.
ScholarStoneInstitute_Academic_Normal_Ku.text4: You obtained knowledge about the skyroot cultivation site.

ScholarStoneInstitute_Academic_Normal_An.title: Ancient Abyss Research
ScholarStoneInstitute_Academic_Normal_An.text3: There is an ongoing research about the Abyss, in front of the Abyss research tablet which was passed down from ancient times.
ScholarStoneInstitute_Academic_Normal_An.text4: You obtained knowledge about the ancient Abyss.

Mission_ScholarStoneInstitue_ResearchSto.title: Halted Abyssal Power Research
Mission_ScholarStoneInstitue_ResearchSto.text3: The research has been halted. Assistance may be needed.
Mission_ScholarStoneInstitue_ResearchSto.text4: The research on Abyssal power was resumed.

Mission_ScholarStoneInstitue_ResearchSto.title: Halted Skyroot Research
Mission_ScholarStoneInstitue_ResearchSto.text3: The research has been halted. Assistance may be needed.
Mission_ScholarStoneInstitue_ResearchSto.text4: The research on skyroot was resumed.

Mission_ScholarStoneInstitute_All_Start.title: Constellation Research
Mission_ScholarStoneInstitute_All_Start.text3: Search for the constellation research journal at the Scholastone Institute. It may have a lead connecting starlight and the ruins.
Mission_ScholarStoneInstitute_All_Start.text4: The constellation research journal was found. It recorded beams of light observed at the "Gate of Truth" ruins in the Kingshield Mountains and faint luminescent reactions observed in gravestone samples. The records also detailed the development of the "constellation helm" that decodes constellations, and a conclusion that the steles and constellations are interlinked like a single puzzle.

Mission_ScholarStoneInstitute_All_Stele.title: Troll Studying Steles
Mission_ScholarStoneInstitute_All_Stele.text3: A troll at the institute is immersed in researching a stele. He has suggested wearing the constellation helm to see firsthand.
Mission_ScholarStoneInstitute_All_Stele.text4: The constellation helm was received from the troll. Hidden flows of starlight were revealed upon examining the stele while wearing the headgear.

Mission_ScholarStoneInstitute_Anamorphic.title: The Maps of the Night Unveiled
Mission_ScholarStoneInstitute_Anamorphic.text3: The scattered starlight has gathered and now points toward a single location.
Mission_ScholarStoneInstitute_Anamorphic.text4: At the place revealed by the starlights, a mystical sword was found.

Mission_SeniaVillage_Block_Start.title: The Village of Saint Senia
Mission_SeniaVillage_Block_Start.text3: There are people talking outside the Church of Hernand.
Mission_SeniaVillage_Block_Start.text4: The priest spoke of Senia, a town perched on a steep cliff south of Hernand, famed for the miracles of Saint Senia. It might be worth a visit.

Mission_SeniaVillage_Block_Liberate.title: Town on the Cliff
Mission_SeniaVillage_Block_Liberate.text3: There has been a disturbance in Senia.
Mission_SeniaVillage_Block_Liberate.text4: The Hellhounds that infested Senia have been defeated, but the priests remain uneasy.

Mission_SeniaVillage_HolyRelic_Normal_St.title: Finding the Relic
Mission_SeniaVillage_HolyRelic_Normal_St.text3: The priests are speaking among themselves with troubled faces.
Mission_SeniaVillage_HolyRelic_Normal_St.text4: Senia's long-guarded reliquary has been stolen by the Hellhounds, and the grief of its residents echoes through the town.

Mission_SeniaVillage_Block_HolyRelic.title: Reliquary of Saint Senia
Mission_SeniaVillage_Block_HolyRelic.text3: The Hellhounds appear to have taken Senia's reliquary to their base.
Mission_SeniaVillage_Block_HolyRelic.text4: Senia's reliquary was reclaimed from the Hellhounds and returned to the church. Freed from their grief, the priests wept with joy and hailed it as another miracle of Saint Senia.

Mission_Slum_Normal_Start.title: Boss of the Beggars' Alliance
Mission_Slum_Normal_Start.text3: The king of the hovels is in need of help.
Mission_Slum_Normal_Start.text4: You found the imprisoned healer and delivered the herbs to the boss. The sickly poor began to regain their vitality.

Mission_Slum_NobleCure_Normal_Start.title: Desperate Help
Mission_Slum_NobleCure_Normal_Start.text3: There's a troubled man at Lioncrest Manor.
Mission_Slum_NobleCure_Normal_Start.text4: You learned the man's wife had contracted the plague, and that there was no cure for her.

Mission_Slum_NobleCure_Normal_Play.title: A Clue to the Cure
Mission_Slum_NobleCure_Normal_Play.text3: Find someone who knows about the cure.
Mission_Slum_NobleCure_Normal_Play.text4: You heard in the hovels that pine mushroom tea is effective against the disease. The cure was made following the recipe you were given.

Mission_Slum_NobleCure_Normal_Complete.title: The First Step to Opening Your Heart
Mission_Slum_NobleCure_Normal_Complete.text3: Deliver the completed cure before it's too late.
Mission_Slum_NobleCure_Normal_Complete.text4: The cure was delivered to the noble, with hopes that this would bring nobles and the poor closer together.

Mission_SpiderCastle_Block_SpiderQueen.title: Queen's Nest
Mission_SpiderCastle_Block_SpiderQueen.text3: The Queen Spider has taken over the abandoned factory, transformed it into her citadel, and now resides there.
Mission_SpiderCastle_Block_SpiderQueen.text4: With the Queen Spider defeated, the swarm of spiders retreated. The factory is ready to resume operations.

Mission_SpiderCastle_Block_SpiderQueen_S.title: Forsaken Factory
Mission_SpiderCastle_Block_SpiderQueen_S.text3: Numerous goblins have settled near Arboria Castle.
Mission_SpiderCastle_Block_SpiderQueen_S.text4: The goblins surrounding Arboria Castle were driven out.

Mission_SpiderCastle_DrugFactory_Normal_.title: Restarting the Elixir Factory
Mission_SpiderCastle_DrugFactory_Normal_.text3: A huge factory lies abandoned. To get it running again, the cultivation room to produce raw materials needs to be restored first.
Mission_SpiderCastle_DrugFactory_Normal_.text4: At last, the perfect elixir has been produced. The abandoned factory has begun to fulfill its purpose once again.

Mission_SpiderCastle_DrugFactory_Normal_.title: Foundation of Abundance
Mission_SpiderCastle_DrugFactory_Normal_.text3: It looks like someone left some equipment in the Elixir Factory cultivation room. Let's go and confirm.
Mission_SpiderCastle_DrugFactory_Normal_.text4: A fertilizer sprayer used at the Elixir Factory was obtained. It has a distinct scent, but it feels as though it's packed with rich nutrients.

Mission_VelluaVillage_Block_Request_Help.title: Rumor-Ridden Fishing Village
Mission_VelluaVillage_Block_Request_Help.text3: Fishermen looking for the thrill of the catch have gathered at a fishing spot in Hernand, eager to share their tale.
Mission_VelluaVillage_Block_Request_Help.text4: Though once renowned for its peaceful atmosphere, Vellua now echoes with screams and was overrun by marauding pirates.

Mission_VelluaVillage_Block_Chief.title: Vellua in Peril
Mission_VelluaVillage_Block_Chief.text3: Pirates have seized control of Vellua. Defeat the pirates and rescue the villagers.
Mission_VelluaVillage_Block_Chief.text4: Vellua was shrouded in deep unease and darkness by pirates who worship their leader like a god. But when the chief was rescued, light slowly began to return to the village.

Mission_VelluaVillage_Block_Boss.title: Shadows in the Mist
Mission_VelluaVillage_Block_Boss.text3: The chief states that the pirates' killing will continue as long as their captain remains alive. Defeat the pirates' captain.
Mission_VelluaVillage_Block_Boss.text4: Sir Catfish was cornered, but unfortunately escaped. Seething as if unable to accept defeat at human hands, he fled, vowing that this was not the end.

Mission_VelluaVillage_Block_Boss_Complet.title: The Town Without Fog
Mission_VelluaVillage_Block_Boss_Complet.text3: Sir Catfish has fled. The chief of vellua must be informed.
Mission_VelluaVillage_Block_Boss_Complet.text4: The chief could not hide his joy upon learning that Sir Catfish, the pirate captain, fled from the village. He expressed his gratitude repeatedly, as though hope had returned to the village for the first time in many years.

Mission_VelluaVillage_Girl_Rescue_Normal.title: The Missing Girl
Mission_VelluaVillage_Girl_Rescue_Normal.text3: Someone is sobbing in Vellua, despite the village being peaceful again. Find out what's going on.
Mission_VelluaVillage_Girl_Rescue_Normal.text4: A woman named Vera was wailing that her daughter had been kidnapped by pirates. Worn down by the pirates' long tyranny, Vera looked even more exhausted from the grief of losing her child.

Mission_VelluaVillage_Girl_Rescue_Normal.title: Through the Current
Mission_VelluaVillage_Girl_Rescue_Normal.text3: Look into Rosa's whereabouts along the coast near the village.
Mission_VelluaVillage_Girl_Rescue_Normal.text4: Vera's daughter, Rosa, was rescued from the pirates. Vera, who had longed so desperately for her daughter's return, wept without end the moment she held Rosa in her arms again.

Mission_Node_Kwe_VatnhollFortress_Surrou.title: Shadows of Beasts
Mission_Node_Kwe_VatnhollFortress_Surrou.text3: The Black Bears have occupied Vat'nholl Fortress. Defeat the enemies inside the fortress.
Mission_Node_Kwe_VatnhollFortress_Surrou.text4: All Black Bears have been eliminated.

Mission_Node_Kwe_VatnhollFortress_SubNod.title: Black Bears' Claw
Mission_Node_Kwe_VatnhollFortress_SubNod.text3: The Black Bears in Camp Bjornlund are threatening the defensive line.
Mission_Node_Kwe_VatnhollFortress_SubNod.text4: The Black Bears in Camp Bjornlund were defeated, preventing the threat directed to Calphade.

Mission_Node_Her_SanctumOfTemperance_Blo.title: Sanctum of Temperance
Mission_Node_Her_SanctumOfTemperance_Blo.text3: There are Antumbra's followers performing a suspicious ritual.
Mission_Node_Her_SanctumOfTemperance_Blo.text4: The Antumbra's followers were driven away.

Mission_Node_Her_SanctumOfPenitence_Bloc.title: Sanctum of Penitence
Mission_Node_Her_SanctumOfPenitence_Bloc.text3: There are Antumbra's followers performing a suspicious ritual.
Mission_Node_Her_SanctumOfPenitence_Bloc.text4: The Antumbra's followers were driven away.

Mission_Node_Her_SanctumOfBenediction_Bl.title: Sanctum of Benediction
Mission_Node_Her_SanctumOfBenediction_Bl.text3: There are Antumbra's followers performing a suspicious ritual.
Mission_Node_Her_SanctumOfBenediction_Bl.text4: The Antumbra's followers were driven away.

Mission_Node_Kwe_SanctumOfExaltation_Blo.title: Sanctum of Exaltation
Mission_Node_Kwe_SanctumOfExaltation_Blo.text3: There are Antumbra's followers performing a suspicious ritual.
Mission_Node_Kwe_SanctumOfExaltation_Blo.text4: The Antumbra's followers were driven away.

Mission_Node_Her_SanctumOfDeliverance_Bl.title: Sanctum of Deliverance
Mission_Node_Her_SanctumOfDeliverance_Bl.text3: There are Antumbra's followers performing a suspicious ritual.
Mission_Node_Her_SanctumOfDeliverance_Bl.text4: The Antumbra's followers were driven away.

Mission_Node_Her_SanctumOfAtonement_Bloc.title: Sanctum of Atonement
Mission_Node_Her_SanctumOfAtonement_Bloc.text3: There are Antumbra's followers performing a suspicious ritual.
Mission_Node_Her_SanctumOfAtonement_Bloc.text4: The Antumbra's followers were driven away.

Mission_Node_Del_SanctumOfDevotion_Block.title: Sanctum of Devotion
Mission_Node_Del_SanctumOfDevotion_Block.text3: There are Antumbra's followers performing a suspicious ritual.
Mission_Node_Del_SanctumOfDevotion_Block.text4: The Antumbra's followers were driven away.

Mission_Node_Del_SanctumOfVeneration_Blo.title: Sanctum of Veneration
Mission_Node_Del_SanctumOfVeneration_Blo.text3: There are Antumbra's followers performing a suspicious ritual.
Mission_Node_Del_SanctumOfVeneration_Blo.text4: The Antumbra's followers were driven away.

Mission_Node_Del_Temple_0015_Block.title: Sanctum of Oblation
Mission_Node_Del_Temple_0015_Block.text3: There are Antumbra's followers performing a suspicious ritual.
Mission_Node_Del_Temple_0015_Block.text4: The Antumbra's followers were driven away.

Mission_Node_Del_Temple_0014_Block.title: Sanctum of Faith
Mission_Node_Del_Temple_0014_Block.text3: There are Antumbra's followers performing a suspicious ritual.
Mission_Node_Del_Temple_0014_Block.text4: The Antumbra's followers were driven away.

Mission_Node_Her_SanctumOfExpiation_Bloc.title: Sanctum of Expiation
Mission_Node_Her_SanctumOfExpiation_Bloc.text3: There are Antumbra's followers performing a suspicious ritual.
Mission_Node_Her_SanctumOfExpiation_Bloc.text4: The Antumbra's followers were driven away.

Mission_Node_Dem_SanctumOfRenunciation_B.title: Sanctum of Renunciation
Mission_Node_Dem_SanctumOfRenunciation_B.text3: There are Antumbra's followers performing a suspicious ritual.
Mission_Node_Dem_SanctumOfRenunciation_B.text4: The Antumbra's followers were driven away.

Mission_Her_SanctumOfSolace_Boss_Battle.title: Antumbra's Staff
Mission_Her_SanctumOfSolace_Boss_Battle.text3: An Antumbra follower is offering prayers beneath a great tree.

Mission_Her_SanctumOfAbsolution_Boss_Bat.title: Antumbra's Sword
Mission_Her_SanctumOfAbsolution_Boss_Bat.text3: The Antumbra followers are stuffing people into coffins.

Mission_Dem_SanctumOfRevelation_Boss_Bat.title: Antumbra's Spear
Mission_Dem_SanctumOfRevelation_Boss_Bat.text3: There are Antumbra's followers performing a suspicious ritual.

Mission_Dem_SanctumOfRevelation_Boss_Rew.title: Antumbra's Spear Loot
Mission_Dem_SanctumOfRevelation_Boss_Rew.text3: Search for loot where Antumbra's Spear fell.
Mission_Dem_SanctumOfRevelation_Boss_Rew.text4: Thorn of Dark Pursuit was obtained.

Mission_Kwe_SpireOfRuination_Boss_Start.title: Archon of Antumbra
Mission_Kwe_SpireOfRuination_Boss_Start.text3: Investigate the mysterious Cloister of Ruination.
