Mission_Kwe_SpireOfRuination_Boss_Start.text4: The archon's end was deeply unsettling to witness, crying out for darkness even as he fell. His last scream filled the air with ominous feeling, like an echo swallowed by the void.

Mission_HarpyNest_Boss_Block.title: Queen of the Skies
Mission_HarpyNest_Boss_Block.text3: Perched atop the mountain's highest peak rests a colossal nest, home to the Harpy Queen Karanda.
Mission_HarpyNest_Boss_Block.text4: After a fierce battle, Karanda soared high into the sky.

Mission_LonelyJackal_BloodGolem_Boss_Sta.title: Hunting Red
Mission_LonelyJackal_BloodGolem_Boss_Sta.text3: Defeat the bloodied monster attacking travelers on their way to Pailune, then return to the town.
Mission_LonelyJackal_BloodGolem_Boss_Sta.text4: Crussis, the Bloodwalker, also known as the bloodied monster, was defeated.

Mission_LonelyJackal_BloodGolem_Boss_End.title: Vanquished Threat
Mission_LonelyJackal_BloodGolem_Boss_End.text3: Crussis, the Bloodwalker was defeated. Return and let the Pailune Militia know.
Mission_LonelyJackal_BloodGolem_Boss_End.text4: The militia was relieved at the news of the bloodied monster and handed over the promised reward. Its threat upon Pailune also finally vanished.

LongleafTreeVillage_Boss_Battle.title: The Sport Hunter
LongleafTreeVillage_Boss_Battle.text3: Moren, the Mistwood Huntmaster, is occupying Longleaf Forest.
LongleafTreeVillage_Boss_Battle.text4: Moren, the Mistwood Huntmaster, was defeated. The threat over Longleaf Forest faded.

Mission_LongrootsVillage_Block_Start.title: City in a Lightless Forest
Mission_LongrootsVillage_Block_Start.text3: Something ominous seems to be happening in Longleaf Forest.
Mission_LongrootsVillage_Block_Start.text4: The trust of the villagers were earned.

Mission_LongrootsVillage_Puzzle.title: Longroots Lost to Darkness
Mission_LongrootsVillage_Puzzle.text3: In the villages that lost their light, the people's nerves are frayed.
Mission_LongrootsVillage_Puzzle.text4: Bringing light back to the village earned the trust of the people of Longroots.

Mission_LongleafTreeVillage_Puzzle.title: Longleaf Lost to Darkness
Mission_LongleafTreeVillage_Puzzle.text3: In the villages that lost their light, the people's nerves are frayed.
Mission_LongleafTreeVillage_Puzzle.text4: Bringing light back to the village earned the trust of the people of Longleaf.

Mission_LongbranchVillage_Puzzle.title: Longbranch Lost to Darkness
Mission_LongbranchVillage_Puzzle.text3: In the villages that lost their light, the people's nerves are frayed.
Mission_LongbranchVillage_Puzzle.text4: Bringing light back to the village earned the trust of the people of Longbranch.

Mission_LongleafTreeVillage_Normal.title: Remaining Threat
Mission_LongleafTreeVillage_Normal.text3: The leader of Mistwood Hunters remain, roaming Longleaf Forest.
Mission_LongleafTreeVillage_Normal.text4: Moren, the Mistwood Huntmaster, was defeated. The threat over Longleaf Forest faded.

Mission_LongleafTreeVillage_VanishedMist.title: Dissipated Fog
Mission_LongleafTreeVillage_VanishedMist.text3: Share the news of the defeat of the Mistwood Hunters' leader.
Mission_LongleafTreeVillage_VanishedMist.text4: You delivered the news of the Mistwood Hunters' leader defeat. People felt the anxiety over the roads lift, and a brief moment of respite returned to the village.

Mission_RidgehunterLeatherMaker_Normal_S.title: Concern of the Tannery
Mission_RidgehunterLeatherMaker_Normal_S.text3: A monster suddenly appeared one day and covered the forest in mud. Slay the beast and return to the village.
Mission_RidgehunterLeatherMaker_Normal_S.text4: Lutemir, the Mudwalker, also known as the mud monster, was defeated.

Mission_RidgehunterLeatherMaker_Normal_R.title: Reward for Subjugation
Mission_RidgehunterLeatherMaker_Normal_R.text3: People should be able to travel without worry now. Deliver this news to the tannery.
Mission_RidgehunterLeatherMaker_Normal_R.text4: The tannery was relieved at the news of the mud monster and handed over the promised reward. The threat of mud that covered the forest finally vanished.

Mission_LongbranchVillage_EntTreasure_St.title: Woodland Spirit with a House on Its Head
Mission_LongbranchVillage_EntTreasure_St.text3: They say a house is built on top of Wayward Spirit Tett's head. Search inside the woodland spirit's house.
Mission_LongbranchVillage_EntTreasure_St.text4: You obtained the treasure inside the woodland spirit's house.

Mission_OdeckVillage_Tarandus.title: The Black Bears and the Red Smoke
Mission_OdeckVillage_Tarandus.text3: The Black Bears are occupying Odeck and are spreading a red smoke.
Mission_OdeckVillage_Tarandus.text4: The Black Bears occupying Odeck and its surroundings were defeated, and the jars that seemed to be spreading the red smoke were destroyed.

Mission_OdeckVillage_Tarandus_Battle.title: Ashen Warrior
Mission_OdeckVillage_Tarandus_Battle.text3: The Black Bears around Odeck have been defeated, and the jars emitting red smoke have been destroyed. Now, deliver the news to the villagers.
Mission_OdeckVillage_Tarandus_Battle.text4: Tarandus, who had occupied Odeck, has been defeated.

Mission_OdeckVillage_Tarandus_OdeckPier_.title: The Crimson-Stained Breath
Mission_OdeckVillage_Tarandus_OdeckPier_.text3: Red smokes are rising near Odeck.
Mission_OdeckVillage_Tarandus_OdeckPier_.text4: The Black Bears near Odeck were defeated.

Mission_GeneralTomb_Block_Start.title: The Guardian's Tomb
Mission_GeneralTomb_Block_Start.text3: Even though the Black Bears are gone from the village, there is still a resident who seems troubled.
Mission_GeneralTomb_Block_Start.text4: A tomb of a general, known as a guardian deity, lies deep within the mountains near Odeck.

Mission_GeneralTomb_Block_GuardianTomb.title: Odeck Ruins
Mission_GeneralTomb_Block_GuardianTomb.text3: Find the entrance to the ruins within the mountains near Odeck.
Mission_GeneralTomb_Block_GuardianTomb.text4: The spear of the general, guardian deity of Odeck, was obtained.

Mission_RescuePailuneLeader_Normal_Start.title: Shapers of the Future
Mission_RescuePailuneLeader_Normal_Start.text3: Candidates of Pailune's future leader have gone missing.
Mission_RescuePailuneLeader_Normal_Start.text4: Find the candidates who will lead Pailune's future.

Mission_Node_Kwe_SteinnfellFortress_Surr.title: Persistent Dark Shadow
Mission_Node_Kwe_SteinnfellFortress_Surr.text3: The Black Bears used the blizzard to their advantage and took over the fortress. Break through the encirclement and enter.
Mission_Node_Kwe_SteinnfellFortress_Surr.text4: The occupying Black Bears have been wiped out.

Mission_Node_Kwe_SteinnfellFortress_SubN.title: Lord of the Forgotten Castle
Mission_Node_Kwe_SteinnfellFortress_SubN.text3: The Black Bears occupying the destroyed Steinnfell Fortress are threatening Pailune.
Mission_Node_Kwe_SteinnfellFortress_SubN.text4: The Black Bears were defeated and Steinnfell Fortress was secured.

Mission_SteinnfellFortress_Normal_Rescue.title: Resolve Forgotten in the Blizzard
Mission_SteinnfellFortress_Normal_Rescue.text3: Surviving Pailunese refugees have gathered in the heart of Steinnfell Fortress.
Mission_SteinnfellFortress_Normal_Rescue.text4: Garred, whom Jian had noted as a candidate for Pailune's future, was found at Steinnfell Fortress. The refugees stated that he fought to protect them until the very end and vowed never to forget him.

Mission_FortAskelund_Retake_Block_Start.title: The Unending Threat of the Black Bears
Mission_FortAskelund_Retake_Block_Start.text3: The Black Bears have seized Fort Askelund. Eliminate the enemies inside.

Mission_FortAskelund_Retake_Block_SubNod.title: White Wall
Mission_FortAskelund_Retake_Block_SubNod.text3: The Black Bears are blocking the path through the gate of Fort Askelund.
Mission_FortAskelund_Retake_Block_SubNod.text4: The Black Bears guarding the gate were defeated.

Mission_FortAskelund_Normal_RescuePailun.title: Resolve Forgotten in Everfrost
Mission_FortAskelund_Normal_RescuePailun.text3: Pailunese refugees are gathered inside Fort Askelund.
Mission_FortAskelund_Normal_RescuePailun.text4: Rodrick, whom Jian had noted for Pailune's future, was found at Fort Askelund. The refugees expressed deep regret, lamenting that they failed to protect him after he had fought for them until the end.

Mission_HiddenEstate_Block_Start.title: Closed Fence
Mission_HiddenEstate_Block_Start.text3: Righteous Inquisitors are stationed at the secluded private property of House Byron.
Mission_HiddenEstate_Block_Start.text4: The Righteous Inquisitors stationed at the secluded private property of House Byron were defeated.

Mission_WindmereManor_HiddenEstate_Norma.title: Resolve Forgotten Past the Fence
Mission_WindmereManor_HiddenEstate_Norma.text3: Rescued refugees are gathered inside the secluded private property.
Mission_WindmereManor_HiddenEstate_Norma.text4: Clemens, whom Jian had noted for Pailune's future, was safely rescued from the secluded private property of House Byron. He will play a vital role in reuniting the scattered people.

Mission_RoketBag_Normal_Start.title: Fire Breathing Pack
Mission_RoketBag_Normal_Start.text3: Someone is looking for a Greymane on the streets of Pailune. Find out what is going on.
Mission_RoketBag_Normal_Start.text4: With the materials handed over, Grimnir finished crafting the kuku rocket pack. His ever-wonderful technology seemed like it could even make the heaviest man fly.

Mission_Kwe_Wanted_Criminal_Thorfinn.title: Bounty Notice - Torfinn
Mission_Kwe_Wanted_Criminal_Thorfinn.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for conducting forbidden research in the ancient ruins of the Pailune Ancient Mine Site.
Mission_Kwe_Wanted_Criminal_Thorfinn.text4: The outlaw Torfinn has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Kwe_Wanted_Criminal_Sigrid.title: Bounty Notice - Sigrid
Mission_Kwe_Wanted_Criminal_Sigrid.text3: An arsonist is hiding in the Wolf's Molar Cave.
Mission_Kwe_Wanted_Criminal_Sigrid.text4: The outlaw Sigrid has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Kwe_Wanted_Criminal_Slurk.title: Bounty Notice - Throk
Mission_Kwe_Wanted_Criminal_Slurk.text3: Rumor has it that a dog thief roams the woods near the Pailune Floodgate, with a pack of vicious hounds at his heels.
Mission_Kwe_Wanted_Criminal_Slurk.text4: The outlaw Throk has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Kwe_Wanted_Criminal_Rolf.title: Bounty Notice - Rolf
Mission_Kwe_Wanted_Criminal_Rolf.text3: Rumor has it that the criminal who murdered his friend has escaped to the eastern foothills of Pailune.
Mission_Kwe_Wanted_Criminal_Rolf.text4: The outlaw Rolf has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Kwe_Wanted_Criminal_Ulf.title: Bounty Notice - Wolfe
Mission_Kwe_Wanted_Criminal_Ulf.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for committing crimes disguised as a boar in Volstein Ruins.
Mission_Kwe_Wanted_Criminal_Ulf.text4: The outlaw Wolfe has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Kwe_Wanted_Criminal_Eira.title: Bounty Notice - Aera
Mission_Kwe_Wanted_Criminal_Eira.text3: A grave robber is lurking near the Valgrind Tomb.
Mission_Kwe_Wanted_Criminal_Eira.text4: The outlaw Aera has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Kwe_Wanted_Criminal_Krunk.title: Bounty Notice - Kronk
Mission_Kwe_Wanted_Criminal_Krunk.text3: There's a poacher in the northern part of Skoghorn.
Mission_Kwe_Wanted_Criminal_Krunk.text4: The outlaw Kronk has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Kwe_Wanted_Criminal_Ivar.title: Bounty Notice - Ivar
Mission_Kwe_Wanted_Criminal_Ivar.text3: A slave who murdered his master was spotted near the Halbert Harpoonery.
Mission_Kwe_Wanted_Criminal_Ivar.text4: The outlaw Ivar has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Kwe_Wanted_Criminal_Snaggle.title: Bounty Notice - Snaggle
Mission_Kwe_Wanted_Criminal_Snaggle.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for illegally looting an ore vein in Pailune.
Mission_Kwe_Wanted_Criminal_Snaggle.text4: The outlaw Snaggle has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Kwe_Wanted_Criminal_Snira.title: Bounty Notice - Sienna
Mission_Kwe_Wanted_Criminal_Snira.text3: Rumor has it that an outlaw plundering Pailune's ancient relics has been spotted across the forests of Pailune.
Mission_Kwe_Wanted_Criminal_Snira.text4: The outlaw Sienna has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Kwe_Wanted_Criminal_Patrick.title: Bounty Notice - Patrick
Mission_Kwe_Wanted_Criminal_Patrick.text3: A drunk pickpocket is on the loose in Pailune.
Mission_Kwe_Wanted_Criminal_Patrick.text4: The outlaw Patrick has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_Kwe_Wanted_Criminal_Jonathan.title: Bounty Notice - Jonathan
Mission_Kwe_Wanted_Criminal_Jonathan.text3: An outlaw has a bounty for pickpocketing as a hobby in Pailune.
Mission_Kwe_Wanted_Criminal_Jonathan.text4: The outlaw Jonathan has been handed over to the guards.

Mission_RescuePailuneLeader_Finale.title: The Empty Seat
Mission_RescuePailuneLeader_Finale.text3: Marius has been updated about Pailune's leadership candidates.
Mission_RescuePailuneLeader_Finale.text4: Marius expressed regret and said that the new leader Clemens will be motivated to do better, taking on the responsibilities of the other candidates.

Mission_Pailune_Daily_DeceptionForest.title: Forest of Deception
Mission_Pailune_Daily_DeceptionForest.text3: There are white mushrooms on the way to Wayward Woods.
Mission_Pailune_Daily_DeceptionForest.text4: Shadows revealed themselves among spores while carefully treading through the mushrooms.

Mission_Pailune_Daily_Woodcutter.title: Captured Woodcutter
Mission_Pailune_Daily_Woodcutter.text3: There is a captured woodcutter at the upper Denn River.
Mission_Pailune_Daily_Woodcutter.text4: The threat of the Black Bears reaches all across Pailune.

Mission_Pailune_Daily_PailuneMine.title: Ancient Mine
Mission_Pailune_Daily_PailuneMine.text3: The Jackals were encountered inside the mine.
Mission_Pailune_Daily_PailuneMine.text4: The patrolling Jackals were encountered inside the Pailune mine.

Mission_Pailune_Daily_SummitHostage.title: Captive on a Hill
Mission_Pailune_Daily_SummitHostage.text3: There is a person captured by bandits on top of a hill.
Mission_Pailune_Daily_SummitHostage.text4: The captured person was rescued from the bandits.

Mission_Pailune_Daily_RuinsSecret.title: Secret of the Ruins
Mission_Pailune_Daily_RuinsSecret.text3: A man stands by the ruins, calling out for help.
Mission_Pailune_Daily_RuinsSecret.text4: After defeating the attacking bandits and examining the surroundings, the man's claims seemed to be true.

Mission_Pailune_Daily_SurvivalStruggle.title: Struggle for Survival
Mission_Pailune_Daily_SurvivalStruggle.text3: A man stands by the lake, calling out for help.
Mission_Pailune_Daily_SurvivalStruggle.text4: Mistwood hunters ambushed the man while he was being escorted, making him flee in a panic.

Mission_Pailune_Daily_RemainingEnemies.title: Remaining Threat
Mission_Pailune_Daily_RemainingEnemies.text3: There are still remaining Black Bears.
Mission_Pailune_Daily_RemainingEnemies.text4: Pailune proved how strong their spirit is.

Mission_Pailune_Daily_GuardianStatue.title: Statue that Protects the Village
Mission_Pailune_Daily_GuardianStatue.text3: Rescue the person captured by the Black Bears.

Mission_Pailune_RonHardt.title: Ronnard's Request
Mission_Pailune_RonHardt.text3: Ronnard of Pailune has requested for some fur hide, saying his hands are freezing.
Mission_Pailune_RonHardt.text4: The hide was delivered. Ronnard smiled, saying his hands can feel some warmth now.

Mission_Pailune_Terinand.title: Terianne's Request
Mission_Pailune_Terinand.text3: Terianne of Pailune has requested for some flowers to repel the insects drawn to her meat.
Mission_Pailune_Terinand.text4: The flowers that help repel insects were delivered. They should not fly around the meat anymore.

Mission_Pailune_Gorio.title: Gorio's Request
Mission_Pailune_Gorio.text3: Gorio of Skoghorn has requested some leather to make armor that can protect against the cold.
Mission_Pailune_Gorio.text4: The leather was delivered. A spirit of a strong warrior filled his eyes.

Mission_Pailune_Henri.title: Harry's Request
Mission_Pailune_Henri.text3: Harry of Pailune has requested the delivery of repaired tools to their owners.
Mission_Pailune_Henri.text4: The tools were delivered. He seemed delighted to see them repaired so perfectly.

Mission_Pailune_Aeba.title: Ava's Request
Mission_Pailune_Aeba.text3: Ava of Pailune has requested to bring her the delicious fish caught from the river in front of the village, to make even tastier fried fish.
Mission_Pailune_Aeba.text4: The fish was delivered. Looks like the tavern will be crowded tonight.

Mission_Pailune_Bargul.title: Bargul's Request
Mission_Pailune_Bargul.text3: Bargul of Odeck has requested some stones to repair the village.
Mission_Pailune_Bargul.text4: Some stones have been delivered. It's not much, but if they keep stacking them up one by one, the village will eventually regain its former appearance.

Mission_Pailune_Lenard.title: Leonard's Request
Mission_Pailune_Lenard.text3: Leonard, the tanner, has requested for information on whether the village's leather craftsman is willing to work with him.
Mission_Pailune_Lenard.text4: Leonard was told the artisan would come as soon as he finishes his current task. The shop gained a new pair of hands.

Mission_Pailune_Baris.title: Varis's Request
Mission_Pailune_Baris.text3: Varis of Pailune has requested for some delicious forest mushrooms so that he can sell a new product.
Mission_Pailune_Baris.text4: The mushrooms were delivered. He seemed very content with their aroma.

Mission_Pailune_Gonthyr.title: Gunter's Request
Mission_Pailune_Gonthyr.text3: The arms dealer Gunter has requested to deliver a dagger crafted for the coming-of-age ceremony.
Mission_Pailune_Gonthyr.text4: The dagger, forged by Gunter's hands, was safely delivered. It carried the enduring traditions of Pailune.

Mission_Pailune_Lora.title: Lola's Request
Mission_Pailune_Lora.text3: Lola wants to create an outfit inspired by butterfly wing patterns. She needs a few meadow butterflies to help with her design.
Mission_Pailune_Lora.text4: Lola's received the meadow butterflies. Soon she'll be stitching up beautiful garments inspired by them.

Mission_Pailune_Aldred.title: Eldred's Request
Mission_Pailune_Aldred.text3: Eldred the saddler ran out of hay to lay on the stable floor, and has requested to ask around the village if they can spare some for her.
Mission_Pailune_Aldred.text4: She was told that she could receive straw bales. Eldred, delighted by the news, said the horses would now be able to rest well.

Mission_Pailune_Ratko.title: Rocco's Request
Mission_Pailune_Ratko.text3: Rocco the provisioner has requested to deliver the ordered shovel he forgot to deliver in his stead.
Mission_Pailune_Ratko.text4: The shovel was safely delivered to him. He should be able to clear the snow without problem now.

Mission_Pailune_Richart.title: Richart's Request
Mission_Pailune_Richart.text3: Richart has requested for some centipede, claiming liquor made from it is invigorating.
Mission_Pailune_Richart.text4: Centipedes were handed over to Richart. Seeing them, he smiled with satisfaction.

Mission_Pailune_FishTrap.title: News in the Fish Trap
Mission_Pailune_FishTrap.text3: A man who appears to have back pain looks troubled.
Mission_Pailune_FishTrap.text4: The fish from the trap has been delivered. The man handed over a fish to show his gratitude.

Mission_Pailune_WarmthColdWave.title: Warmth in the Cold Wave
Mission_Pailune_WarmthColdWave.text3: A soldier at the fortress has requested for some meat to lift his spirits on this cold day.
Mission_Pailune_WarmthColdWave.text4: Some meat was handed over to the soldiers. They will probably have a slightly warmer day today.

Mission_Pailune_TroubleMaker.title: Troublemakers by the River
Mission_Pailune_TroubleMaker.text3: The construction work is not going well because of the flies buzzing around the village riverside.
Mission_Pailune_TroubleMaker.text4: The pesky flies were dealt with. The man was grateful, saying that he can finally breathe easy now.

Mission_Pailune_BackhillBandits.title: Shadows of the Mountain Behind the Village
Mission_Pailune_BackhillBandits.text3: A man from the leatherworks has requested for help with the bandits threatening the village from the mountain behind it.
Mission_Pailune_BackhillBandits.text4: The bandits were dealt with. The man could not stop showing his gratitude for the help.

Mission_Pailune_Lauric.title: Sculpting Beauty from the Horns
Mission_Pailune_Lauric.text3: Laurick of Pailune has requested a horn, saying he wants to dye a large horn and make it into a decoration.
Mission_Pailune_Lauric.text4: The horn has been handed over. Laurick couldn't take his eyes off it for a while.

Mission_Pailune_Festivities.title: Before the Mood Dies Down
Mission_Pailune_Festivities.text3: A man watching a performance at Pailune has requested to bring him more alcohol.
Mission_Pailune_Festivities.text4: The alcohol was delivered. Looks like the theater will be lively today as well.

Mission_Pailune_RedFish.title: A Plate of the Lake
Mission_Pailune_RedFish.text3: A villager in Odeck has promised a delicious meal in exchange for a red fish.
Mission_Pailune_RedFish.text4: The red fish was delivered. The meal looked delicious and mouth-watering.

Mission_Pailune_VegetableBox.title: Missing Vegetable Box
Mission_Pailune_VegetableBox.text3: A farmer has requested to deliver the vegetables that were supposed to be loaded to a wagon bound for the village.
Mission_Pailune_VegetableBox.text4: The farmer was told the vegetables were delivered. The wild garlic received smelled stronger than the normal ones.

Mission_Pailune_FragrantMushrooms.title: A Cup of Fragrant Tea
Mission_Pailune_FragrantMushrooms.text3: A man who loves tea has requested for some fresh mushrooms, saying he wants to make a tea with a rich aroma.
Mission_Pailune_FragrantMushrooms.text4: Some aromatic mushrooms were delivered to the man. The other tea he had also gave off a pleasant scent.

Mission_Pailune_LakeDelicacies.title: Delicacy of the Lake
Mission_Pailune_LakeDelicacies.text3: A weary-looking man has requested for some frogs, saying they will help him regain his strength.
Mission_Pailune_LakeDelicacies.text4: The frogs were handed over to the man, but it is uncertain if they will actually make him regain his strength.

Mission_Pailune_WinterWarmth.title: Firewood that Melts Away the Cold
Mission_Pailune_WinterWarmth.text3: Linden of Pailune Castle wants some firewood for those shivering in the cold.
Mission_Pailune_WinterWarmth.text4: The firewood was delivered. It should help people fight the cold even if by a little.

Mission_Pailune_BoostingFruit.title: A Vitality-Boosting Fruit
Mission_Pailune_BoostingFruit.text3: A man from Svinholt Ranch has requested for some fruits to make a special feed for his pigs that seem weary.
Mission_Pailune_BoostingFruit.text4: Some fresh fruits were delivered. The pigs should regain their strength after eating the special feed.

Mission_Pailune_FrozenVillage.title: The Ember of the Frozen Village
Mission_Pailune_FrozenVillage.text3: A man shivering in cold at Skoghorn Farm has requested for some firewood.
Mission_Pailune_FrozenVillage.text4: The timber has been handed over. Looks like the man will have a warm night.

Mission_Pailune_SecretFishingRod.title: Our Secret Mission
Mission_Pailune_SecretFishingRod.text3: At the fishing spot, a man has requested for a fishing rod. He wants it handed to him as if it were a gift from a friend, without his wife noticing.
Mission_Pailune_SecretFishingRod.text4: The man received the fishing rod. He feigned surprise, but his eyes were full of excitement. The thought of him sneaking off to fish again without his wife knowing was amusing.

Mission_Pailune_FriendArmWrestling.title: Arm Wrestling of the Wages
Mission_Pailune_FriendArmWrestling.text3: A man from the village seems to be looking for a Greymane to break someone's arm wrestling win streak at the tavern.
Mission_Pailune_FriendArmWrestling.text4: The arm wrestling ended in victory. The man was excited at the thought of claiming his winnings from his friend's coinpurse.

Mission_Pailune_FishingHunter.title: The Hunter Who Can't Fish
Mission_Pailune_FishingHunter.text3: A hunter from Skoghorn wasn't any good at fishing and has requested to catch some fresh fish for the children.
Mission_Pailune_FishingHunter.text4: The hunter was handed the fresh fish. It's heartwarming to think about how happy the children would be.

Mission_HorpbothHarpoonery_Sheep_Normal_.title: Lightning on a Harpoon
Mission_HorpbothHarpoonery_Sheep_Normal_.text3: A thunderbolt struck, causing all the sheep to flee. Help the shepherd.
Mission_HorpbothHarpoonery_Sheep_Normal_.text4: The shepherd expressed gratitude for finding the sheep.

Mission_DoubleStepPass_Block_Start.title: Path of the Black Bears
Mission_DoubleStepPass_Block_Start.text3: The Black Bears have occupied Twinpath Post.
Mission_DoubleStepPass_Block_Start.text4: The Black Bears occupying Twinpath Post were defeated.

Mission_RidgePath_Block_Start.title: Footprint of the Black Bears
Mission_RidgePath_Block_Start.text3: The Black Bears have occupied Ridgepath Post.
Mission_RidgePath_Block_Start.text4: The Black Bears occupying Ridgepath Post were defeated.

Mission_Brokenford_Block_Start.title: Blockaded Waterway
Mission_Brokenford_Block_Start.text3: The Lonely Jackals have occupied the Whispering Forest Dock.
Mission_Brokenford_Block_Start.text4: The Lonely Jackals occupying the Whispering Forest Dock were defeated.

Mission_RidgehunterLeatherMaker_Block_Mo.title: Uninvited Guests of Wayward Woods
Mission_RidgehunterLeatherMaker_Block_Mo.text3: The Mistwood Hunters have occupied Ridgehunter Tannery.
Mission_RidgehunterLeatherMaker_Block_Mo.text4: The Mistwood Hunters occupying Ridgehunter Tannery were defeated.

Mission_Node_Kwe_WildhuntCamp.title: Trace in the Hunting Grounds
Mission_Node_Kwe_WildhuntCamp.text3: The Black Bears have occupied the Beast Hunters' Camp.
Mission_Node_Kwe_WildhuntCamp.text4: The Black Bears occupying the Beast Hunters' Camp were defeated.

Mission_QuietSnowShelter_Block_Start.title: Deep-Rooted Sorrow
Mission_QuietSnowShelter_Block_Start.text3: It sounds like someone is crying inside a house in Skoghorn. Head to the house and see what's going on.
Mission_QuietSnowShelter_Block_Start.text4: The area was searched after White Horn was defeated, but the child was nowhere to be found. While the news of the failed search was being delivered, the child, who had escaped and hid from the bandits, returned on his own.

Mission_QuietSnowShelter_Block_Battle.title: White Horn of Snowhaven Hearth
Mission_QuietSnowShelter_Block_Battle.text3: The bandits have taken the child into the Argent Peaks. Find the child.
Mission_QuietSnowShelter_Block_Battle.text4: White Horn, the mountain spirit, attacked while fighting the bandits to rescue the child. Even after the giant creature was defeated, the boy could not be found.

Mission_QuietSnowShelter_Block_WhiteHorn.title: Shadow Over the Snowy Mountains
Mission_QuietSnowShelter_Block_WhiteHorn.text3: The White Horn followers have seized Snowhaven Hearth.
Mission_QuietSnowShelter_Block_WhiteHorn.text4: The White Horn followers have been driven from Snowhaven Hearth. Tranquility has returned to the snowy mountains once more.

Mission_SkallcoveVillage_Block_II_Start.title: The Jackals' Scheme
Mission_SkallcoveVillage_Block_II_Start.text3: The Lonely Jackals have seized Skallcove. Drive them out and liberate the village.
Mission_SkallcoveVillage_Block_II_Start.text4: The threat strangling the village eased as the Jackals were driven away. Talk to Skallcove's chief.

Mission_WindsongMountain_Block_Start.title: The Clue for Chaos
Mission_WindsongMountain_Block_Start.text3: Someone might know how this chaos began.
Mission_WindsongMountain_Block_Start.text4: It turned out the chaos began at the broken altar.

Mission_WindsongMountain_Block_Coil.title: Ancient Barrier
Mission_WindsongMountain_Block_Coil.text3: Legend says that there used to be a barrier protecting Windsong Peaks, where lightning strike constantly since long ago.
Mission_WindsongMountain_Block_Coil.text4: The lightning subsided once the barrier was restored. However, an ominous energy still remains at the top of the mountain.

Mission_WindsongMountain_Block_Boss.title: Fallen God
Mission_WindsongMountain_Block_Boss.text3: The barrier has been restored, but the source of the lightning still remains. Defeat the fallen god at the mountain's peak.
Mission_WindsongMountain_Block_Boss.text4: The fallen god was defeated. The lightning that rained upon Windsong Peaks began to subside as well.

Mission_WindsongMountain_Block_Complete.title: Restored Balance
Mission_WindsongMountain_Block_Complete.text3: Share what happened at Windsong Peaks with the village. Skallcove will find peace again.
Mission_WindsongMountain_Block_Complete.text4: Balance was restored to Windsong Peaks. The long-forgotten peace of Skallcove began to return as well.

Mission_DelesyiaCastle_NeutralZoneResear.title: Blazing Steel
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_NeutralZoneResear.text3: They need even greater firepower for a powerful weapon.
Mission_DelesyiaCastle_NeutralZoneResear.text4: Gunpowder needed to enhance firepower was handed over. They should be able to craft even deadlier weapons now.

Mission_GorthakIronMaker_Research_BestSk.title: Skilled Workflow Optimization Research
Mission_GorthakIronMaker_Research_BestSk.text3: It seems like a key facility of the ironworks.
Mission_GorthakIronMaker_Research_BestSk.text4: You learned about the skilled workflow optimization research.

Mission_GorthakIronMaker_Research_FireWe.title: Weapon Heat-Treatment Research
Mission_GorthakIronMaker_Research_FireWe.text3: It seems like a key facility of the ironworks.
Mission_GorthakIronMaker_Research_FireWe.text4: You learned about the weapon heat-treatment research.

Mission_GorthakIronMaker_Research_Sulfur.title: Brimstone Research
Mission_GorthakIronMaker_Research_Sulfur.text3: Weapons that use gunpowder are deployed at the front line.
Mission_GorthakIronMaker_Research_Sulfur.text4: You learned about the brimstone research.

Mission_GorthakIronMaker_Research_Effici.title: Mineral Excavation Efficiency Research
Mission_GorthakIronMaker_Research_Effici.text4: You learned about the mineral excavation efficiency research.

Mission_GorthakIron_ResearchStop_Reserch.title: Halted Taro Research
Mission_GorthakIron_ResearchStop_Reserch.text3: The research has been halted. Assistance may be needed.
Mission_GorthakIron_ResearchStop_Reserch.text4: The research on taro was resumed.

Mission_GorthakIron_ResearchStop_Reserch.title: Halted Brimstone Research
Mission_GorthakIron_ResearchStop_Reserch.text3: The research has been halted. Assistance may be needed.
Mission_GorthakIron_ResearchStop_Reserch.text4: The research on brimstone was resumed.

Mission_GorthakIron_Normal_KuKuATAG.title: New Designs
Mission_GorthakIron_Normal_KuKuATAG.text3: Marek, the artisan who crafted the A.T.A.G., has discovered something new.
Mission_GorthakIron_Normal_KuKuATAG.text4: You received the small kuku A.T.A.G. design note from Marek.

Mission_GorthakIron_Normal_KuKuATAG_Mate.title: Preparing for New Skills
Mission_GorthakIron_Normal_KuKuATAG_Mate.text3: Find Grimnir, the one who crafted the pot using the materials listed on the note.
Mission_GorthakIron_Normal_KuKuATAG_Mate.text4: A new machine was crafted in Grimnir's workshop by combining materials with the pot.

Mission_GorthakIron_Normal_Complete.title: The Pinnacle of Technical Skill
Mission_GorthakIron_Normal_Complete.text3: Take the finished product back to Marek.
Mission_GorthakIron_Normal_Complete.text4: Marek showed interest in new crafting possibilities as he examined the finished result.

Mission_Marni_OutPost_Block_Start.title: Blade of Discipline
Mission_Marni_OutPost_Block_Start.text3: Defeat the leader of the Machina Knights who has seized the outpost.
Mission_Marni_OutPost_Block_Start.text4: The leader of the Machina Knights in Marni's outpost was defeated. The obstacle blocking the abandoned trade route has been cleared.

Mission_Marni_OutPost_Block_SubNode.title: Scars of War
Mission_Marni_OutPost_Block_SubNode.text3: A Marni machine force has occupied the ruined village.
Mission_Marni_OutPost_Block_SubNode.text4: The Marni machine force occupying the ruined village were defeated.

Mission_Shadow_Whisper_Cave_Witch.title: The Hermit Witch
Mission_Shadow_Whisper_Cave_Witch.text3: White Crow has pointed you toward an expert in Abyss gears. Head to the location she mentioned.
Mission_Shadow_Whisper_Cave_Witch.text4: You met someone in the hidden cave who can handle Abyss gears.

Mission_WitchHouse_Witch_Normal_Meet.title: The Witch of Wisdom
Mission_WitchHouse_Witch_Normal_Meet.text3: They say witches live in hidden locations throughout Pywel.
Mission_WitchHouse_Witch_Normal_Meet.text4: Elowen the Witch gave her crafting recipe book as a reward for cleansing the sanctum.

Mission_WitchHouse_Witch_Normal_SanctumO.title: Sanctum of Absolution
Mission_WitchHouse_Witch_Normal_SanctumO.text4: The Sanctum of Absolution was cleansed.

Mission_WitchHouse_Witch_Normal_SanctumO.title: Sanctum of Temperance
Mission_WitchHouse_Witch_Normal_SanctumO.text4: The Sanctum of Temperance was cleansed.

Mission_WitchHouse_Witch_Normal_SanctumO.title: Sanctum of Penitence
Mission_WitchHouse_Witch_Normal_SanctumO.text4: The Sanctum of Penitence was cleansed.

Mission_WitchHouse_Witch_Normal_SanctumO.title: Sanctum of Benediction
Mission_WitchHouse_Witch_Normal_SanctumO.text4: The Sanctum of Benediction was cleansed.

Mission_RedLake_Witch_Normal_Meet.title: The Witch of Kindness
Mission_RedLake_Witch_Normal_Meet.text3: They say witches live in hidden locations throughout Pywel.
Mission_RedLake_Witch_Normal_Meet.text4: Bari the Witch gave her crafting recipe book as a reward for cleansing the sanctum.

Mission_RedLake_Witch_Normal_SanctumOfEx.title: Sanctum of Exaltation
Mission_RedLake_Witch_Normal_SanctumOfEx.text4: The Sanctum of Exaltation was cleansed.

Mission_RedLake_Witch_Normal_SanctumOfSo.title: Sanctum of Solace
Mission_RedLake_Witch_Normal_SanctumOfSo.text4: The Sanctum of Solace was cleansed.

Mission_RedLake_Witch_Normal_SanctumOfDe.title: Sanctum of Deliverance
Mission_RedLake_Witch_Normal_SanctumOfDe.text4: The Sanctum of Deliverance was cleansed.

Mission_RedLake_Witch_Normal_SanctumOfAt.title: Sanctum of Atonement
Mission_RedLake_Witch_Normal_SanctumOfAt.text4: The Sanctum of Atonement was cleansed.

Mission_HiddenCave_Witch_Normal_Meet.title: The Witch of Humility
Mission_HiddenCave_Witch_Normal_Meet.text3: They say witches live in hidden locations throughout Pywel.
Mission_HiddenCave_Witch_Normal_Meet.text4: Lyselia the Witch gave her crafting recipe book as a reward for cleansing the sanctum.

Mission_HiddenCave_Witch_Normal_SanctumO.title: Sanctum of Devotion
Mission_HiddenCave_Witch_Normal_SanctumO.text4: The Sanctum of Devotion was cleansed.

Mission_HiddenCave_Witch_Normal_SanctumO.title: Sanctum of Veneration
Mission_HiddenCave_Witch_Normal_SanctumO.text4: The Sanctum of Veneration was cleansed.

Mission_HiddenCave_Witch_Normal_Temple_0.title: Sanctum of Oblation
Mission_HiddenCave_Witch_Normal_Temple_0.text4: The Sanctum of Oblation was cleansed.

Mission_HiddenCave_Witch_Normal_Temple_0.title: Sanctum of Faith
Mission_HiddenCave_Witch_Normal_Temple_0.text4: The Sanctum of Faith was cleansed.

Mission_Crimson_Desert_Witch_Normal_Meet.title: The Witch of Strength
Mission_Crimson_Desert_Witch_Normal_Meet.text3: They say witches live in hidden locations throughout Pywel.
Mission_Crimson_Desert_Witch_Normal_Meet.text4: Areciel the Witch gave her crafting recipe book as a reward for cleansing the sanctum.

Mission_Crimson_Desert_Witch_Normal_Sanc.title: Sanctum of Expiation
Mission_Crimson_Desert_Witch_Normal_Sanc.text4: The Sanctum of Expiation was cleansed.

Mission_Crimson_Desert_Witch_Normal_Sanc.title: Sanctum of Renunciation
Mission_Crimson_Desert_Witch_Normal_Sanc.text4: The Sanctum of Renunciation was cleansed.

Mission_Crimson_Desert_Witch_Normal_Sanc.title: Sanctum of Revelation
Mission_Crimson_Desert_Witch_Normal_Sanc.text4: The Sanctum of Revelation was cleansed.

Mission_Wayward_Woods_Witch_Normal_Meet.title: Protector of the Abyss
Mission_Wayward_Woods_Witch_Normal_Meet.text3: All of the Witch's Tokens have been acquired.
Mission_Wayward_Woods_Witch_Normal_Meet.text4: Slotting in the Witch's Tokens into a tree in Wayward Woods opened the door, leading to White Crow the Witch.

Mission_BraveNest_Armor.title: Wings of Iron
Mission_BraveNest_Armor.text3: You received a recipe for the Abyssal Fusion from White Crow for defeating Golden Star.
Mission_BraveNest_Armor.text4: Blackstar, clad in Abyssal Dragon Armor, spread its giant wings toward the skies.

Mission_Intro_Tutorial_I.title: Unfamiliar Lands
Mission_Intro_Tutorial_I.text3: Head to the cabin where your comrades are gathered.
Mission_Intro_Tutorial_I.text4: The Greymanes took a moment to catch their breath at a secluded cabin, but the Black Bears' dogged pursuit is far from over.

Mission_Intro_MainBattle.title: In Ashes
Mission_Intro_MainBattle.text3: Seek out your scattered comrades and fight alongside them.
Mission_Intro_MainBattle.text4: The Black Bears' ambush scattered the Greymanes, leaving  no time to check for survivors.

Mission_Intro_Abyss_Tutorial.title: Realm of Uncertainty
Mission_Intro_Abyss_Tutorial.text3: You've awoken in an unknown place. Find a way forward.
Mission_Intro_Abyss_Tutorial.text4: The strange realm was impossible to define, suspended between dream and reality. There, you regained your lost sense of self.

Mission_Intro_After_Horse.title: New Journey
Mission_Intro_After_Horse.text3: Your wounds have healed, and you are back on your feet. It is time to search for your scattered comrades.
Mission_Intro_After_Horse.text4: You repaid a small portion of your debt to Sebastian. Head to the Hernand Tavern to gather information and begin your search for the scattered Greymanes.

Mission_MeetAlustain_Alustain_Strength.title: Where Rumors Gather
Mission_MeetAlustain_Alustain_Strength.text3: Enter the tavern to gather information.
Mission_MeetAlustain_Alustain_Strength.text4: There was little information to be found at the tavern, but an arm wrestling match proved profitable.

Mission_MeetAlustain_Alustain_Wisdom.title: A Mysterious Beggar
Mission_MeetAlustain_Alustain_Wisdom.text3: There is a commotion near the sewer by the tavern. Children are taunting an old beggar lying on the ground.
Mission_MeetAlustain_Alustain_Wisdom.text4: Thankful to be shown kindness, an old beggar handed over a wooden key, uttered a few enigmatic words, and suddenly disappeared.

Mission_MeetAlustain_Alchemist_Rescue.title: True Wisdom in Kindness
Mission_MeetAlustain_Alchemist_Rescue.text3: Strange sounds are coming from the iron grate the old beggar was lying on top of.
Mission_MeetAlustain_Alchemist_Rescue.text4: You received a letter and a word of thanks before the noblewoman you freed vanished from the sewer.

Mission_MeetAlustain_Alustain_CatchCat.title: A Transcendent Connection
Mission_MeetAlustain_Alustain_CatchCat.text3: Explore the town. You might find something interesting.
Mission_MeetAlustain_Alustain_CatchCat.text4: You rescued the cat stuck on a rooftop and returned him to his owner. The thankful child told you to head for the watchtower before disappearing, accidentally dropping a pendant on the ground in their haste.

Mission_MeetAlustain_Alchemist_Cleaning.title: Actions Speak Volumes
Mission_MeetAlustain_Alchemist_Cleaning.text3: Explore the town. You might find something interesting.
Mission_MeetAlustain_Alchemist_Cleaning.text4: You cleared the chimney of the smoking house and received a fine attire as a reward.

Mission_MeetAlustain_Alchemist_Chamber.title: Mystical Key
Mission_MeetAlustain_Alchemist_Chamber.text3: A strange aura emanates from the key the old man handed you.
Mission_MeetAlustain_Alchemist_Chamber.text4: The shabby wooden key suddenly transformed into an intricate steel one. It unlocked a room inside the castle where one of the walls within split open, revealing a dazzling, radiant passage beyond.

Mission_MeetAlustain_Alustain_WhiteWolf.title: Faced With the Truth
Mission_MeetAlustain_Alustain_WhiteWolf.text3: The dazzling gate led to a place filled with mysterious energy. Examine the massive building up ahead.
Mission_MeetAlustain_Alustain_WhiteWolf.text4: The building was filled with endless rows of books. The old beggar introduced himself as Alustin, the overseer of the Axiom Archive, and implored you to restore the balance of the Abyss.

Mission_MeetAlustain_Alustain_AbyssGate.title: The Faltering Abyss
Mission_MeetAlustain_Alustain_AbyssGate.text3: After the blinding light subsided, you found yourself once more outside the building. Restore the Abyss according to Alustin's advice.
Mission_MeetAlustain_Alustain_AbyssGate.text4: With some effort, the Abyss' balance was corrected and its original state restored.

Mission_MeetAlustain_Alustain_Witch.title: Woman in White
Mission_MeetAlustain_Alustain_Witch.text3: A woman in white appears to be waiting. Approach the mysterious woman.
Mission_MeetAlustain_Alustain_Witch.text4: The woman introduced herself as White Crow, guardian of the Abyss, and then bestowed the power to soar through the skies. You returned the faith Alustin and White Crow placed in you by trusting their words and intentions.

Mission_UnexpectedGift_GoBackDailyRoutin.title: Return to Everyday Life
Mission_UnexpectedGift_GoBackDailyRoutin.text3: With your strange journey behind you, you returned to Hernand. Head to your tent and reflect on all that has transpired.
Mission_UnexpectedGift_GoBackDailyRoutin.text4: Suddenly, the words of the shai who told you to visit the watchtower came to mind. Did she have something to talk about?

Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_UnexpectedGift.title: Where the Light Leads
Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_UnexpectedGift.text3: The cat you rescued from the roof snatched the pendant the moment you took it out and ran off. Head in the direction it disappeared.
Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_UnexpectedGift.text4: Chasing after cat with the pendant in its mouth led to a watchtower occupied by goblins.

Mission_UnexpectedGift_MemoryChip.title: Memory Fragment
Mission_UnexpectedGift_MemoryChip.text3: You spot an unusual object in the corner of the watchtower. Examine it.
Mission_UnexpectedGift_MemoryChip.text4: Upon donning a strange helmet, the form of a man materialized. He referred to the helmet as a "visione." After a cryptic and rambling explanation, he vanished like a phantom. Just what is this object?

Mission_UnexpectedGift_Liftable.title: Reunion
Mission_UnexpectedGift_Liftable.text3: The familiar figure of Rulupee, the shai who lost their cat, has appeared near the watchtower.
Mission_UnexpectedGift_Liftable.text4: The cat led you to a spot marked by a mysterious stone lantern. After training in a meditative trance, you awakened a new power.

Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_DoubleKickMatias.title: For Honor
Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_DoubleKickMatias.text3: There is a group talking about the Greymanes. Speak with them to see if they have information regarding your comrades' whereabouts.
Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_DoubleKickMatias.text4: A knight named Matthias, eager to test his skills against a Greymane, proposed a duel. Arrogant as he was, it didn't take long to put the knight in his place.

Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_Barden_FirstMeet.title: Awestruck
Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_Barden_FirstMeet.text3: A man has been watching as if waiting for the duel to end. See what he wants.
Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_Barden_FirstMeet.text4: A man, with a mysterious woman beside him, introduced himself as the Marshal of Hernand. He spoke of the hardships caused by bandits and requested aid from the Greymanes. As compensation, he offered his full support in helping reestablish the Greymanes.

Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_SpringtideWatermi.title: Shadow Over the River
Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_SpringtideWatermi.text3: Bandits have taken control of both the floodgate and bridge, the lifelines of Hernand. They are robbing travelers and obstructing the water flow, causing the entire town to suffer.
Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_SpringtideWatermi.text4: The bandits that held the town's water supply hostage were driven out. Peace has returned to the town and surrounding farmland.

Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_HernandRequestBoa.title: A Collection of Woes
Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_HernandRequestBoa.text3: True to the marshal's word, the mood in the village is tense. A string of suspicious incidents seems to be at the root of it all. Check the notice board to get the full picture.
Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_HernandRequestBoa.text4: The notice board was filled with various news, and suspicious incidents could be seen.

Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_Bremer_FirstMeet.title: Trial After Trial
Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_Bremer_FirstMeet.text3: A citizen of the town has apparently lost his cattle to bandits, leaving him with no means of livelihood. Listen to the farmer's story.
Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_Bremer_FirstMeet.text4: Farmer Bremer was devastated. A boulder from the sky destroyed his home and his cattle were stolen. The culprits were apparently looking for something more important than cattle, a detail that makes this whole affair feel far too suspicious for simple banditry.

Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_Ibano_FirstMeet.title: Down in the Muck
Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_Ibano_FirstMeet.text3: A rancher says bandits have cut off the precious horns of his goats. Listen to his story.
Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_Ibano_FirstMeet.text4: Ibano, a hot-tempered rancher, was reeling from a recent break-in, but the thieves weren't after his coin, they were in search of some stone. Someone is clearly using these bandits as pawns to secretly seek something out.

Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_Willian_FirstMeet.title: Missing Companion
Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_Willian_FirstMeet.text3: Unknown assailants have apparently taken a child's animal companion, Wooly, by force. Listen to the child's story.
Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_Willian_FirstMeet.text4: The sheep was recovered from the bandits, but Willian remained upset, claiming that the sheep is not Wooly.

Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_ThiefCave.title: Shadowed Secrets
Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_ThiefCave.text3: They say there's a Greymane in town. Look for your potential comrade.
Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_ThiefCave.text4: The alleged local Greymane turned out to be just a drunkard. Still, his account of the bandits' behavior supports the marshal's suspicions. There's definitely a greater power pulling their strings.

Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_GoldenShadow_dlc.title: In the Shade of the Goldleaves
Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_GoldenShadow_dlc.text3: You dealt with the events in Hernand. The evidence suggests that a single person may be behind them.
Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_GoldenShadow_dlc.text4: The circumstances surrounding the events in Hernand point toward Kailok, the new head of the Goldleaf Merchant Guild. Gather some information about him at the Goldleaf Trading Post.

Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_TwinkleManner.title: The Dark Veil
Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_TwinkleManner.text3: The guards who arrived to handle the situation mentioned something about the Goldleaf Merchant Guild. Pay a visit to the market at the edge of town.
Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_TwinkleManner.text4: You met Shakatu, trademaster of the Goldleaf Merchant Guild. He expressed he had nothing to do with the problems plaguing Hernand and took his leave, promising that your paths would cross again.

Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_GoblinCompany_New.title: The Flames of Greed
Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_GoblinCompany_New.text3: A nun is calling for help in the middle of the road. See what's going on.
Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_GoblinCompany_New.text4: Bandits torched a healer's home in search of a stone fragment that turned out to be an Abyss artifact. It's clear that someone in the Goldleaf Merchant Guild is orchestrating these events.

Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_GoblinCompany_Hub.title: Kidnapped Healer
Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_GoblinCompany_Hub.text3: Bandits have kidnapped Hubert, the healer. Rescue him and listen to his full account of the events that transpired.
Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_GoblinCompany_Hub.text4: Hubert the healer, trembling and rambling, laid the blame squarely at the feet of the current branchmaster, the "Hornsplitter." He lamented that, had Shakatu taken the lead, such tragedy would have been avoided. The full truth of this incident has finally come to light.

Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_GoblinCompany_Sha.title: Rebellion or Revolution
Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_GoblinCompany_Sha.text3: Go to the Goldleaf Merchant Guild to confirm the details of the incidents in Hernand and settle the matter once and for all.
Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_GoblinCompany_Sha.text4: Shakatu named the current branchmaster as the mastermind behind the chaos and asked for aid in dethroning him. He spoke of a future partnership and revealed that the Marquis of Hernand likely intends to grant the Greymanes land as a reward for resolving this matter.

Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_Battle.title: Resounding Victory
Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_Battle.text3: Find and defeat the Hornsplitter to resolve the matter.
Mission_SplitHorn_Boss_Battle.text4: You felled Hornsplitter in the middle of the Goldleaf headquarters. Without a moment's hesitation, Shakatu ascended the blood-soaked throne. Watching him deliver a speech to his fellow goblins that seemed far too well-rehearsed left you conflicted about his true intentions.

Mission_GreyWolf_Camp_Start.title: Old Friend
Mission_GreyWolf_Camp_Start.text3: The Goldleaves had some information on someone calling himself a Greymane. Go look for him in the back alleys of Hernand.
Mission_GreyWolf_Camp_Start.text4: In a quiet back alley, you reunited with Marius, who now walked with a noticeable limp. Though his appearance was ragged, he was brimming with hope. It won't be long before the Greymanes are all reunited again.

Mission_GreyWolf_Camp_SerkisGift.title: First Step to Rebuilding
Mission_GreyWolf_Camp_SerkisGift.text3: Rebuilding the Greymanes will require a reliable and powerful ally. Go meet with Marquis Serkis.
Mission_GreyWolf_Camp_SerkisGift.text4: In exchange for settling the affair with the Goldleaves, the Greymanes have secured a new home. Is this a genuine gesture of goodwill, or merely gilded fetters? Whatever their motives, it's time to focus entirely on rebuilding the Greymanes.

Mission_GreyWolf_Camp_RepairCamp.title: A Fresh Start
Mission_GreyWolf_Camp_RepairCamp.text3: Complete the camp that will be the Greymanes' hub. Lend the workers a hand to finalize the construction.
Mission_GreyWolf_Camp_RepairCamp.text4: You joined forces with the workers to lay the camp's foundations. Though currently just a collection of small tents and fences, it is the vital home needed for the Greymanes to rebuild and rise again.

Mission_GreyWolf_Camp_RepairCamp_Cook.title: A Well-Earned Meal
Mission_GreyWolf_Camp_RepairCamp_Cook.text3: Serve a meal to the workers who labored to build the camp. Nothing expresses gratitude better than a good meal.
Mission_GreyWolf_Camp_RepairCamp_Cook.text4: You served a warm meal as a show of gratitude to the men and women who labored to build the new Greymane camp. The Greymanes will rise here once again.

Mission_GreyWolf_Camp_RepairCamp_Complet.title: New Foundations
Mission_GreyWolf_Camp_RepairCamp_Complet.text3: The work is done. The camp is in order and the meal has been served. Time to return to our new home.
Mission_GreyWolf_Camp_RepairCamp_Complet.text4: The foundations of the camp has finally been laid with the help of everyone's sweat and dedication. Humble as it may be, this place will serve as the pillar for the Greymanes to rise again.

Mission_GreyWolf_Camp_Join_Marius.title: Comrade's Return
Mission_GreyWolf_Camp_Join_Marius.text3: A new base for the Greymanes has been established. It is now time to call the scattered Greymanes home. Go meet Marius.
Mission_GreyWolf_Camp_Join_Marius.text4: Ross was already waiting at the camp, drawn by the whispers of his comrades' return. During a heartfelt reunion, yet another ally emerged. The Greymanes were coming home. A new era was dawning.

Mission_Halsius_Yann_Meet.title: Foul-Mouthed Reunion
Mission_Halsius_Yann_Meet.text3: Rumor has it a Greymane was spotted causing a scene at St. Halssius's House of Healing. Head to St. Halssius's House of Healing to investigate.
Mission_Halsius_Yann_Meet.text4: Shouts and angry voices filled the halls of the infirmary. The source of the noise was none other than Yann. According to him, the House of Healing is merely using medical care as a front to carry out suspicious experiments and illegal activities.

Mission_Grace_Dominion_Dwayne.title: Homecoming
Mission_Grace_Dominion_Dwayne.text3: Now that Yann is back within the fold, the search for the rest of the scattered souls begins. Return to camp and speak with Marius.
Mission_Grace_Dominion_Dwayne.text4: Concern over the scattered comrades has kept Marius pacing endlessly. Duane dispelled that somber air with a hearty laugh as he dragged in a Black Bear he captured on the way.

Mission_Grace_Dominion_ReedDevil_Mansion.title: Traces in the Manor
Mission_Grace_Dominion_ReedDevil_Mansion.text3: There's been no word from Naira and Andrew. Go seek them out at Glenbright Manor.
Mission_Grace_Dominion_ReedDevil_Mansion.text4: The Glenbright Manor estate was a scene of utter devastation upon arrival. Though you feared the worst, a survivor offered hopeful news that some Greymanes had successfully escorted the count away from the grounds to safety.

Mission_Grace_Dominion_ReedDevilWitness.title: Inhuman
Mission_Grace_Dominion_ReedDevilWitness.text3: You discovered fresh tracks from the count's escape. Find and reunite with your comrades before the lead is lost.
Mission_Grace_Dominion_ReedDevilWitness.text4: The pursuit of Count Grace ended in tragedy. He has perished, and your comrades are heavily injured. The culprit slipped away in an effortless show of mockery. If he's not stopped, there will only be further bloodshed.

Mission_Grace_Dominion_ReedDevil_ScareCr.title: Seed of Dread
Mission_Grace_Dominion_ReedDevil_ScareCr.text3: If the Reed Devil escapes, it would put your Greymane comrades at grave risk. Hunt him down.
Mission_Grace_Dominion_ReedDevil_ScareCr.text4: Beyond the ranks of the Reed Devil's acolytes stood an altar bearing a crudely fashioned miniature scarecrow. As you lifted the doll in a trance-like state, the surrounding air grew frigid, and a chilling presence began to take hold.

Mission_Grace_Dominion_ReedDevil.title: Dance with the Devil
Mission_Grace_Dominion_ReedDevil.text3: A chilling wind carrying the scent of blood blows through the reed field. He is close. Defeat the devil that threatens the Greymanes.
Mission_Grace_Dominion_ReedDevil.text4: The Reed Devil vanished like smoke just as the final strike was about to land, leaving behind a cryptic message. A palpable frustration lingers after letting such an enemy slip through your fingers.

Mission_ForGraymane.title: The Storm Passes
Mission_ForGraymane.text3: Andrew was injured during the battle with the Reed Devil. Return to camp immediately to check on his condition.
Mission_ForGraymane.text4: Andrew's wounds fortunately proved to be non-fatal. While the comrades shared a collective sigh of relief, Yann also safely arrived at the camp. Having reunited after such a long separation, the group celebrated late into the night.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_ScoutFromMariusLv1_.title: Scattered Comrades
Mission_GreymaneCamp_ScoutFromMariusLv1_.text3: Marius has been speaking with an informant since daybreak. Approach him and listen.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_ScoutFromMariusLv1_.text4: Marius shared rumors regarding the whereabouts of some scattered comrades. Begin your search at the confirmed locations.

Graymane_Scout_Group_I.title: Rumors from the Sawmill
Graymane_Scout_Group_I.text3: Rumors tell of Greymanes who traded in their swords for axes and now cut wood at a sawmill near the Coalvale Workshop. Go see if these stories are true.
Graymane_Scout_Group_I.text4: The rumors of Greymanes who traded in their swords for axes were true. Luke and Ronald were found working at the sawmill. Their spirits remained unbroken, and they were overjoyed at finding fellow Greymanes once more.

Mission_ForGraymane_ShakatuLetter.title: A Gentle Touch
Mission_ForGraymane_ShakatuLetter.text3: Your comrades have returned to camp safely. Now, head to Howling Hill plan the next step.
Mission_ForGraymane_ShakatuLetter.text4: Unknown crates and bundles were waiting at the camp. It seems Shakatu kept his promise to support the Greymanes' cause.

Graymane_ExpandCamp_Lv1.title: Commotion at Howling Hill
Graymane_ExpandCamp_Lv1.text3: Securing more space is a top priority to accommodate the growing number of comrades. To house more personnel and expand your forces, the camp must undergo a major expansion.
Graymane_ExpandCamp_Lv1.text4: The expansion o the camp was completed successfully. Now it should be big enough to accommodate the growing number of Greymanes. However, as more comrades gather, continuous expansion will be necessary to make bigger leaps going forward.

Mission_ForGraymane_Complete.title: Greymanes Reunited
Mission_ForGraymane_Complete.text3: The camp has been expanded. Gather with your comrades to share stories and celebrate the long awaited reunion.
Mission_ForGraymane_Complete.text4: A peaceful night of reminiscing, filled with the laughter and banter, ended all too quickly. As day broke, a massive explosion shattered the tranquil morning.

Mission_KukuBird_Kuku_Start_dlc.title: A New Day Dawns
Mission_KukuBird_Kuku_Start_dlc.text3: The night with your comrades was filled with joy, but morning has come and you have to deliver the news about Roy. Speak with Ross, who is waiting to hear from you.
Mission_KukuBird_Kuku_Start_dlc.text4: Ross struggled in denial over Roy's death. However, he pulled himself together eventually. He suggested cleaning up the mess created by the explosion as a way of repaying his debts to the workshop. Help Ross put his sorrows aside and repay his debt. Split up the tasks with him and investigate the area near the top of the workshop.

Mission_KukuBird_Kuku_Start.title: Kilnden Workshop
Mission_KukuBird_Kuku_Start.text3: A sudden explosion has shattered the peace of the morning. The blast occurred close to the camp and could pose a serious threat. Let's head to the scene and see what happened.
Mission_KukuBird_Kuku_Start.text4: You found a dwarven craftsman sighing over a broken kiln. He wore a visione and acted dismissive of any questions, but seemed to be secretly hoping for some assistance.

Mission_KukuBird_Kuku_Repairkuku.title: Kilnden Kiln Repair
Mission_KukuBird_Kuku_Repairkuku.text3: Fixing the kiln may grant a closer look at their craftsmanship. Help with the repairs and examine the pots in the workshop.
Mission_KukuBird_Kuku_Repairkuku.text4:
You repaired all the kilns damaged by the Black Bears.
Before long, the kilns roared back to life, churning out intense heat.

Mission_KukuBird_Kuku_Repairkuku_Complet.title: Good News for the Artisan
Mission_KukuBird_Kuku_Repairkuku_Complet.text3:
The broken kilns are up and running again.
Head back to Grimnir, who must be anxiously waiting, and let him know the repairs are finished.
Mission_KukuBird_Kuku_Repairkuku_Complet.text4:
You brought the news to Grimnir that all the kilns were fully repaired.
Unable to hide his emotion, he expressed his gratitude by promising to show me what the workshop is truly capable of.

Mission_KukuBird_Kuku_Craft.title: The Mysterious Pot
Mission_KukuBird_Kuku_Craft.text3: In return for fixing the generator and the kiln, Grimnir promised a pot. Wait for the pot to be crafted.
Mission_KukuBird_Kuku_Craft.text4: Fresh from the kiln, Grimnir's pot was a true masterpiece. Every pattern etched into its surface seemed to pulse with life, as if the artisan had poured his very soul into the metal.

Mission_KukuBird_Kuku_StoneSeal.title: Pot Put to Good Use
Mission_KukuBird_Kuku_StoneSeal.text3: An artisan's guidance is required to properly handle the kuku pot. Learn how to use the pot from him at the Kilnden Workshop.
Mission_KukuBird_Kuku_StoneSeal.text4: A massive boulder managed to squeeze itself inside the strange pot. Strangely, though it held a large boulder within, the vessel felt absolutely weightless.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Fight.title: Ruckus in the Arena
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Fight.text3: Business at the Kilnden Workshop has been put to bed. Return to Howling Hill and get some rest.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_Fight.text4: Duane led the way to the fighting pits where Yann was being held. Though a bloody fight was waged to buy his freedom, Yann acted like it was a minor inconvenience, even leveraging his aches and pains to evade a prior commitment to Naira.

Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_ArrowShot.title: Skilled in Archery
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_ArrowShot.text3: It is time to head to the meeting place Yann so forcefully delegated. Seek out Naira, who is likely waiting unaware of the situation.
Mission_GreymaneCamp_Contents_ArrowShot.text4: Naira was waiting with Duane, who was being mercilessly teased by her for his poor marksmanship. While following along with Duane, he mentioned that the Chalice of Vows was up for grabs as the grand prize in the archery contest. Although victory was achieved and the Chalice of Vows reclaimed, a heavy heart remained over the reality that it had reduced to a mere tournament prize.

Mission_TrollUniversity_Visit_Call_Alust.title: The Words of Alustin
Mission_TrollUniversity_Visit_Call_Alust.text3: Set your troubled thoughts aside for now and first head down to the village of Hernand.
Mission_TrollUniversity_Visit_Call_Alust.text4: A man vanished into the crowd after a deliberate collision, leaving a small note behind. This brusque message came from Alustin, bearing an urgent plea to look into the dark emanations he sensed at Scholastone Institute.

Mission_TrollUniversity_Scholastone.title: Scholastone
Mission_TrollUniversity_Scholastone.text3: Locate the fence Alustin mentioned to collect the prepared items. Once preparations are complete, set out for Scholastone Institute.
Mission_TrollUniversity_Scholastone.text4: Between the treacherous terrain and the concealed entrance, it was clear that this secret location was nearly impossible to reach through normal means. After changing into the clothes Alustin prepared, a troll scholar revealed the way to Scholastone Institute.

Mission_TrollUniversity_Brain_Find_Maste.title: On the Right Path
Mission_TrollUniversity_Brain_Find_Maste.text3: Meet with the dean who oversees the institute. He likely knows the true nature of the ominous energy detected here.
Mission_TrollUniversity_Brain_Find_Maste.text4: Sharing Alustin's penchant for speaking in riddles, the dean claimed the experiments in the plaza are a necessary defense against the oncoming chaos. He encouraged you to provide assistance with the research.

Mission_TrollUniversity_Brain_Octabus_Nu.title: Gate to the Otherworld
Mission_TrollUniversity_Brain_Octabus_Nu.text3: The dean introduced you to a scholar named Octavius. Help him with the preparations for his experiment.
Mission_TrollUniversity_Brain_Octabus_Nu.text4: Octavius had embarked on a perilous endeavor, seeking to create an unknown power through the clash of two titanic forces. Though urged by all to stop, his persistence led to a catastrophic blast that pulled him into its very center. It took a desperate battle to finally excise the black corruption that emerged.

Mission_SpireOfTheStars_LinkBand.title: Spire of the Stars
Mission_SpireOfTheStars_LinkBand.text3: Grundir spoke of a strange phenomenon at the institute's spire following Octavius's disappearance. Investigate the Spire of the Stars.
Mission_SpireOfTheStars_LinkBand.text4: A journey to the tower was necessary to uncover the truth behind the strange phenomena tied to Octavius's experiment. Once the tower's mysteries were solved and the summit reached, passing through the portal unveiled the landscape of the Abyss, a place both recognizable and strangely foreign.

Mission_TrollUniversity_Brain_Meet_Crazy.title: Obsession and Madness
Mission_TrollUniversity_Brain_Meet_Crazy.text3: This place appears to be connected to the rift that swallowed Octavius. He may still be alive. Search the area for any sign of him.
Mission_TrollUniversity_Brain_Meet_Crazy.text4: Octavius crumbled into dust and disappeared as soon as you found him. At the heart of a powerful storm, you caught sight of a mysterious entity. It shouted a cryptic message as a massive power expelled you from the Abyss.

Mission_TrollUniversity_Brain_Lost_Maste.title: Cast Shadow
Mission_TrollUniversity_Brain_Lost_Maste.text3: With Octavius gone and a new shadow looming, you must alert the dean and devise a strategy to face this emerging danger. Seek out the dean.
Mission_TrollUniversity_Brain_Lost_Maste.text4: News of the encounter in the Abyss left {StaticInfo:Knowledge:Knowledge_Grundir#Grundir} in a state of solemn reflection. Weighing Octavius' message against the strange being discovered in the depths, he became convinced that the rift-maker is the catalyst for this entire catastrophe. For now, put aside these complex matters and return to Howling Hill.

Mission_Imp_Banquet_Boss_Invite.title: Ulterior Motives
Mission_Imp_Banquet_Boss_Invite.text3:
Perhaps it's the laughter and warmth shared with your comrades, the morning at the new homestead no longer feels so unfamiliar.
Seek out Marius, lost in thought, and have a talk with him.
Mission_Imp_Banquet_Boss_Invite.text4: Marquis Serkis announced the arrival of a Demenissian delegation and extended a banquet invitation to the Greymanes. This news poses a grave threat to Damiane, who is a Demenissian in hiding. However, she is currently nowhere to be found within the camp.

Mission_Imp_Banquet_Boss_Battle_WildHors.title: Unwelcomed Guests
Mission_Imp_Banquet_Boss_Battle_WildHors.text3: The excitement of the harvest festival has swept Hernand. With word of a Demenissian delegation attending, Damiane must be located and alerted immediately.
Mission_Imp_Banquet_Boss_Battle_WildHors.text4: The master of the panicked horse at the gates was none other than Damiane. She revealed that her swordmaster disappeared amidst a dark conspiracy, and she has also been framed and turned into a fugitive.

Mission_Imp_Banquet_Boss_Battle.title: Demenissian Delegation
Mission_Imp_Banquet_Boss_Battle.text3: The harvest festival banquet is about to begin. Go to the banquet hall in Hernand Castle.
Mission_Imp_Banquet_Boss_Battle.text4: A monster brought by the Demenissian delegation to flaunt their military might broke free, instantly turning the banquet hall into a scene of carnage. A fierce battle ensued, and the mortally wounded creature fled, leaving behind a gruesome hellscape of blood and bodies.

Mission_Imp_Banquet_Boss_Battle_DemiansC.title: Exposed Plot
Mission_Imp_Banquet_Boss_Battle_DemiansC.text3: The monster sent by Bastier, the grand general of Demeniss, left the banquet in shambles. Ask Damiane for more information about this man.
Mission_Imp_Banquet_Boss_Battle_DemiansC.text4: Suspicious individuals have reportedly crossed into Hernand alongside the Demenissian delegation. It appears that Demeniss is the hidden hand providing supplies to the Black Bears.

Mission_Crowman_Boss_WitchHouse.title: The Missing Seal
Mission_Crowman_Boss_WitchHouse.text3:
After a night spent with comrades you hadn't seen in ages, the morning was a truly nostalgic sight.
Now head back to the tents and sort out which direction to move forward in.
Mission_Crowman_Boss_WitchHouse.text4: Elowen, the Witch of Wisdom, spoke of the coven that safeguards the delicate balance between the Abyss and reality. She offered a grave warning of a malevolent force on the rise that seeks to neutralize the witches, seize their sanctuaries, and plunge the world into darkness.

Mission_Crowman_Boss_Request.title: Crowcaller
Mission_Crowman_Boss_Request.text3: The witch's warning of looming dark forces leaves you with an ominous sense of foreboding. Quickly return to Hernand to gather information and prepare.
Mission_Crowman_Boss_Request.text4: The dark premonition has come to pass. Unidentified assailants raided the Axiom Archive and abducted White Crow. Unconcerned for his own injuries, Alustin pleaded for you to pursue the intruders and rescue White Crow.

Mission_Crowman_Boss_FirstMeet.title: The Crow's Warning
Mission_Crowman_Boss_FirstMeet.text3: The attack on the Axiom Archive seems recent. The culprits must be caught before the trail grows cold. Scour every corner of Hernand.
Mission_Crowman_Boss_FirstMeet.text4: On the outskirts of town stood a man resembling a crow. He appeared to be quite knowledgeable about the Greymanes. The hostility radiating from him was both intense and overt. He is clearly a lethal adversary with a singular, deadly purpose.

Mission_Crowman_Boss_Ribentain_Battle.title: Blood on the Wind
Mission_Crowman_Boss_Ribentain_Battle.text3:
Word is that the Black Witch is taking White Crow to the altar as a sacrifice.
Chase down the man of black feathers and rescue White Crow before it's too late.
Mission_Crowman_Boss_Ribentain_Battle.text4: The trail of the feathered man ended at the west church, which already became a scene of carnage. A battle ensued, but the crowman fled, promising he would be waiting at a site better suited for a final stand.

Mission_Crowman_Boss_Ribentain_HideToken.title: The Church's Hidden Secret
Mission_Crowman_Boss_Ribentain_HideToken.text3: What did he mean by "Your doom awaits?" Investigate the church.
Mission_Crowman_Boss_Ribentain_HideToken.text4: The sacred relic was fitted into the stone pagoda, activating the hidden mechanism and sending a faint tremor rippling through the earth. The Spire of Soaring had finally awakened. The path has now opened to where the enemy awaits.

Mission_Crowman_Boss_Battle.title: Toward the Nest
Mission_Crowman_Boss_Battle.text3: The Spire of Soaring has been activated. It is time for the final showdown. Go to the tower and head to where the enemy awaits.
Mission_Crowman_Boss_Battle.text4: Following a grueling battle, the feather-clad figure was defeated, and White Crow was safe once again. To his very last breath, he poured out his hatred for the church while desperately yearning for his mother's love. His animosity toward the Greymanes may also be fueled by his mother.

Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_Celester_Chapt.title: Ambition Laid Bare
Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_Celester_Chapt.text3:
It looks like all the immediate threats have been dealt with.
Return to camp and assess the situation.
Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_Celester_Chapt.text4:
You've returned to camp.
Now it's time to carefully sort out everything that just happened.

Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_Celester_Visit.title: News Arrives
Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_Celester_Visit.text3:
You heard from Marquis Serkis's soldiers that a comrade is currently in Calphade, where there's war.
First, you should meet with the marquis to get the details.
Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_Celester_Visit.text4: A messenger brought word that Marquis Serkis requested your presence. You headed to Hernand Castle and found Duke Celeste, who delivered the news that Calphade is under attack by the Black Bears and a Greymane is caught in the middle of it. Set out immediately to save your comrade.

Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_Celester_FindG.title: To the Battlefield
Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_Celester_FindG.text3: A guide is waiting at the beacon. Make haste.
Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_Celester_FindG.text4: Signs of the Black Bears' assault on the road to Calphade revealed how dire the situation is. Upon arrival, Marshal Middler stressed just how bad things had become, but you pushed forward toward the front lines to save your comrade.

Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_War_Start.title: The Counterattack
Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_War_Start.text3: Head to the Southern Sentry Post where your allies are gathered before entering Calphade Castle.
Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_War_Start.text4: With the watchtowers disabled, you arrived at the battlefield with Duane. To restore the army's shattered morale, you boldly raised the fallen banner pikes once more and marched onward into battle.

Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_Occupation_Ref.title: Cradle of Defense
Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_Occupation_Ref.text3: The villages of southern Calphade are the cradle of the city's survival. Reclaim this vital land from the enemy's clutches.
Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_Occupation_Ref.text4: Allied banners fly once more over the southern reaches of Calphade. The cradle of defense will now serve as the foundation for the city's reconstruction.

Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_Occupation_A.title: Hand of Deliverance
Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_Occupation_A.text3: Find the Calphadean defenders at their outpost and help with their preparations to reclaim Calphade.
Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_Occupation_A.text4: The battlefield was a scene of total pandemonium, but around the outpost, a desperate struggle to save lives continued. Fallen soldiers were evacuated, first aid was provided, and supply routes were cleared to deliver materials. The survivors gripped their weapons once more and headed to the battlefield.

Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_Occupation_Tha.title: Fire on the Front Line
Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_Occupation_Tha.text3: Cutting the enemy's supply lines is crucial to drive back the forces that have forced their way deep into allied territory. Seek out and destroy the enemy's supplies.
Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_Occupation_Tha.text4: The destruction of their supplies has slowed the enemy's advance. You seized the momentum and pressed the attack, knowing there was no time to rest if you were to drive them back for good.

Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_Fire_Support.title: Fire Support
Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_Fire_Support.text3: Fierce enemy resistance is stalling your advance. Find a way to call in fire support from your allies.
Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_Fire_Support.text4: Allied cannons are now providing support from the nearby artillery unit. With the odds shifted in your favor, seize this chance to crush enemy strongholds and liberate northern Calphade.

Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_Occupation_Tra.title: In Ashes
Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_Occupation_Tra.text3: The Black Bears have taken several soldiers prisoner following a sudden ambush. For the sake of the men worried about their comrades, infiltrate enemy lines and rescue the captives.
Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_Occupation_Tra.text4: Just as you were about to lead the prisoners out, the Black Bears turned their cannons on their own base. Despite nearly being caught in the inferno, you slipped through the smoke and chaos with the soldiers in tow.

Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_BlackBearTank.title: Hidden Fangs
Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_BlackBearTank.text3: You've discovered why the Black Bears are so emboldened. Their devastating war machines were behind the ruthless shelling that leveled their own camp. Seek out the weapons and reduce them to scraps.
Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_BlackBearTank.text4: You've demolished the ironclad tanks, weapons far beyond the Black Bears' own engineering skills. Their forces have been crippled, but the mystery remains: who is supplying them with the resources to operate such devastating war machines?

Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_Caphade_Reclai.title: Reclamation
Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_Caphade_Reclai.text3: The joint assault of the Black Bears and Bastier's Inquisitors have left Calphade on the brink of collapse. To turn the tide of battle, you must reclaim the fallen strongholds and establish a foothold for a decisive counter-offensive.
Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_Caphade_Reclai.text4: After a grueling struggle, allied banners are fluttering across Calphade once again. The sight of the reclaimed territory has breathed new life into the people's fading will to resist. It seems the momentum has finally shifted in your favor.

Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_Oongka.title: A Thousand Troops
Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_Oongka.text3: The time has come to execute the traitor and retake Calphade Castle. March on the castle and reclaim what was lost.
Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_Oongka.text4: At Calphade Castle, you reunited with Oongka, wielding his massive axe just like the old days. Putting the warmth of the reunion aside for a moment, you headed off to provide support for Stefan Lanford.

Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss.title: Traitor
Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss.text3: It is finally time to bring Cassius Morten, the architect of the uprising, to justice. Find him in the heart of Calphade Castle and strike him down.
Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss.text4: You have suppressed the rebellion in Calphade by executing Cassius Morten, yet it appears he did not act alone. His loyalty belonged to Bastier, the grand general of Demeniss. It is now clear that a massive conspiracy lurks behind the actions of both the Black Bears and Cassius Morten.

Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_Liberation.title: All Quiet on the Front
Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_Liberation.text3: You have finally executed the traitor, Cassius Morten. Marquis Lanford will be eager to hear this news first, so deliver the report of your victory to him immediately.
Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_Liberation.text4: Marquis Lanford has secured the surrounding territory and returned to the castle. With the war finally at an end, Calphade can enjoy a hard-won peace, however brief. Head to the beacon and signal to everyone that peace has returned to this land.

Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_Beacon.title: News of Victory
Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_Beacon.text3: The invaders were crushed, and the spark of rebellion extinguished. In commemoration of the great victory, Marquis Lanford requests that you light the beacon yourself to signal the return of peace.
Mission_Silver_Armor_Boss_Beacon.text4: The flames on the beacon roared to life, piercing the dark night sky. This blaze of victory drove back the shadows, offering comfort to the wounded people of Calphade and sending a message of hope that they would rise once more.

Mission_Ludvig_Boss_Backhome_dlc.title: Return Home
Mission_Ludvig_Boss_Backhome_dlc.text3:
The campaign is over. Now it's time to return to Howling Hill.
There, you must reunite with your comrades and plan your next move.
Mission_Ludvig_Boss_Backhome_dlc.text4: The time has come at last to reclaim your homeland.

Mission_Ludvig_Boss_Danger_BlueMistVilla.title: Ashes of Treachery
Mission_Ludvig_Boss_Danger_BlueMistVilla.text3: Your contact with the informant must remain discreet. Send your comrades ahead first, then make your way to the shrine south of Beighen.
Mission_Ludvig_Boss_Danger_BlueMistVilla.text4: A fire consumed the shrine meant to serve as your meeting point. It was left burnt beyond recognition. You discovered a note from the informant revealing that Ludvig betrayed Pailune.

Mission_Ludvig_Boss_MeetGraymane.title: Trust Lost
Mission_Ludvig_Boss_MeetGraymane.text3: Shake off the shock of the incident at the shrine and head for Beighen, where your comrades are waiting. Assessing the situation there is your top priority.
