Mission_Ludvig_Boss_MeetGraymane.text4: You arrived in Beighen only to find a tense and unsettling atmosphere. The villagers showed open hostility toward the Greymanes and refused to cooperate. To have any hope of reclaiming Pailune, you must first locate Torstein.

Mission_Ludvig_Boss_Investigation.title: Bared Fangs
Mission_Ludvig_Boss_Investigation.text3: Public sentiment in Beighen is restless and hostile, but somewhere a secret resistance movement is standing against the Jackals and Black Bears. You need to find them. Begin your inquiry into their whereabouts immediately.
Mission_Ludvig_Boss_Investigation.text4: Torstein and the Blue Fangs have been operating out of Beighen, preparing to retake Pailune. He never gave up hope, quietly sharpening his blade for the liberation of his homeland. Now, the time has finally come to join forces. Go and meet Torstein.

Mission_Ludvig_Boss_Pailoon_Beacon.title: Rekindled Hope
Mission_Ludvig_Boss_Pailoon_Beacon.text3: Torstein is ready to reveal how he intends to retake Pailune. Make your way down to the hideout to hear his plan.
Mission_Ludvig_Boss_Pailoon_Beacon.text4: You confirmed Torstein's reports of hostages at the mountaintop beacon. After defeating the captors and rescuing the prisoners, you lit the beacon. The fire surged skyward, signaling the start of the counter-offensive.

Mission_Beighen_Basketmaker_Tolstein_Spe.title: A Stand of Resolve
Mission_Beighen_Basketmaker_Tolstein_Spe.text3: Inform Torstein that the mission was a success. It's time to formulate the final plans for the full-scale liberation of Pailune.
Mission_Beighen_Basketmaker_Tolstein_Spe.text4: Torstein's plan was a bold one: a strike team would infiltrate Pailune to sow chaos with explosives, allowing the main force to bring down the walls and charge through the breach. After the briefing, Torstein delivered a stirring speech to his soldiers. His rage toward the enemy became your own, and the morale of the Blue Fangs soared to new heights as they prepared for battle.

Mission_Beighen_Basketmaker_Tolstein_Tal.title: Shadows Over Pailune
Mission_Beighen_Basketmaker_Tolstein_Tal.text3: You have secured the sword Torstein had prepared. Seek out Torstein now to discuss the upcoming liberation of Pailune.
Mission_Beighen_Basketmaker_Tolstein_Tal.text4: The situation became complicated. Shane, who had gone to scout Pailune, hasn't made contact. Rescuing him is a priority, but the operation to blow up the castle walls was also urgent. Reunite with the comrades at the safe house Torstein prepared to discuss the best course of action.

Mission_Ludvig_Boss_Pailoon_SupplyDestro.title: Driving out the Shadows
Mission_Ludvig_Boss_Pailoon_SupplyDestro.text3: You have two objectives to complete simultaneously. Find and save Shane while planting explosives to sabotage the Jackals' defenses.
Mission_Ludvig_Boss_Pailoon_SupplyDestro.text4: You have rescued Shane from the heart of the enemy camp. He is badly hurt but stable. After handing him over to Oongka for care, you set the charges at the designated spots. All that's left is to give the signal to the others.

Mission_Ludvig_Boss_CrouchingWolf.title: Lurking Wolves
Mission_Ludvig_Boss_CrouchingWolf.text3: Preparations are complete, but you must bide your time. Wait for the moment when the enemy lets their guard down.
Mission_Ludvig_Boss_CrouchingWolf.text4: At the designated time, you loosed a flaming arrow into the night sky. A split second later, the charges detonated with a deafening roar, and the once-impregnable walls came crashing down. The battlefield instantly dissolved into chaos, and screams of agony filled the air. Hesitation is not an option. For this price in blood, you will reclaim your lost home.

Mission_Ludvig_Boss_Pailoon_BlackTowerEn.title: Reclamation
Mission_Ludvig_Boss_Pailoon_BlackTowerEn.text3: It's time to bring justice to the Jackals who have defiled Pailune. Drive out every last one of them and reclaim your home.
Mission_Ludvig_Boss_Pailoon_BlackTowerEn.text4: The Jackals fell before your relentless blade. Overwhelmed by the sheer momentum of the battlefield, they have lost the will to fight and are fleeing into the inner fortress like dogs with their tails between their legs. Victory is finally within reach.

Mission_Ludvig_Boss_Pailoon_Ludvig.title: Lonely Jackals
Mission_Ludvig_Boss_Pailoon_Ludvig.text3: Ludvig is somewhere within Pailune Fortress. Track down the traitor and ensure he pays the price for selling out his homeland.
Mission_Ludvig_Boss_Pailoon_Ludvig.text4: You had the traitor Ludvig in your grasp, but he managed to escape while Duane was interrogating him. Your hands trembled with pure rage toward the man, yet you couldn't bring yourself to abandon your fallen comrades to give chase. The time will come to hunt him down once more.

Mission_Ludvig_Boss_Pailoon_Decision.title: Resolution
Mission_Ludvig_Boss_Pailoon_Decision.text3: Ludvig escaped, but at long last, Pailune is yours again. This is only the beginning. Join the other Greymanes to discuss the path ahead and determine your future course.
Mission_Ludvig_Boss_Pailoon_Decision.text4: Reclaiming Pailune is a victory, but the celebration must wait. As long as the Black Bears stand strong, your home is not truly free. You need to regroup and prepare for the final showdown.

Mission_Mjordin_Boss_LavaMountain_Battle.title: The Counterattack
Mission_Mjordin_Boss_LavaMountain_Battle.text3: All forces have gathered at Silver Wolf Mountain for the final assault on the Black Bears. This is where the war ends. Join your comrades and prepare for the coming battle.
Mission_Mjordin_Boss_LavaMountain_Battle.text4: You see the fire of determination burning in your comrades' eyes. Once the torches flare and war cries echo across Silver Wolf Mountain, the assault on the Black Bears will begin.

Mission_Mjordin_Boss_Meet.title: Unleashed Fury
Mission_Mjordin_Boss_Meet.text3: It is time to settle all scores. Advance with your comrades to bring the Black Bears to justice and take back what is rightfully yours.
Mission_Mjordin_Boss_Meet.text4: A single wooden bridge lies between you and the Black Bears. Looking at the foe you've loathed for a lifetime, you feel a surprising peace. The time for words is over; only the sword remains. The fury that once burned in your chest will finally fade away.

Mission_Mjordin_Boss_Meet_GrayWolf_Battl.title: The Final Bridge
Mission_Mjordin_Boss_Meet_GrayWolf_Battl.text3: Blood stains the ground as a fierce struggle for Silver Wolf Mountain unfolds. Find Myurdin atop the fortress and strike him down.
Mission_Mjordin_Boss_Meet_GrayWolf_Battl.text4: You owe this moment to your comrades. After fighting by their sides across the peak of Silver Wolf Mountain, you have reached the fortress's highest point. Tonight, you will end this cycle of hatred with your own hands.

Mission_Mjordin_Boss_LavaMountain.title: Battle at Silver Wolf Mountain
Mission_Mjordin_Boss_LavaMountain.text3: Myurdin awaits you in the heart of the fortress. The time has come to end this long-standing and relentless cycle of hatred once and for all.
Mission_Mjordin_Boss_LavaMountain.text4: Myurdin's loathsome voice echoed through the carnage. After a fierce battle, you brought him to his knees, but just as you were about to settle the score, Ludvig struck from the shadows. You fell from the heights of the citadel and lost consciousness.

Mission_Mjordin_Boss_UncomfortableEnding.title: Incomplete Victory
Mission_Mjordin_Boss_UncomfortableEnding.text3: Waking up, you find your body racked with agonizing pain. Seeing Oongka by your side puts your mind at ease, though. Ask him for the final outcome of the battle.
Mission_Mjordin_Boss_UncomfortableEnding.text4: You are alive, but your body is battered and broken. It frustrates you to stop now, but you have no choice but to rest. With Oongka handling the cleanup of the enemy remnants, you must turn all your attention to healing your wounds.

Mission_Chase_traitorDwayne_Start.title: Ludvig's Whereabouts
Mission_Chase_traitorDwayne_Start.text3: Duane and Shane are on the hunt for any trace of Ludvig. Go and see if they discovered anything useful.
Mission_Chase_traitorDwayne_Start.text4: Witnesses claim that the Jackals and Black Bears are now operating independently. Since the main force cannot be spared for a full-scale manhunt, you have decided to pursue Ludvig with only a small, elite group.

Mission_Dwayne_Boss_Oongka_III.title: Time of Reckoning
Mission_Dwayne_Boss_Oongka_III.text3: Investigate the location where the Jackals were last seen for any sign of Ludvig. He will not escape this time.
Mission_Dwayne_Boss_Oongka_III.text4: Though Ludvig is dead and vengeance is yours, the grief still lingers. Standing before Jian's grave, you renew your resolve. The war is far from over.

Mission_BloodCoronation_TolsteinGuide.title: The Unending Pursuit
Mission_BloodCoronation_TolsteinGuide.text3:
Calphade has been saved from the flames of rebellion, but Myurdin, the mastermind behind it all, has vanished beyond the fog.
Meet with Stefan Lanford to discuss what comes next and learn more about his whereabouts.
Mission_BloodCoronation_TolsteinGuide.text4: News arrived from Stefan Lanford that Myurdin has slipped into Demeniss. To track him down and uncover the truth behind it all, you must follow Myurdin's trail starting at Fort Ironclad, which is currently controlled by Grand General Bastier's forces.

Mission_BloodCoronation_EastWitch.title: Bonds
Mission_BloodCoronation_EastWitch.text3:
You decided to split up from your comrades and track down Myurdin.
Head to Fort Ironclad based on the information provided by Stefan Lanford.
Mission_BloodCoronation_EastWitch.text4: Maegu, a witch from the far-off East, has suffered a series of unfortunate events: a debilitating injury and the abduction of her sister. According to her, the only way to track her sister is to recover their lost heirlooms and let the wind itself provide the path.

Mission_IronStronghold_Block_WitchReques.title: Ritual Preparations
Mission_IronStronghold_Block_WitchReques.text3: On Shipwreck Shore lies the wreckage of a ship that appears to have carried the foreign sisters. Investigate the surroundings.
Mission_IronStronghold_Block_WitchReques.text4: You pulled the sisters' lost heirlooms from the remains of the wreckage. Maegu believes the energy dwelling in this item will reveal the path to her missing sibling's location.

Mission_IronStronghold_Block_ReturnToSis.title: Where the Wind Guides You
Mission_IronStronghold_Block_ReturnToSis.text3: You have recovered all the items needed to find Maegu's sister. Return to the altar.
Mission_IronStronghold_Block_ReturnToSis.text4: The wind led you to Woosa at last. After breaking through the defenses of Gregor, the Halberd of Carnage, you reunited Woosa with her elder sister, Maegu.

Mission_BloodCoronation_GrayWolf_Shrine.title: Chasing a Shadow
Mission_BloodCoronation_GrayWolf_Shrine.text3: Search for your Greymane comrades scattered across Demeniss to track down Myurdin's leads.
Mission_BloodCoronation_GrayWolf_Shrine.text4:
Even in Demeniss, Myurdin's whereabouts remained elusive. It seems Bastier's forces are backing his escape.
To counter them, we need the help of Countess Azerian, who has kept his distance from corrupt power. Meet the countess, who is currently living in seclusion after being driven from the struggle for power.

Mission_BloodCoronation_NobleWoman_Reque.title: Blazing Fire
Mission_BloodCoronation_NobleWoman_Reque.text3: According to Andrew and Naira, all Demeniss intelligence flows through Countess Azerian's manor. Sneak into the mansion to discover Myurdin's whereabouts.
Mission_BloodCoronation_NobleWoman_Reque.text4: Despite being caught during your infiltration, Countess Azerian made a surprising proposal to join forces for mutual benefit. She explained that Countess Marshell and Count Byron hold the information you seek.

Mission_BloodCoronation_Marseille.title: Murmurs in the Dark
Mission_BloodCoronation_Marseille.text3: Countess Marshell is a loyal lapdog of the traitorous Caliburn. The evidence you find may shed light on their rebellion against House Thorel.
Mission_BloodCoronation_Marseille.text4: Digging into Countess Marshell's affairs led to a surprising discovery. It turns out she knows exactly what happened to Colette Azerian's sister who has been missing for years.

Mission_BloodCoronation_Byron.title: Signed in Blood
Mission_BloodCoronation_Byron.text3: The clue from Countess Marshell's manor proved that Count Byron was deeply involved with the tragedy in Pailune. It's time to find him, and bring him to justice.
Mission_BloodCoronation_Byron.text4: Byron was the very man who set Pailune aflame, the man who enjoyed sitting idle while others suffered in pain. He may not be the person behind everything, but he deserved every punishment for all the innocent blood he's spilled.

Mission_BloodCoronation_Azerian.title: Steadfast in the Storm
Mission_BloodCoronation_Azerian.text3: Go to Countess Azerian to tell her about the information gathered from Count Byron and Countess Marshell.
Mission_BloodCoronation_Azerian.text4: Damiane rushed out the moment she heard the fate of her swordmaster. Countess Azerian appeared visibly shaken at first, but quickly regained her composure. She explained that to secure allies, they must first come to the aid of Duke Wells.

Mission_ThornRoseFort_Block_Start.title: Preparing to Strike
Mission_ThornRoseFort_Block_Start.text3: After finishing your discussion with Countess Azerian about the need to secure allies, you set out to aid the embattled Duke Wells.
Mission_ThornRoseFort_Block_Start.text4: The turncoats have taken control of Thornbriar Fortress. You can feel a sense of dread in the air as the sounds of combat echo from within the walls.

Mission_ThornRoseFort_Liberation.title: Quelling the Uprising
Mission_ThornRoseFort_Liberation.text3: Rebels are advancing with siege towers to besiege the fortress. Dismantle the towers to halt their assault.
Mission_ThornRoseFort_Liberation.text4: The destruction of the siege towers has stalled the rebels' advance. Your forces have now fully surrounded the enemy, effectively cutting off their escape and sealing their fate.

Mission_ThornRoseFort_Block_Boss.title: The Cursed Knight
Mission_ThornRoseFort_Block_Boss.text3:
This rebellion won't end until the cursed knight who seized the inner keep is struck down.
Put an end to the traitor who has soaked this fortress in blood.
Mission_ThornRoseFort_Block_Boss.text4:
You eliminated the traitor who soaked the fortress in blood.
The power he seized by forsaking his oath brought him nothing but a miserable end.

Mission_ThornRoseFort_Block_Boss_Complet.title: Lord of Thornbriar Fortress
Mission_ThornRoseFort_Block_Boss_Complet.text3:
With the traitor's end, the fortress has finally returned to its rightful owner.
Now, go meet Duke Wells, who has reclaimed his proper place.
Mission_ThornRoseFort_Block_Boss_Complet.text4: You subdued the rebels and met Duke Wells. The description he provided of the man in question matches Myurdin perfectly. You may find more answers if you investigate Caliburn's former office in the royal castle.

Mission_BloodCoronation_BloodCoronation.title: The Blood Coronation
Mission_BloodCoronation_BloodCoronation.text3: Investigate Duke Caliburn's old office to find out Myurdin's whereabouts.
Mission_BloodCoronation_BloodCoronation.text4: You encountered the figure from the Abyss once again. An unknown force pulled you toward him, blurring the line between memory and reality. After suffering defeat in the ensuing battle against this man, Duke Caliburn, you lost consciousness. The duke sat on a throne erected over a pool of blood, and merely looked down with an expression of pure boredom.

Mission_BloodCoronation_Azerian_Dead.title: The Thread
Mission_BloodCoronation_Azerian_Dead.text3: According to Kliff, your swordmaster is being held at the court. Seek out Naira, who is on Bastier's trail, to combine your intelligence and plan a rescue.
Mission_BloodCoronation_Azerian_Dead.text4: By the time you found your swordmaster, it was already too late. Bastier, that monster, killed her. You will make him pay for this in blood.

Mission_BloodCoronation_BastionDead.title: A Fleeting Dream
Mission_BloodCoronation_BastionDead.text3: Bastier is in the tower according to Naira. Blood must be repaid with blood. Head to the tower to bring justice to him in your swordmaster's name.
Mission_BloodCoronation_BastionDead.text4: You forced Bastier to his knees. At swordpoint, you demanded to know why he murdered your master, but the bastard simply gave a mocking smirk and took his own life.

Mission_Goblin_Master_Doo_WakeUp.title: Mysterious Voice
Mission_Goblin_Master_Doo_WakeUp.text3: Though your senses remain dull, you have regained consciousness thanks to the help of the shai. An unfamiliar voice calls out during an untimely silence, inviting you to find it should you seek more power.
Mission_Goblin_Master_Doo_WakeUp.text4: Deep within a cave, an enormous temple revealed itself from beneath the sand.

Mission_Goblin_Master_Doo_Statue.title: Cloister of Enlightenment
Mission_Goblin_Master_Doo_Statue.text3: Inside the temple, you found a giant statue at the end of a long stairway. The golden surface, which should have been radiant, was losing its light from being corrupted.
Mission_Goblin_Master_Doo_Statue.text4: The voice reached out once more, urging you to unravel the secrets engraved upon the stone tablets.

Goblin_Master_Doo_Urdavah.title: The Spear's Mark
Goblin_Master_Doo_Urdavah.text3: You must reveal the secret of the stone tablet to achieve enlightenment, then fully seize the power as your own.
Goblin_Master_Doo_Urdavah.text4: Following the tablet's words led to a collapsed and wounded dragon, suffering from a bismuth spear driven deep into its back.

Goblin_Master_Doo_Urdavah_Blackstar.title: Shackles of Fate
Goblin_Master_Doo_Urdavah_Blackstar.text3: With a spear lodged in its back, the massive dragon circles low in the skies of Urdavah, gasping for breath.
Goblin_Master_Doo_Urdavah_Blackstar.text4: Once the bismuth spear was pulled free, the creature's ragged breathing steadied, and its gaze landed intently on you. A silent understanding passed through its deep eyes.

Goblin_Master_Doo_OldKliff.title: The Crossroads
Goblin_Master_Doo_OldKliff.text3: You must reveal the secret of the stone tablet to achieve enlightenment, then fully seize the power as your own.
Goblin_Master_Doo_OldKliff.text4: In the heart of the sand dunes, the Spire of the Sun stood in silent defiance, as if piercing the skies. Find a way to open the firmly locked gate.

Goblin_Master_Doo_OldKliff_Abyss.title: Unwavering Steps
Goblin_Master_Doo_OldKliff_Abyss.text3: On the edge of the dunes, the mirrors of a cryptic ruin lie distorted, casting fractured light across the shifting sands.
Goblin_Master_Doo_OldKliff_Abyss.text4: The old man you encountered in the Abyss leveled his blade, testing your resolve. He spoke as though he could see through your hesitation. "You were never wrong. Every path you chose was the right one." His words instilled a sense of conviction in you stronger than any physical power.

Goblin_Master_Doo_Jijeongtemple.title: The Shroud of Dawn
Goblin_Master_Doo_Jijeongtemple.text3: You must reveal the secret of the stone tablet to achieve enlightenment, then fully seize the power as your own.
Goblin_Master_Doo_Jijeongtemple.text4: In search of enlightenment, you set foot upon the jagged peaks of southern Pywel.

Mission_JijeongTemple_Challenge_Buddha.title: Jijeong Temple in Chaos
Mission_JijeongTemple_Challenge_Buddha.text3: The temple is in turmoil. Go see what is going on.
Mission_JijeongTemple_Challenge_Buddha.text4: As the pensive statues of Jijeong Temple were restored to their former glory, a shift began to stir within the grounds. The restless, chaotic energy that once clouded the air finally started to sink into a calm stillness.

Mission_JiJeongTemple_Normal_Report.title: Path to Enlightenment
Mission_JiJeongTemple_Normal_Report.text3: The pensive statues have been fully restored. It is time to return to the chief monk and deliver the news.
Mission_JiJeongTemple_Normal_Report.text4: When the chief monk heard of your encounter with the masked monk, he revealed that the masked monk was the one responsible for destroying the temple. Fearing the masked monk's obsession with raw power over true enlightenment, the chief monk has opened the training grounds. He pleaded for you to hone your skills and guide the fallen monk back to the righteous path.

Mission_JiJeongTemple_Normal_Training.title: Path of the Disciple
Mission_JiJeongTemple_Normal_Training.text3: There are training grounds around Jijeong Temple where one can achieve enlightenment. Train and hone the mind.
Mission_JiJeongTemple_Normal_Training.text4: As you completed your training, a newfound core of strength took root deep within. An unshakeable will has begun to form.

Mission_JiJeongTemple_Normal_ChiefMonk.title: True Strength
Mission_JiJeongTemple_Normal_ChiefMonk.text3: All training sessions have been completed. Go meet T'rukan, just as requested by the chief monk.
Mission_JiJeongTemple_Normal_ChiefMonk.text4: Your unshakable resolve stood like a silent monolith, delivering a harsh lesson to T'rukan. Finally, the true meaning of strength began to take hold.

Goblin_Master_Doo_Jijeongtemple_End.title: Confronting What Lies Within
Goblin_Master_Doo_Jijeongtemple_End.text3: Once your training finished, the long-dormant gate at the pagoda atop the highest peak finally creaked open.
Goblin_Master_Doo_Jijeongtemple_End.text4: Master Jijeong's teachings offered unexpected wisdom. He advised against trying too hard in the pursuit of power, affirming that letting things flow naturally is often the true path toward strength.

Goblin_Master_Doo_ShadowTemple.title: Fragments of Darkness
Goblin_Master_Doo_ShadowTemple.text3: You must reveal the secret of the stone tablet to achieve enlightenment, then fully seize the power as your own.
Goblin_Master_Doo_ShadowTemple.text4: A talking painting revealed the crisis of the sanctum. The collapsed sanctum has been restored, bringing back balance.

Mission_HexeMarie_Boss_StoneTower.title: Pursuit Beyond the Veil
Mission_HexeMarie_Boss_StoneTower.text3: The energy spread by the Black Witch is concealing her traces. Destroy the stone totems to lift the veil.
Mission_HexeMarie_Boss_StoneTower.text4: By destroying the stone totems, Hexe Marie's energy has been scattered. The traces leading to her sanctuary can be tracked.

Mission_HexeMarie_Boss_Battle.title: Black Witch
Mission_HexeMarie_Boss_Battle.text3: As the stone totems crumbled, the Black Witch's presence grew distinct. Seek out and defeat Hexe Marie to restore the balance.
Mission_HexeMarie_Boss_Battle.text4: After a fierce battle, the Black Witch, Hexe Marie,  finally seemed to be cornered. She fled, vanishing into the darkness, leaving behind cryptic words promising a future encounter.

Mission_Goblin_Master_DoorToGold.title: The Cloister of Enlightenment
Mission_Goblin_Master_DoorToGold.text3: The secrets of the stone tablets have been revealed, bestowing enlightenment. Return to the temple to prove your worth.
Mission_Goblin_Master_DoorToGold.text4: You had to prove your worth to meet the mysterious speaker. His identity remains unknown, as do the reasons why he sought to test both strength and willpower.

Mission_Goblin_Master_Doo.title: The Sage of the Desert
Mission_Goblin_Master_Doo.text3: The doors of each trial have opened. Proceed to the deepest part of the cloister to meet the mysterious speaker.
Mission_Goblin_Master_Doo.text4: The Sage of the Desert waited within the cloister, a figure of exceptional martial prowess and wisdom. It was no ordinary sparring match, and the sage conveyed truth through his blade, teaching to "observe essence beyond form." As the duel ended, he commanded you to follow him and vanished.

Mission_Goblin_Master_Meet.title: New Perspectives
Mission_Goblin_Master_Meet.text3: While exchanging blows, Master Du offered words of deep insight. Follow him into the Abyss to discover what else he has to reveal.
Mission_Goblin_Master_Meet.text4: Master Du shared a harrowing tale regarding the true nature of the Abyss and the atrocities committed by those intoxicated by its power. He warned that many still scheme to force open the gate and urged that, with the help of your comrades, the opening of the gate in the Musket of Demeniss be stopped.

Mission_Goblin_Master_Doo_Blood_Throne.title: Fallen Demeniss
Mission_Goblin_Master_Doo_Blood_Throne.text3:
Demeniss has been engulfed in the raging flames of civil war by a rebel attack.
To protect its suffering citizens and save the city, join your comrades and take down the rebels.
Mission_Goblin_Master_Doo_Blood_Throne.text4: Alongside the allied forces, you have routed the rebels and finally settled uour long-standing score with Myrdin. Demenis is liberated, yet the victory feels incomplete. The true architect of this misery, Caliburn, still draws breath. He must be hunted down and brought to justice once and for all.

Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_Meet_Yann.title: A New Front
Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_Meet_Yann.text3: Talk to Garkhan as he prepares to return to Gorthak after the battle.
Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_Meet_Yann.text4: You cannot turn a blind eye to Gorthak's plight, especially after he spared no effort to help Demeniss. If Caliburn's dark reach, the same that tormented Pailune, is now threatening Gorthak, then this is ultimately our fight as well.

Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_MeetDemianinNeu.title: The Gate of War
Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_MeetDemianinNeu.text3: To bring down the flying fortress, Valgash's technology is required. Find him at Gorthak Ironworks.
Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_MeetDemianinNeu.text4: The Gate of Peace, the entrance to Gorthak, was in chaos following an assault of clockwork insects. You gained entry after helping the soldiers defeat the swarm. Find Valgash who holds the key to dealing with the flying fortress.

Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_Valgash.title: Master of the Ironworks
Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_Valgash.text3: Find Valgash at the ironworks, explain the current situation, and seek his assistance.
Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_Valgash.text4: Valgash, leader of Gorthak, is in a difficult position. Unable to cooperate due to the chaos caused by the insect swarm, he proposed that mutual aid could resolve both situations. Assist Valgash to secure his support against the flying fortress.

Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_BurnSilver_Robo.title: Hidden Ace
Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_BurnSilver_Robo.text3: Head to the location where Valgash's secret weapon is kept to learn more about its nature.
Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_BurnSilver_Robo.text4: Valgash's secret weapon, the A.T.A.G., is unlike anything seen before. Loaded with explosives, the machine is essentially a walking fortress. After learning its operation from the master artisan, an initial test run proved its immense destructive capabilities.

Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_GorthakIronMake.title: Clockwork Insect Clash
Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_GorthakIronMake.text3: Gorthak is overrun with clockwork insects. Defeat them to secure the ironworks' safety.
Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_GorthakIronMake.text4: The clockwork insects swarming Gorthak were driven out, and the ironworks is secure.

Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_TransmissionTow.title: Beating Heart
Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_TransmissionTow.text3: A lull in enemy attacks provides an opportunity. Activate the power plant to restore power.
Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_TransmissionTow.text4: The power plant was successfully activated, and the heart of Gorthak Ironworks began to beat once more. This was short-lived, as swarms of clockwork insects rushed toward the facility, drawn by its hum. Protect the plant from the approaching swarm.

Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_MonsterWave.title: Invaders from the East
Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_MonsterWave.text3: A swarm of clockwork insects approaches the reactivated power plant. Protect the plant until the charging process is complete.
Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_MonsterWave.text4: You fended off the endless swarm until the charging process was completed. The giant cannon struck the sky galleon with precision, shattering it midair. Amidst the joy of victory, an object emitting a red glow fell to the ground from the debris.

Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_SteelMillEscape.title: Frozen Hearted Predator
Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_SteelMillEscape.text3: Find the strange glowing object that fell from the sky galleon and crashed into the center of Gorthak.
Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_SteelMillEscape.text4: A weapon in the form of a giant mantis fell from the sky galleon's debris. Its metal heart, rampaging with overwhelming power, froze over after a fierce battle.

Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_MachineTheFall.title: Lingering Shadow
Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_MachineTheFall.text3: It appears the assault has ended with the defeat of the clockwork mantis. Find and speak with Valgash.
Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_MachineTheFall.text4: Since the giant cannon was exhausted defending the ironworks, it is unusable for the assault on the flying fortress. Direct confrontation with Marni in Delesyia is now the only option. It remains unknown what his true intentions are.

Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_Audience_dlc.title: Prelude of Steel
Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_Audience_dlc.text3: After the battle, speak with the Greymane comrades gathered nearby.
Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_Audience_dlc.text4: All seem shaken by the news that the people of Pailune are being sold as slaves in Delesyia. Thinking of those enduring such torment, there's no time to waste.

Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_Audience.title: The City of Steel
Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_Audience.text3: Visit Marni, the master of the flying fortress, in Delesyia Castle to negotiate a resolution to its looming presence.
Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_Audience.text4: A bizarre scene unfolded in the castle. From the escorts to the soldiers, all wore visiones and bore the same soulless demeanor. The mysterious figure seated on the throne claimed it would provide a moment's rest to think, then threw you into a dungeon.

Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_Underground.title: At a Crossroads
Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_Underground.text3: Marni claimed he would give you time to think, but instead locked you in a dungeon. Search the area to find a way out.
Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_Underground.text4: A playback device became a glimmer of hope. The accomplice within the device provided the support needed for a successful escape, yet the identity of the person who placed it remains unknown.

Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_MarniMansion.title: Strange Manor
Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_MarniMansion.text3: The identity and motives of the man who assisted the escape remain unclear. Locate the mansion with the golden statue to find answers.
Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_MarniMansion.text4: The mysterious man who aided your escape claimed to share the same goal as you and requested assistance. It was unclear if he simply wished to destroy the flying fortress or if he harbored other motives. Meeting him is the only way to reveal his true intentions.

Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_CollectingKeyCh.title: Fortress Keys
Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_CollectingKeyCh.text3: Find the three keys mentioned by the mysterious man, which are required to reach his location.
Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_CollectingKeyCh.text4: All three fortress keys were obtained through intense combat and exploration. Such a perilous task allowing for no mistakes seemed to be a trivial matter for the mysterious man.

Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_Rescue_dlc.title: Heart of the Machine
Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_Rescue_dlc.text3: To find clues left by our fellow Pailunese, we must first search the suspicious areas nearby.
Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_Rescue_dlc.text4: The journal detailed a gruesome plan to use our fellow Pailune as living power sources for the machines. You barely managed to rescue those trapped inside the devices, but are the biological experiments truly over?

Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_MarniMeet.title: Truth and Lies
Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_MarniMeet.text3: Use the keys to activate the transporter inside the manor.
Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_MarniMeet.text4: Our mysterious ally revealed himself to be the real Marni. He explained that H.A.L.L., the entity currently ruling Delesyia, was his own cloned consciousness that had spiraled out of control. He requested assistance in destroying H.A.L.L. and provided instructions on how to destroy the Flying Fortress Orbian.

Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_GoldenStar_Star.title: Master of a Forgotten Land
Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_GoldenStar_Star.text3: In order to destroy the Flying Fortress Orbian, Golden Star must be defeated to obtain its power core.
Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_GoldenStar_Star.text4: During the struggle against Golden Star, Blackstar appeared to assist, creating an opportunity for a critical strike. Golden Star was destroyed and its power core was retrieved. Shortly after, White Crow appeared and handed over records related to the machine.

Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_GoldenStar_Blow.title: Whispers in the Wind
Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_GoldenStar_Blow.text3: White Crow is guiding you to the Abyss. Follow White Crow.
Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_GoldenStar_Blow.text4: Waiting within the Abyss was the dragon, Blackstar, an ally whose bond was forged amidst the desert sands. Just as White Crow foretold, Blackstar shall be the wings you need for the path ahead. With such an ally at your side, the destruction of the "impregnable" flying fortress is suddenly within reach.

Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_GoldenStar_AirC.title: Flying Fortress Orbian
Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_GoldenStar_AirC.text3: Destroy the Flying Fortress Orbian with Blackstar.
Mission_MarniDragon_Boss_GoldenStar_AirC.text4: As the great bastion's heart fell still, the crushing weight that had stifled the battlefield finally lifted. The flying fortress looms only as a hollow husk, unable to do anything but bear silent witness to the final, relentless march toward victory.

Mission_Caliburn_Boss_VictoryKey_dlc.title: The Key to Victory
Mission_Caliburn_Boss_VictoryKey_dlc.text3: Rally at Fort Musket's outpost for the final battle.
Mission_Caliburn_Boss_VictoryKey_dlc.text4: You've regrouped with your scattered allies at the  Musket outpost. Now, it's time to reignite the fighting spirit of the demoralized soldiers.

Mission_Caliburn_Boss_Threat.title: Precise Execution
Mission_Caliburn_Boss_Threat.text3: The Flying Fortress Orbian has been destroyed. Return to the outpost and prepare for battle.
Mission_Caliburn_Boss_Threat.text4: The joy of victory was short-lived as the enemy's ultimate weapons were revealed. Massive cannons protected the central fortress with overwhelming firepower. With allied morale at risk before the combat has even begun, a new plan is required.

Mission_Caliburn_Boss_Turrets.title: Deferred Advance
Mission_Caliburn_Boss_Turrets.text3: A method to neutralize the cannons must be found before the battle can begin.
Mission_Caliburn_Boss_Turrets.text4: The cannons protecting the fortress were successfully destroyed thanks to Gorthak's weaponry and the assistance of Blackstar. Allied morale is at an all-time high, while the enemy retreats as their cannons collapse with a thunderous roar.

Mission_Caliburn_Boss_MusketSiege_Milita.title: Departure of the Brave
Mission_Caliburn_Boss_MusketSiege_Milita.text3: The final battle for the fate of Pywel has drawn near. Join your comrades at the departure ceremony to strengthen resolve for the fight ahead.
Mission_Caliburn_Boss_MusketSiege_Milita.text4: Many soldiers and factions gathered for a solemn yet powerful ceremony. Morale soared as if victory had already been claimed. With eyes fixed upon the fort, each soul strengthened their resolve for the coming battle.

Mission_Caliburn_Boss_FinalAbyss_Roof.title: Forbidden Gate
Mission_Caliburn_Boss_FinalAbyss_Roof.text3: Caliburn is located somewhere within Fort Musket. Break through enemy lines to track him down.
Mission_Caliburn_Boss_FinalAbyss_Roof.text4: The Antumbra followers opened a gate to the Abyss through their ritual. Despite a desperate attempt to stop him, Caliburn vanished beyond the deep darkness. Entrusting Pywel to my comrades, I followed him into the dark.

Mission_Caliburn_Boss_AwakenCaliburn_Bat.title: A Shadow in the Void
Mission_Caliburn_Boss_AwakenCaliburn_Bat.text3:
There remains but a single opportunity to stop Caliburn, who seeks to seize everything.
Pursue Caliburn at last, in search of the one answer capable of altering fate.
Mission_Caliburn_Boss_AwakenCaliburn_Bat.text4: Caliburn was no longer human by the time you found him in the Abyss. A sword appeared suddenly, skewering him through the chest. The one wielding it absorbed him, the two beings becoming one as if that was their natural state.

Mission_Caliburn_Boss_MyurdinUmbra_Battl.title: Blinding Darkness
Mission_Caliburn_Boss_MyurdinUmbra_Battl.text3: Whether it was Caliburn or Myurdin, the being controlling them vanished. Follow the trail of uncertainty and venture into the very depths of the Abyss.
Mission_Caliburn_Boss_MyurdinUmbra_Battl.text4: Both men, Caliburn and Myurdin, had been turned into beasts by an absolute, unending darkness. From that same shadow sprang blinding white wings, their brilliance so fierce it defied the very nature of the void, as if light and darkness were one and the same. Before answers could be found, the darkness swallowed everything.

Mission_Epilogue_Ending_ComeBackHome.title: A New Beginning
Mission_Epilogue_Ending_ComeBackHome.text3: Myurdin's grasp on the land has been put to an end. With Pailune reclaimed, the time has come to look toward the future.
Mission_Epilogue_Ending_ComeBackHome.text4: Peace has returned to Pailune, and all is back in its rightful place. Oongka's advice to let go of burdens and rest resonated deeply within you. A fresh start begins.

Mission_Caliburn_Boss_Ending_ComeBackHer.title: Peace Restored
Mission_Caliburn_Boss_Ending_ComeBackHer.text3: Witness the return of peace to Hernand now that the war has ended.
Mission_Caliburn_Boss_Ending_ComeBackHer.text4: Hernand bustled with its regular activity, but the air carried a new sense of ease. As the festival reached its peak, reuniting with Marshal Middler revealed he had been granted the title of baron.

Mission_Caliburn_Boss_Ending_ComeBackCal.title: The Unyielding Shield
Mission_Caliburn_Boss_Ending_ComeBackCal.text3: After the scars of war, the atmosphere in Calphade has shifted towards recovery. Explore the castle grounds as they undergo reconstruction.
Mission_Caliburn_Boss_Ending_ComeBackCal.text4: Determined to never again suffer the pain of war, Stefan could be seen preparing to lead a training drill. Calphade is establishing itself as a mightier force than ever before to ensure the hard-earned peace lasts.

Mission_Caliburn_Boss_Ending_ComeBackDem.title: The Heart of Pywel
Mission_Caliburn_Boss_Ending_ComeBackDem.text3: Once at the center of chaos, Demeniss has finally settled. Observe the city's transformation.
Mission_Caliburn_Boss_Ending_ComeBackDem.text4: Demeniss, now united, faces a changing future. Countess Azerian, whose sights are set on punishing disloyal factions, is forced to remain patient for now.

Mission_Caliburn_Boss_Ending_Orcneutralz.title: The Enduring Flame
Mission_Caliburn_Boss_Ending_Orcneutralz.text3: With the flames of war extinguished, the forges of Gorthak Ironworks are free to burn once more. Return to the ironworks.
Mission_Caliburn_Boss_Ending_Orcneutralz.text4: Finding the balance between man and machine is the next challenge for the Gorthak Ironworks. Valgash remains busy with post-war reconstruction, assisted by his A.T.A.G. and an unlikely ally, Marni.

Mission_Caliburn_Boss_Ending_Delesyia.title: The Evolving City
Mission_Caliburn_Boss_Ending_Delesyia.text3: Delesyia was the key to taking down the flying fortress and conquering Fort Musket. But as everything seemed to conclude, a memory fragment began to vibrate.
Mission_Caliburn_Boss_Ending_Delesyia.text4: Through a memory, Marni revealed a shocking truth. The visione was not a mere recording device, but a tool designed to read and collect the emotions and thoughts of its wearer. This allowed him to understand the principles of human behavior, and he now believes his evolution has surpassed that of his creator.

Mission_Caliburn_Boss_Ending_ComeBackDem.title: The Desert's Edge
Mission_Caliburn_Boss_Ending_ComeBackDem.text3: Return to the site of the great battle and witness the scars left on Fort Musket.
Mission_Caliburn_Boss_Ending_ComeBackDem.text4: The threat to Fort Musket has not yet passed. Duke Wells has plans to man and restore the fort, which was left vulnerable by the war.

Mission_Caliburn_Boss_Ending_Varnia.title: New Horizons
Mission_Caliburn_Boss_Ending_Varnia.text3: Journey to Varnia, the city in the desert, and enjoy a brief respite within its exotic streets and vibrant markets.
Mission_Caliburn_Boss_Ending_Varnia.text4: A chance encounter led to a reunion with Sebastian, the man who aided you at your journey's beginning. Relieved to find you alive, having heard of your exploits, he proposed a trek across the desert. While the sands are known for bloodshed, they also offer a pilgrimage of peace.
